questions.stem: A rectangle is 8 cm long and 5 cm wide. Find its area.
questions.stemZh: 一個長方形長 8 cm、闊 5 cm。求它的面積。
questions.hint: Area of a rectangle = length × width.
questions.hintZh: 長方形面積 = 長 × 闊。
questions.solution: Area = 8 × 5 = 40 cm².
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A circle has radius 7 cm. Find its area in terms of π.
questions.stemZh: 一個圓的半徑為 7 cm。以 π 表示它的面積。
questions.hint: Use A = πr².
questions.hintZh: 利用 A = πr²。
questions.solution: A = π × 7² = 49π cm².
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A prism has cross-sectional area 12 cm² and length 5 cm. Find its volume.
questions.stemZh: 一個柱體的截面積為 12 cm²，長為 5 cm。求體積。
questions.hint: Multiply the cross-sectional area by the length.
questions.hintZh: 將截面積乘以長度。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A cylinder has radius 3 cm and height 8 cm. Find its volume.
questions.stemZh: 一個圓柱的半徑為 3 cm，高為 8 cm。求體積。
questions.hint: Use V = πr²h.
questions.hintZh: 利用 V = πr²h。
questions.solution: V = π × 3² × 8 = 72π cm³.
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: Find the total surface area of a closed cylinder of radius 3 cm and height 5 cm.
questions.stemZh: 一個密封圓柱的半徑為 3 cm，高為 5 cm。求總表面積。
questions.hint: Include both circular ends and the curved surface.
questions.hintZh: 包括兩個圓形底面及曲面。
questions.solution: A = 2πr² + 2πrh = 18π + 30π = 48π cm².
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: Two similar solids have corresponding lengths in the ratio 2 : 3. Find their volume ratio.
questions.stemZh: 兩個相似立體的對應邊長之比為 2 : 3。求體積之比。
questions.hint: Volume scales with the cube of the length scale factor.
questions.hintZh: 體積比等於長度比的三次方。
questions.solution: The volume ratio is 2³ : 3³ = 8 : 27.
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A sector has radius 6 cm and angle 120°. Find its area.
questions.stemZh: 一個扇形的半徑為 6 cm，圓心角為 120°。求面積。
questions.hint: A sector occupies θ/360 of the full circle.
questions.hintZh: 扇形佔整個圓的 θ/360。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A rectangle is 12 cm long and 7 cm wide. Find its area in cm². Enter only the number.
questions.stemZh: 長方形長 12 cm、闊 7 cm。求面積（cm²），只需輸入數值。
questions.solution: Area = 12×7 = 84 cm².
questions.hint: Multiply length by width.
questions.hintZh: 長方形面積等於長乘闊。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A prism has cross-sectional area 18 cm² and length 7 cm. Find its volume in cm³.
questions.stemZh: 柱體截面積為 18 cm²，長 7 cm。求體積（cm³）。
questions.hint: Multiply cross-sectional area by the length of the prism.
questions.hintZh: 柱體體積等於截面積乘長度。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A closed cylinder has radius 4 cm and height 9 cm. (a) Find its volume. (b) Find its total surface area. Give exact answers in terms of π.
questions.stemZh: 一個密封圓柱半徑為 4 cm，高為 9 cm。(a) 求體積；(b) 求總表面積，以 π 表示答案。
questions.solution:
(a) V=πr²h=π×16×9=144π cm³.
(b) A=2πr²+2πrh=32π+72π=104π cm².
questions.hint: Use the volume formula, then include the two circular faces when finding total surface area.
questions.hintZh: 先用圓柱體積公式。求總表面積時，要包括兩個圓形底面。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習
rubric: 體積公式及答案 144π cm³ 正確。
包括兩個底面，總表面積為 104π cm²。
使用正確平方及立方單位。

questions.stem: Two similar closed cylinders A and B have radii in the ratio 2:3. A has radius 4 cm and height 10 cm. (a) Find the radius and height of B. (b) Find both volumes. (c) Find the ratio of their total surface areas. Explain each scale factor.
questions.stemZh: 兩個相似密封圓柱 A、B 的半徑比為 2:3。A 的半徑為 4 cm，高為 10 cm。(a) 求 B 的半徑及高；(b) 求兩者體積；(c) 求總表面積之比，並解釋各比例因子。
questions.solution:
(a) Linear scale factor is 3/2, so B has radius 6 cm and height 15 cm.
(b) VA=π×4²×10=160π cm³; VB=π×6²×15=540π cm³. Volume ratio is 8:27.
(c) Surface areas scale as the square of corresponding lengths, giving 4:9.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 長度比例因子為 3/2，B 半徑為 6 cm，高為 15 cm。
(b) VA=160π cm³，VB=540π cm³，體積比為 8:27。
(c) 面積比等於長度比的平方，故為 4:9。
questions.hint: Corresponding lengths have ratio 2:3. Square that ratio for areas and cube it for volumes.
questions.hintZh: 對應長度比為 2:3。面積比取平方，體積比取三次方。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習
rubric: B 半徑及高分別為 6 cm、15 cm。（2 分）
體積分別為 160π、540π cm³。（2 分）
清楚說明長度、面積及體積的比例關係。（2 分）

questions.stem: The figure shows rectangle ABCD. AB=8 cm and BC=6 cm. Find the area of triangle ABC.
questions.stemZh: 圖中 ABCD 為長方形，AB=8 cm、BC=6 cm。求三角形 ABC 的面積。
questions.solution: Area of triangle ABC = ½×AB×BC = ½×8×6 = 24 cm².
questions.solutionZh: 三角形 ABC 面積 = ½×8×6 = 24 cm²。
questions.hint: AB and BC are perpendicular. Use them as the base and height of triangle ABC.
questions.hintZh: AB 垂直 BC，可以分別作為三角形 ABC 的底和高。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: In the figure, the solid consists of a right circular cone and a hemisphere with a common base. The base radius and the height of the circular cone are \(3\text{ cm}\) and \(4\text{ cm}\) respectively. Find the total surface area of the solid.
questions.stemZh: 圖中，該立體由一個直立圓錐及一個共享底面的半球組成。圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(3\text{ cm}\) 及 \(4\text{ cm}\)。求該立體的總表面積。
questions.hint: Curved surface area \(=\pi r l\). Slant height \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\).
questions.hintZh: 圓錐曲面面積 = \(\pi r l\)，總面積 = 曲面 + 底。斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
questions.solution: Q2. The cone slant height is \(l=\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5\) cm. The common base is internal, so only the cone and hemisphere curved surfaces are exposed: \(S=\pi(3)(5)+2\pi(3)^2=33\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Answer B. Do not include either circular joining face.
questions.solutionZh: 圓錐斜高 \(l=\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5\) cm。共享底面在內部，故只有圓錐曲面及半球曲面外露：\(S=\pi(3)(5)+2\pi(3)^2=33\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。答案 B。

questions.stem: If the height of a regular tetrahedron is \(2\text{ cm}\), then the volume of the tetrahedron is
questions.stemZh: 若一個正四面體的高為 \(2\text{ cm}\)，則該四面體的體積為
questions.hint: Regular tetrahedron: \(h=\frac{\sqrt{6}}{3}a\), volume \(=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{12}a^3\).
questions.solution: Q3. All faces are congruent equilateral triangles. For edge length \(a\), the distance from the base centre to a base vertex is \(a/\sqrt3\). Pythagoras gives \(a^2=2^2+(a/\sqrt3)^2\), so \(a^2=6\). The base area is \((\sqrt3/4)a^2=3\sqrt3/2\), hence \(V=\frac13(3\sqrt3/2)(2)=\sqrt3\text{ cm}^3\). B. The given height is perpendicular height, not edge length.
questions.solutionZh: 正四面體高 \(h=\frac{\sqrt6}{3}a=2\)，得 \(a=\sqrt6\)。體積 \(V=\frac{\sqrt2}{12}a^3=\frac{\sqrt2}{12}(6\sqrt6)=\sqrt3\text{ cm}^3\)。答案 B。

questions.stem: In the figure, the base of a right prism is a right-angled triangle with legs 6 cm and 8 cm. The length of the prism is 10 cm. Find the volume of the prism.
questions.stemZh: 圖中所示為一個直立棱柱，底面為一直角三角形，兩股分別為 6 cm 及 8 cm。棱柱的長度為 10 cm。求該棱柱的體積。
questions.hint: Prism volume = base area × height.
questions.hintZh: 棱柱體積 = 底面積 × 長度。
questions.solution: The base area is \(\frac12(6)(8)=24\text{ cm}^2\). The volume is \(24(10)=240\text{ cm}^3\). Answer B.

questions.stem: The base radius of a right circular cone is 2 times the base radius of a right circular cylinder while the height of the circular cylinder is 3 times the height of the circular cone. If the volume of the circular cone is \(36\pi\text{ cm}^3\), then the volume of the circular cylinder is
questions.stemZh: 一個直立圓錐的底半徑為一個直立圓柱底半徑的 2 倍，而圓柱的高為圓錐高的 3 倍。若圓柱的體積為 \(243\pi\text{ cm}^3\)，則圓錐的體積為
questions.hint: Use relevant volume/area formulas. Watch units.
questions.hintZh: 運用相關立體體積/面積公式，小心單位。
questions.solution: Q6. Let the cylinder radius be \(r\) and cone height be \(h\). The cone volume is \(\frac13\pi(2r)^2h=\frac43\pi r^2h\); the cylinder volume is \(\pi r^2(3h)=3\pi r^2h\). Thus \(V_{\rm cylinder}/V_{\rm cone}=9/4\), giving \((9/4)(36\pi)=81\pi\text{ cm}^3\). C. Use the separate solid formulae; these solids are not similar.

questions.stem: In the figure, the base of a solid right triangular prism is a right-angled triangle with legs 8 cm and 15 cm. The length of the prism is 10 cm. Find the volume of the prism.
questions.stemZh: 圖中，該實心直立三角棱柱的底面為一直角三角形，兩股分別為 8 cm 及 15 cm。棱柱的長度為 10 cm。求該棱柱的體積。

questions.stem: The base of a solid right pyramid is a square of side \(18\text{ cm}\). If the height of the pyramid is \(12\text{ cm}\), then the total surface area of the pyramid is
questions.stemZh: 一個實心直立錐體的底面為邊長 \(18\text{ cm}\) 的正方形。若錐體高 \(12\text{ cm}\)，則錐體的總表面積為
questions.hint: Pyramid volume = \(\frac{1}{3}\) × base area × height.
questions.hintZh: 錐體體積 = \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
questions.solution: Q8. The face slant height runs to the midpoint of a base edge, so \(l=\sqrt{12^2+9^2}=15\) cm. Add four triangular faces and the square base: \(S=4(\frac12\times18\times15)+18^2=864\text{ cm}^2\). D. The perpendicular pyramid height \(12\) cm is not the triangular face height.
questions.solutionZh: 斜面高至底邊中點：\(l=\sqrt{12^2+9^2}=15\) cm。四面三角面加正方形底：\(S=4\left(\frac12\times18\times15\right)+18^2=540+324=864\text{ cm}^2\)。答案 D。

questions.stem: The base of a solid right prism is a regular 6-sided polygon of side 8 cm. If the volume of the prism is \(288\text{ cm}^3\), find the total surface area of the prism correct to the nearest \(\text{cm}^2\).
questions.stemZh: 一個實心直立棱柱的底面為邊長 \(8\) cm 的正六邊形。若棱柱的體積為 \(288\text{ cm}^3\)，求棱柱的總表面積，準確至最接近的 \(\text{cm}^2\)。
questions.hint: Prism volume = base area × height.
questions.hintZh: 柱體體積 = 底面積 × 高。先搵底面積。
questions.solution: Q10. Split the regular hexagon into six equilateral triangles: \(A=6(\sqrt3/4)(8)^2=96\sqrt3\text{ cm}^2\). The prism height is \(h=288/(96\sqrt3)=\sqrt3\) cm. Thus \(S=2A+(6\times8)h=240\sqrt3\approx415.692\text{ cm}^2\), which rounds to \(416\text{ cm}^2\). C. Keep exact radicals until the final rounding.
questions.solutionZh: 正六邊形面積 \(=6(\sqrt3/4)(8)^2=96\sqrt3\text{ cm}^2\)。棱柱高 \(h=288/(96\sqrt3)=\sqrt3\) cm。\(S=2(96\sqrt3)+(6\times8)(\sqrt3)=240\sqrt3\approx416\text{ cm}^2\)。答案 C。

questions.stem: The sum of the total surface areas of two solid hemispheres is \(351\pi\text{ cm}^2\). If the ratio of the radius of the smaller hemisphere to the radius of the larger hemisphere is \(2:3\), then the difference of the volumes of the two hemispheres is
questions.stemZh: 兩個實心半球的總表面積和為 \(351\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。若較小半球與較大半球的半徑比為 \(2:3\)，則兩半球的體積差為
questions.hint: Sphere volume \(=\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\), surface area \(=4\pi r^2\).
questions.hintZh: 球體積 \(=\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，球面積 \(=4\pi r^2\)。半球總面積 \(=3\pi r^2\)。
questions.solution: Q11. Let the radii be \(2k,3k\). Including the flat bases, \(3\pi(2k)^2+3\pi(3k)^2=351\pi\), so \(k=3\) and the radii are \(6,9\) cm. The volume difference is \(\frac23\pi(9^3-6^3)=342\pi\text{ cm}^3\). A. Hemisphere total surface area is \(3\pi r^2\), not just the curved area \(2\pi r^2\).

questions.stem: The radius of a solid hemisphere and the base radius of a solid right circular cylinder are equal. If the height of the circular cylinder is equal to its base diameter, then the ratio of the total surface area of the hemisphere to the total surface area of the circular cylinder is
questions.stemZh: 一個實心半球的半徑與一個實心直立圓柱的底半徑相等。若圓柱的高等於其底直徑，則半球與圓柱的總表面積之比為
questions.hint: Curved surface area \(=2\pi r h\). Total area = curved + 2 circles.
questions.hintZh: 圓柱曲面面積 = \(2\pi r h\)，總面積 = 曲面 + 2個圓。
questions.solution: Q12. Let the common radius be \(r\); the cylinder height is \(2r\). The hemisphere total area is \(3\pi r^2\), and the cylinder total area is \(2\pi r^2+2\pi r(2r)=6\pi r^2\). The ratio is \(3:6=1:2\). A. Include the exposed flat faces of both solids.
questions.solutionZh: 設共同半徑 \(r\)，圓柱高 \(2r\)。半球總面積 \(3\pi r^2\)，圓柱總面積 \(2\pi r^2+2\pi r(2r)=6\pi r^2\)。比為 \(3:6=1:2\)。答案 A。

questions.stem: The diameter of a circle is 10 cm. The circle is divided into a major segment and a minor segment by a chord of length 8 cm. Find the area of the major segment correct to the nearest \(\text{cm}^2\).
questions.stemZh: 一個圓的直徑為 \(10\) cm。該圓被一條長 \(8\) cm 的弦分成一個大弓形及一個小弓形。求大弓形的面積，準確至最接近的 \(\text{cm}^2\)。
questions.hint: Segment area = sector area - triangle area.
questions.hintZh: 弓形面積 = 扇形面積 - 三角形面積。
questions.solution: Q13. The radius is \(5\) cm and half-chord is \(4\) cm, so the centre-to-chord distance is \(\sqrt{25-16}=3\) cm. The minor-sector angle is \(\theta=2\sin^{-1}(4/5)\approx106.260^\circ\). The minor segment area is \((\theta/360)25\pi-\frac12(8)(3)\approx11.182\text{ cm}^2\). The major segment area is \(25\pi-11.182\approx67.357\text{ cm}^2\), rounding to \(67\text{ cm}^2\). D. Subtract the minor segment from the whole circle.
questions.solutionZh: 半徑 \(5\) cm、半弦 \(4\) cm，圓心至弦距離 \(\sqrt{25-16}=3\) cm。小弓形角 \(\theta=2\sin^{-1}(4/5)\approx106.26^\circ\)。小弓形面積 \(=(\theta/360)25\pi-\frac12(8)(3)\approx11.2\text{ cm}^2\)。大弓形面積 \(=25\pi-11.2\approx67\text{ cm}^2\)。答案 D。

questions.stem: \(O\) is the centre of the sector \(OAB\). The ratio of its radius to its arc length is \(2:3\). If the area of the sector \(OAB\) is \(192\text{ cm}^2\), which of the following are true? I. \(\angle AOB<90^\circ\) II. The radius of the sector \(OAB\) is 16 cm. III. The perimeter of \(\triangle OAB\) is less than 54 cm.
questions.stemZh:
O 為扇形 OAB 的圓心，其半徑與弧長之比為 2:3，面積為 \(192\text{ cm}^2\)。下列哪些敘述正確？
I. \(\angle AOB<90^\circ\)
II. 半徑為 16 cm。
III. 三角形 OAB 的周界小於 54 cm。
questions.hint: Use arc length \(l=r\theta\) and sector area \(A=\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta\).
questions.hintZh: 運用扇形弧長公式 \(l=r\theta\) 同埋扇形面積公式 \(A=\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta\)。
questions.solution: With arc length s = 3r/2, \(192=rs/2=3r^2/4\), so r = 16 and s = 24. The angle is \(24(360)/(2\pi(16))\approx85.94^\circ\), so I and II are true. By the cosine rule, \(AB=\sqrt{16^2+16^2-2(16)^2\cos85.94^\circ}\approx21.81\) cm. Thus the triangle perimeter is approximately 53.81 cm, below 54 cm. All three are true; answer D.
questions.solutionZh: 由弧長 \(s=3r/2\) 及 \(192=rs/2=3r^2/4\)，得 r = 16、s = 24。圓心角為 \(24(360)/(2\pi(16))\approx85.94^\circ\)，故 I、II 正確。由餘弦公式，弦長 \(AB\approx21.81\) cm，三角形周界約為 53.81 cm，小於 54 cm，故 III 亦正確。答案 D。

questions.stem: The base radius of a circular cone is 6 cm. The upper part of the circular cone is cut so that a frustum with height half of the height of the circular cone is made. If the volume of the frustum is 168π cm³, find the height of the frustum.
questions.stemZh: 一個圓錐的底半徑為 \(6\) cm。切除圓錐的上部，造成一個高為圓錐高一半的截頭錐。若截頭錐的體積為 \(168\pi\text{ cm}^3\)，求截頭錐的高。

questions.hintZh: 截頭錐 = 大錐 - 細錐。相似體比例係關鍵。
questions.solution: Let the original cone height be H. The removed cone has half its height and one eighth its volume. Thus \(168\pi=(7/8)(1/3)\pi(6)^2H\), so H = 16 cm. The frustum height is H/2 = 8 cm. Answer C.

questions.stem: A metal sphere has volume \(972\pi\text{ cm}^3\). It is melted and recast, without loss of material, into a cylinder of height 18 cm. Find the exact radius of the cylinder.
questions.stemZh: 一金屬球的體積為 \(972\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。將它熔化並重鑄成高 18 cm 的圓柱，過程中沒有材料損失。求圓柱半徑的準確值。
questions.hint: Sphere volume \(=\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\), surface area \(=4\pi r^2\).
questions.hintZh: 球體積 \(=\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，球面積 \(=4\pi r^2\)。半球總面積 \(=3\pi r^2\)。
questions.solution: Conservation of volume gives \(18\pi r^2=972\pi\), hence \(r^2=54\) and \(r=3\sqrt6\) cm (the positive root). None of the original MC choices equals this value.
questions.solutionZh: 由體積守恆，\(18\pi r^2=972\pi\)，所以 \(r^2=54\)。半徑取正值，故 \(r=3\sqrt6\) cm。原來的四個選項均不等於此值。

questions.stem: The base radius and height of a metal cylinder are 3 cm and 8 cm respectively. The cylinder is melted and recast into two spheres. If the ratio of the radii of the two spheres is \(1: 2\), find the difference between the surface areas of the two spheres correct to 2 decimal places.
questions.stemZh: 一個金屬圓柱的底半徑及高分別為 \(3\) cm 及 \(8\) cm。將圓柱熔化重鑄成兩個球。若兩球的半徑比為 \(1:2\)，求兩球表面積之差。
questions.hint: Curved surface area \(=2\pi r h\). Total area = curved + 2 circles.
questions.hintZh: 圓柱曲面面積 = \(2\pi r h\)，總面積 = 曲面 + 2個圓。
questions.solution: The cylinder volume is \(72\pi\). With sphere radii \(r,2r\), volume conservation gives \(\frac43\pi(r^3+8r^3)=72\pi\), so \(r^3=6\). The area difference is \(12\pi r^2=12\pi\cdot6^{2/3}\approx124.48\text{ cm}^2\). Answer: C.

questions.stem: A sphere is melted and recast into a cone which has the same base radius and height. Find the percentage change in the total surface area.
questions.stemZh: 一個球熔化後重鑄成一個底半徑與高相等的圓錐。求總表面積的百分數變化。
questions.hint: Curved surface area \(=\pi r l\). Slant height \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\).
questions.hintZh: 圓錐曲面面積 = \(\pi r l\)，總面積 = 曲面 + 底。斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
questions.solution: The supplied source gives answer C; it does not include a full derivation.
questions.solutionZh: 球體積 \(\frac43\pi r^3\) = 圓錐 \(\frac13\pi h^3\)，得 \(h=\sqrt[3]{4}r\)。球面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。圓錐總面積 \(=\pi h^2+\pi h\sqrt{2}h=\pi h^2(1+\sqrt2)\approx6.08\pi r^2\)。變化 \(=(6.08-4)/4\approx52.1\%\)。答案 C。

questions.stem: The sum of the volumes of two spheres is \(4992 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). If the ratio of the radius of the larger sphere to the radius of the smaller sphere is \(7: 5\), then the sum of the surface areas of the two spheres is
questions.stemZh: 兩個球的體積和為 \(4992\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。若較大球與較小球的半徑比為 \(7:5\)，則兩球的表面積和為
questions.hint: Sphere volume \(=\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\), surface area \(=4\pi r^2\).
questions.hintZh: 球體積 \(=\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，球面積 \(=4\pi r^2\)。半球總面積 \(=3\pi r^2\)。
questions.solution: Let radii be 7k and 5k. Sum of volumes = \(\frac{4}{3}\pi[(7k)^3+(5k)^3] = \frac{4}{3}\pi(343k^3+125k^3) = \frac{4}{3}\pi(468k^3) = 624\pi k^3\). Given \(624\pi k^3 = 4992\pi\), so \(k^3 = 8\), \(k=2\). Radii are 14 and 10. Sum of surface areas = \(4\pi(14^2+10^2) = 4\pi(196+100) = 4\pi(296) = 1184\pi\). Answer: D.

questions.stem: In the figure, \(OAB\) and \(OCD\) are sectors with centre \(O\). If \(\widehat{AB}=12\pi\text{ cm}\), \(\widehat{CD}=16\pi\text{ cm}\) and \(OA=30\text{ cm}\), then \(AC=\)
questions.stemZh: 圖中，\(OAB\) 及 \(OCD\) 為以 \(O\) 為圓心的扇形。若 \(\widehat{AB}=12\pi\text{ cm}\)、\(\widehat{CD}=16\pi\text{ cm}\) 及 \(OA=30\text{ cm}\)，則 \(AC=\)
questions.solution: Q1. The sectors share the same central angle, so arc lengths are proportional to radii: \(OC/OA=16\pi/(12\pi)=4/3\). Thus \(OC=30(4/3)=40\) cm and \(AC=OC-OA=40-30=10\) cm. Answer B. The outer radius \(40\) cm is not the required difference.
questions.solutionZh: 兩扇形共享同一圓心角，故弧長與半徑成正比：\(OC/OA=16\pi/(12\pi)=4/3\)。因此 \(OC=30(4/3)=40\) cm，\(AC=OC-OA=40-30=10\) cm。答案 B。外半徑 \(40\) cm 並非所求差。

questions.stem: In the figure, \(OAB\) and \(OCD\) are sectors with centre \(O\), where \(OA=33\text{ cm}\) and \(OC=39\text{ cm}\). The area of the shaded region \(ABDC\) is \(72\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Which of the following is/are true? I. The angle of sector OAB is \(60^\circ\). II. The area of sector OAB is \(11\pi\text{ cm}^2\). III. The perimeter of sector OCD is \(13\pi\text{ cm}\).
questions.stemZh: 圖中，\(OAB\) 及 \(OCD\) 為以 \(O\) 為圓心的扇形，其中 \(OA=33\text{ cm}\) 及 \(OC=39\text{ cm}\)。陰影區域 \(ABDC\) 的面積為 \(72\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。下列哪項必為正確？ I. 扇形 OAB 的圓心角為 \(60^\circ\)。II. 扇形 OAB 面積為 \(11\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。III. 扇形 OCD 周界為 \(13\pi\text{ cm}\)。
questions.solution: The common angle is \(\theta=360(72)/(39^2-33^2)=60^\circ\). The inner sector area is \(181.5\pi\text{ cm}^2\), not \(11\pi\). The outer sector perimeter is \(78+13\pi\text{ cm}\), not \(13\pi\). Only I is true.
questions.solutionZh: 共同圓心角 \(\theta=360(72)/(39^2-33^2)=60^\circ\)。內扇形面積為 \(181.5\pi\text{ cm}^2\)，外扇形周界為 \(78+13\pi\text{ cm}\)。只有 I 正確。

questions.stem: In the figure, \(AC\) is a diameter of the circle \(ABCD\) while \(BD\) and \(EF\) are diameters of the circle \(BEDF\). It is given that \(C\) and \(E\) lie on \(AF\). Let \(G\) be the point of intersection of \(AF\) and \(BD\). If \(AG=30\) cm and \(CG=10\) cm, find the area of the shaded region correct to the nearest cm\(^2\).
questions.stemZh: 圖中，AC 為圓 ABCD 的直徑，BD 及 EF 為圓 BEDF 的直徑，C 及 E 在 AF 上，G 為 AF 與 BD 的交點。已知 AG = 30 cm，CG = 10 cm。求陰影部分面積，準確至最接近的 cm²。
questions.solution: The first radius is \(20\) and \(OG=10\), so the second radius is \(BD/2=\sqrt{20^2-10^2}=10\sqrt3\). The overlap is the sum of two circular segments: \(400\pi/3-100\sqrt3+150\pi\). The shaded area is \(400\pi-(400\pi/3-100\sqrt3+150\pi)\approx539.724\text{ cm}^2\), hence 540.
questions.solutionZh: 第一圓半徑為 \(20\)，\(OG=10\)，所以第二圓半徑為 \(10\sqrt3\)。重疊部分由兩個弓形組成，面積為 \(400\pi/3-100\sqrt3+150\pi\)。陰影面積 \(=400\pi-(400\pi/3-100\sqrt3+150\pi)\approx540\text{ cm}^2\)。

questions.stem: In the figure, \(A\) is the centre of the sector \(ABC\). \(D\) is a point lying on \(AC\) such that \(ADB\) is a semi-circle. If \(AB=20\text{ cm}\) and \(AD:DC=4:1\), find the area of the shaded region correct to the nearest \(0.1\text{ cm}^2\).
questions.stemZh: 圖中，\(A\) 為扇形 \(ABC\) 的圓心。\(D\) 為 \(AC\) 上的一點，使 \(ADB\) 為半圓。若 \(AB=20\text{ cm}\) 及 \(AD:DC=4:1\)，求陰影區域的面積，準確至最接近的 \(0.1\text{ cm}^2\)。
questions.solution: Let \(\theta=\angle BAC\). Since \(AD=16\), \(AC=20\), \(\cos\theta=4/5\). The sector ABC area is \(200\theta\); the triangle ABD area is 96. The circular segment BD has area \(50(2\theta-\sin2\theta)\), where \(\sin2\theta=24/25\). The shaded area is \(200\theta-96-50(2\theta-24/25)\approx16.4\text{ cm}^2\).
questions.solutionZh: 設 \(\theta=\angle BAC\)，則 \(\cos\theta=16/20=4/5\)。扇形 ABC 面積為 \(200\theta\)，三角形 ABD 面積為 96，弓形 BD 面積為 \(50(2\theta-24/25)\)。相減得陰影面積 \(16.4\text{ cm}^2\)。

questions.stem:
9. The radius and the area of a sector are \(12\) cm and \(30\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively.

(a) Find the angle of the sector.

(b) Express the perimeter of the sector in terms of \(\pi\).
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
9. 扇形的半徑及面積分別為 \(12\) cm 及 \(30\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求扇形的圓心角。

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 表示扇形的周界。
（5 分）
questions.hint: Radius and sector area → find the fraction of a full circle.
questions.hintZh: 已知半徑及扇形面積 → 先求佔整圓的比例。
questions.solution: (a) Let the central angle be \(\theta^\circ\). The sector occupies \(\theta/360\) of the circle, so \[\frac{\theta}{360}\pi(12)^2=30\pi.\] Cancel \(\pi\) and solve to obtain \(\theta=75\). The angle is \(75^\circ\). (b) The arc has the same fraction of the full circumference: \[s=\frac{75}{360}\times2\pi(12)=5\pi\text{ cm}.\] The perimeter includes the arc and both radii: \[P=5\pi+12+12=(24+5\pi)\text{ cm}.\] Check: \(\frac12rs=\frac12(12)(5\pi)=30\pi\text{ cm}^2\).
questions.solutionZh:
（a）設圓心角為 θ°。扇形佔圓的 θ/360：
\[
\frac{\theta}{360}\pi(12)^2=30\pi.
\]
消去 π 解得 θ = 75。角度為 75°。
（b）弧長佔圓周同樣比例：
\[
s=\frac{75}{360}\times2\pi(12)=5\pi\text{ cm}.
\]
周界包括弧及兩條半徑：
\[
P=5\pi+12+12=(24+5\pi)\text{ cm}.
\]

questions.stem: 6. There is a cylinder with radius \(A \mathrm{~cm}\) and height \(2 A \mathrm{~cm}\). There is also a hemisphere with radius \(\frac{7}{5} \mathrm{Acm}\). Someone claims that the total surface area of the cylinder is larger than the total surface area of the hemisphere. Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh: 6. 有一個半徑為 \(A\) cm、高為 \(2A\) cm 的圓柱。另有一個半徑為 \(\frac{7}{5}A\) cm 的半球。某人聲稱圓柱的總表面積大於半球的總表面積。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Total surface area comparison → list every exposed face.
questions.hintZh: 比較總表面積 → 先逐個數外露面。
questions.solution: Total surface area includes all exposed curved and flat faces. The cylinder has two circular ends and one curved surface: \(S_C=2\pi A^2+2\pi(A)(2A)=6\pi A^2.\) The hemisphere has half a spherical surface and one circular base: \(S_H=3\pi\left(\frac75A\right)^2=\frac{147}{25}\pi A^2.\) Their difference is \(S_C-S_H=\frac3{25}\pi A^2>0\) since \(A>0\). The cylinder has the greater total surface area, so the claim is correct.
questions.solutionZh:
總表面積包括所有外露曲面及平面。圓柱有兩個圓形端面及一個曲面：
\[
S_C=2\pi A^2+2\pi(A)(2A)=6\pi A^2.
\]
半球有半個球面及一個圓形底面：
\[
S_H=3\pi\left(\frac75A\right)^2=\frac{147}{25}\pi A^2.
\]
兩者相差：
\[
S_C-S_H=\frac3{25}\pi A^2>0.
\]
圓柱總表面積較大，故聲稱正確。

questions.stem:
5. Consider the sector \(OABC\) of area \(1215\pi\text{ cm}^2\). The angle of the sector is \(216^\circ\).

(a) Find the radius of the sector.

(b) By joining \(OA\) and \(OC\) together, \(OABC\) is folded to form an inverted right circular conical vessel. Express the capacity of the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).
(4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
5. 扇形 \(OABC\) 的面積為 \(1215\pi\text{ cm}^2\)，圓心角為 \(216^\circ\)。

(a) 求扇形的半徑。

(b) 將 \(OA\) 及 \(OC\) 接合，把 \(OABC\) 摺成一個倒置直立圓錐形容器。以 \(\pi\) 表示該容器的容量。
（4 分）
questions.hint: Rolled sector → radius becomes slant height; arc becomes circumference.
questions.hintZh: 扇形捲成圓錐 → 半徑變斜高，弧變底圓周。
questions.solution: (a) Let the sector radius be \(l\) cm. The sector-area formula gives \[\frac{216}{360}\pi l^2=1215\pi \Rightarrow l^2=2025.\] Taking the positive root, \(l=45\) cm. (b) The sector radius becomes the cone slant height, and the arc becomes the base circumference. For base radius \(r\), \[2\pi r=\frac{216}{360}\times2\pi(45)=54\pi, r=27.\] Pythagoras gives the perpendicular height: \[h=\sqrt{45^2-27^2}=36\text{ cm}.\] The capacity is \[V=\frac13\pi(27)^2(36)=8748\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Check: \(\pi rl=\pi(27)(45)=1215\pi\), equal to the original sector area.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）設扇形半徑為 l cm。扇形面積公式：
\[
\frac{216}{360}\pi l^2=1215\pi \Rightarrow l^2=2025.
\]
取正根，l = 45 cm。
（b）扇形半徑成為圓錐斜高，弧長成為底圓周。設底半徑 r：
\[
2\pi r=\frac{216}{360}\times2\pi(45)=54\pi,\quad r=27.
\]
畢氏定理求垂直高度：
\[
h=\sqrt{45^2-27^2}=36\text{ cm}.
\]
容量：
\[
V=\frac13\pi(27)^2(36)=8748\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]

questions.stem:
The radius and area of a sector are \(10\) cm and \(2\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively.

(a) Find the angle of the sector.

(b) Find the perimeter of the sector.
(4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
扇形的半徑及面積分別為 \(10\) cm 及 \(2\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求扇形的圓心角。

(b) 求扇形的周界。
（4 分）
questions.hint: Sector-area fraction equals the fraction of a full turn.
questions.hintZh: 扇形面積與整圓面積之比，等於圓心角與 \(360^\circ\) 之比。
questions.solution: (a) The sector occupies \(2\pi/(100\pi)=1/50\) of the full circle. Its central angle is therefore \[\theta=360\times\frac1{50}=7.2^\circ.\] (b) The arc occupies the same fraction of the circumference: \[s=\frac1{50}\times2\pi(10)=\frac{2\pi}{5}\text{ cm}.\] Add both radii for the perimeter: \[P=20+\frac{2\pi}{5}\approx21.3\text{ cm} \text{(3 s.f.)}.\] Check: \(\frac12rs=\frac12(10)(2\pi/5)=2\pi\), as given.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）扇形佔整圓的 2π/(100π) = 1/50。圓心角：
\[
\theta=360\times\frac1{50}=7.2^\circ.
\]
（b）弧長佔圓周同樣比例：
\[
s=\frac1{50}\times2\pi(10)=\frac{2\pi}{5}\text{ cm}.
\]
加上兩條半徑：
\[
P=20+\frac{2\pi}{5}\approx21.3\text{ cm}.
\]

questions.stem:
11. Let \(\$C\) be the cost of painting a can of surface area \(A\text{ m}^2\). It is given that \(C\) is the sum of two parts, one part is a constant and the other part varies as \(A\). When \(A=2\), \(C=62\); when \(A=6\), \(C=74\).

(a) Find the cost of painting a can of surface area \(13\text{ m}^2\).

(b) There is a larger can which is similar to the can described in (a). If the volume of the larger can is \(8\) times that of the can described in (a), find the cost of painting the larger can.
(4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
11. 設 \(C\) 為油漆一個表面積為 \(A\text{ m}^2\) 的罐的成本。已知 \(C\) 由兩部分組成，一部分為常數，另一部分隨 \(A\) 正變。當 \(A=2\) 時，\(C=62\)；當 \(A=6\) 時，\(C=74\)。

(a) 求油漆一個表面積為 \(13\text{ m}^2\) 的罐的成本。

(b) 有一個較大的罐，與 

(a) 所述的罐相似。若較大罐的體積為 

(a) 所述罐的 \(8\) 倍，求油漆較大罐的成本。
（4 分）
questions.hint: Fixed cost plus area-dependent cost → start with \(C=a+bA\).
questions.hintZh:
費用有固定部分＋面積正變部分 → 先建 \(C=

(a)+bA\)。
questions.solution: Let \(C=a+bA\). The two given cases yield \(a+2b=62,\qquad a+6b=74.\) Subtracting gives \(4b=12\), so \(b=3\) and \(a=56\). Thus \(C=56+3A\). (a) At \(A=13\), \(C=56+3(13)=95\). The cost is 95 dollars. (b) The volume ratio is \(8:1\), so the linear ratio is \(2:1\) and the area ratio is \(4:1\). The larger can has area \(4(13)=52\text{ m}^2\). Its cost is \[C=56+3(52)=212\text{ dollars}.\] The fixed charge remains 56 dollars; it does not scale with the can.

questions.stem:
14. A vessel in the form of a frustum which is made by cutting off the lower part of an inverted right circular cone of base radius \(72\) cm and height \(96\) cm. The height of the vessel is \(60\) cm. The vessel is placed on a horizontal table. Some water is now poured into the vessel. John finds that the depth of water in the vessel is \(28\) cm.

(a) Find the area of the wet curved surface of the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) John claims that the volume of water in the vessel is greater than \(0.1\text{ m}^3\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個截頭錐形容器，由切除一個底半徑 \(72\) cm、高 \(96\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐的下部而成。容器的高度為 \(60\) cm，放在水平桌上。現將一些水倒入容器，John 發現水深為 \(28\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求容器的濕曲面面積。

(b) John 聲稱容器中的水體積大於 \(0.1\text{ m}^3\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: The water surface is \(60-28=32\) cm below the top of the vessel, so it is \(96-60+28=64\) cm from the vertex of the original cone. Let \(R\) cm be the radius of the water surface. By similarity, \(\frac{R}{72}=\frac{64}{96},\) so \(R=48.\) The lower cut is \(96-60=36\) cm from the vertex. Let its radius be \(r\). Then \(\frac{r}{72}=\frac{36}{96},\) so \(r=27.\) (a) The wet curved surface area is \[\pi(48)\sqrt{48^2+64^2}-\pi(27)\sqrt{27^2+36^2}.\] Thus \[=\pi(48)(80)-\pi(27)(45)=2625\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (b) The volume of water is \[\frac13\pi(48)^2(64)-\frac13\pi(27)^2(36) =40404\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Since \[40404\pi\text{ cm}^3\approx0.1269\text{ m}^3>0.1\text{ m}^3,\] the claim is agreed. Final answers: (a) \(2625\pi\text{ cm}^2\); (b) agree.

11. An inverted right circular conical vessel contains some milk. The vessel is held vertically. The depth of milk in the vessel is \(12\) cm. Peter then pours \(444\pi\text{ cm}^3\) of milk into the vessel without overflowing. He now finds that the depth of milk in the vessel is \(16\) cm.

questions.stemZh:
11. 一個倒置直立圓錐形容器盛有一些牛奶，容器垂直放置。牛奶的深度為 \(12\) cm。Peter 再倒入 \(444\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 牛奶而沒有溢出，他發現牛奶深度變為 \(16\) cm。

(b) Peter 聲稱容器的濕曲面面積最少為 \(800\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（6 分）
questions.hint: Calculate the values, then compare with the claim. State agree/disagree clearly.
questions.hintZh: 先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: (a) Let \(V\text{ cm}^3\) be the final volume of milk. By similarity, \[\frac{V-444\pi}{V}=\left(\frac{12}{16}\right)^3.\] Solving gives \[V=768\pi.\] (b) Let \(r\) be the final radius of the surface of milk. Then \[\frac13\pi r^2(16)=768\pi,\] so \[ r=12. \] The final wet curved surface area is \[\pi(12)\sqrt{12^2+16^2}=240\pi\approx754\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \(240\pi<800\), the claim is disagreed. Final answers: (a) \(768\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) disagree.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）設最終牛奶體積 V。由相似：
\[
\frac{V-444\pi}{V}=\left(\frac{12}{16}\right)^3.
\]
解得 V = 768π。
（b）設水面半徑 r：
\[
\frac13\pi r^2(16)=768\pi,\quad r=12.
\]
最終濕曲面：
\[
\pi(12)\sqrt{12^2+16^2}=240\pi\approx754\text{ cm}^2.
\]
240π < 800，不同意聲稱。

questions.stem:
13. \(ABCD\) is a trapezium with \(\angle ABC=90^\circ\) and \(AB\parallel DC\). \(E\) is a point lying on \(BC\) such that \(\angle AED=90^\circ\).

(a) Prove that \(\triangle ABE\sim\triangle ECD\).

(b) It is given that \(AB=15\) cm, \(AE=25\) cm and \(CE=36\) cm.

(i) Find the length of \(CD\).
(ii) Find the area of \(\triangle ADE\).
(iii) Is there a point \(F\) lying on \(AD\) such that the distance between \(E\) and \(F\) is less than \(23\) cm? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. \(ABCD\) 為梯形，\(\angle ABC=90^\circ\) 且 \(AB\parallel DC\)。\(E\) 為 \(BC\) 上的一點，使得 \(\angle AED=90^\circ\)。

(a) 證明 \(\triangle ABE\sim\triangle ECD\)。

(b) 已知 \(AB=15\) cm、\(AE=25\) cm 及 \(CE=36\) cm。

(i) 求 \(CD\) 的長度。
(ii) 求 \(\triangle ADE\) 的面積。
(iii) \(AD\) 上是否存在一點 \(F\)，使得 \(E\) 與 \(F\) 的距離小於 \(23\) cm？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Trapezium area = (a+b)h/2.
questions.solution: (a) Since \(AB\parallel DC\) and \(\angle ABC=90^\circ\), \[\angle ABE=\angle DCE=90^\circ.\] Also \(\angle AED=90^\circ\), so the remaining acute angles are equal. Hence \[\triangle ABE\sim\triangle ECD.\] (b)(i) \(BE=\sqrt{AE^2-AB^2}=\sqrt{25^2-15^2}=20\text{ cm}.\) By similarity, \(\frac{CD}{BE}=\frac{CE}{AB}\) so \(\frac{CD}{20}=\frac{36}{15}\) and \(CD=48\text{ cm}.\) (b)(ii) The area of \(\triangle ADE\) is \(\frac12(AB+CD)(BC)-\frac12(AB)(BE)-\frac12(CD)(CE)\) \(=\frac12(15+48)(20+36)-\frac12(15)(20)-\frac12(48)(36)=750\text{ cm}^2.\) (b)(iii) \(AD=\sqrt{BC^2+(CD-AB)^2} =\sqrt{56^2+33^2}=65\text{ cm}.\) The shortest distance from \(E\) to \(AD\) is \(\frac{2(750)}{65}=\frac{300}{13}\approx23.1\text{ cm}.\) Since this is greater than \(23\) cm, there is no such point \(F\). Final answers: (a) proved; (b)(i) \(48\) cm; (b)(ii) \(750\text{ cm}^2\); (b)(iii) no.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）AB ∥ DC 且 ∠ABC = 90°，故 ∠ABE = ∠DCE = 90°。又 ∠AED = 90°，其餘銳角相等，故 △ABE ∼ △ECD。
（b）（i）BE = √(25²−15²) = 20 cm。由相似：
\[
\frac{CD}{20}=\frac{36}{15},\quad CD=48\text{ cm}.
\]
（b）（ii）△ADE 面積：
\[
\frac12(15+48)(56)-\frac12(15)(20)-\frac12(48)(36)=750\text{ cm}^2.
\]
（b）（iii）AD = √(56²+33²) = 65 cm。E 至 AD 最短距離：
\[
\frac{2(750)}{65}=\frac{300}{13}\approx23.1\text{ cm}.
\]
大於 23 cm，不存在此點 F。

questions.stem:
14. A right circular cylindrical container of base radius \(8\) cm and height \(64\) cm and an inverted right circular conical vessel of base radius \(20\) cm and height \(60\) cm are held vertically. The container is fully filled with water. The water in the container is now poured into the vessel.

(a) Find the volume of water in the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Find the depth of water in the vessel.

(c) If a solid metal sphere of radius \(14\) cm is then put into the vessel and the sphere is totally immersed in the water, will the water overflow? Explain your answer.
(9 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個底半徑 \(8\) cm、高 \(64\) cm 的直立圓柱形容器，與一個底半徑 \(20\) cm、高 \(60\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器，均垂直放置。圓柱容器完全注滿水，現將水全部倒入圓錐容器。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求圓錐容器中水的體積。

(b) 求圓錐容器中水的深度。

(c) 若再將一個半徑 \(14\) cm 的實心金屬球放入圓錐容器中，且球完全浸入水中，水會否溢出？試解釋你的答案。
（9 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution: (a) \[V=\pi(8)^2(64)=4096\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) Let the depth of water be \(h\) cm. By similarity, the radius of the water surface is \(\frac h3\). Hence \[\frac13\pi\left(\frac h3\right)^2h=4096\pi.\] Thus \[h^3=110592\] and \[ h=48. \] (c) The capacity of the conical vessel is \[\frac13\pi(20)^2(60)=8000\pi.\] The volume not occupied by water is \[8000\pi-4096\pi=3904\pi.\] The volume of the metal sphere is \[\frac43\pi(14)^3=\frac{10976}{3}\pi.\] Since \[\frac{10976}{3}\pi<3904\pi,\] the water will not overflow. Final answers: (a) \(4096\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(48\) cm; (c) no.

12. The height and the base radius of a solid right circular cone are \(36\) cm and \(15\) cm respectively. The circular cone is divided into three parts by two planes which are parallel to its base. The heights of the three parts are equal. Express, in terms of \(\pi\),

(a) the volume of the middle part of the circular cone;

(b) the curved surface area of the middle part of the circular cone.
(6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個實心直立圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(36\) cm 及 \(15\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分，三部分的高度相等。以 \(\pi\) 表示：

(a) 圓錐中間部分的體積；

(b) 圓錐中間部分的曲面面積。
（6 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh: 圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
questions.solution: (a) The middle part is the difference between two similar cones with heights \(24\) cm and \(12\) cm. The corresponding radii are \[10\text{ cm} \text{and} 5\text{ cm}.\] Thus the volume of the middle part is \[\frac13\pi(10^2)(24)-\frac13\pi(5^2)(12)=700\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The slant heights of the two cones are \[\sqrt{10^2+24^2}=26,\qquad \sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13.\] The curved surface area of the middle part is \[\pi(10)(26)-\pi(5)(13)=195\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Final answers: (a) \(700\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(195\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

questions.stem:
14. Fig. 1 shows a cup \(VAB\) made from soft plastic sheets and in the shape of a right circular cone of base radius \(9\text{ cm}\) and height \(21\text{ cm}\). The dotted circle \(XY\) is parallel to the base and one-third of the height from the base.

(a) Find the volume of the frustum \(ABXY\).

(b) The lower portion \(VXY\) of the cone is now pushed up along circle \(XY\) to form the container in Fig. 2. If it is placed with its base horizontal and water is poured into it until overflows, find the amount of water in the container. Give both answers in terms of \(\pi\).
questions.stemZh:
14. 圖 1 顯示一個用軟膠片造成的杯 \(VAB\)，形狀為底半徑 \(9\) cm、高 \(21\) cm 的直立圓錐。虛線圓 \(XY\) 平行於底面，且與底面的距離為高度的三分之一。

(a) 求截頭錐 \(ABXY\) 的體積。

(b) 現將圓錐下部 \(VXY\) 沿圓 \(XY\) 向上推，造成圖 2 的容器。若將容器底平放，加水至溢出，求容器中的水量。兩個答案均以 \(\pi\) 表示。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution: The full cone has volume \(\frac13\pi(9^2)(21)=567\pi.\) Since \(XY\) is one-third of the height from the base, the smaller top cone has height \(14\text{ cm}\) and radius \(6\text{ cm}\). Its volume is \(\frac13\pi(6^2)(14)=168\pi.\) Hence the frustum \(ABXY\) has volume \(567\pi-168\pi=\boxed{399\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\) After the lower portion is pushed up, the container is a frustum with volume \(168\pi-21\pi=147\pi\) removed from the lower cone, so the water volume is \(399\pi-147\pi=\boxed{252\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\)
questions.solutionZh: 整錐體積 = (1/3)π(9²)(21) = 567π。XY 距底三分之一高，上方小錐高 14、半徑 6，體積 = 168π。截頭錐 ABXY = 567π − 168π = 399π cm³。下方推入後，下方小錐移除 168π − 21π = 147π，水體積 = 399π − 147π = 252π cm³。

questions.stem:
13. The height and the curved surface area of a solid metal right circular cone are \(24\) cm and \(260\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively.

(a) Find the base radius of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided by two planes which are parallel to its base. The top is a right circular cone \(X\), the middle is a frustum \(Y\) and the bottom is a frustum \(Z\). It is given that the ratio of the curved surface areas of \(X\), \(Y\) and \(Z\) is \(9:16:11\). Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的高及曲面面積分別為 \(24\) cm 及 \(260\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求圓錐的底半徑。

(b) 該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分：頂部為圓錐 \(X\)，中間為截頭錐 \(Y\)，底部為截頭錐 \(Z\)。已知 \(X\)、\(Y\)、\(Z\) 的曲面面積比為 \(9:16:11\)。以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的體積。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
questions.solution: (a) Let the base radius be \(r\) cm. The slant height is \[\sqrt{r^2+24^2}.\] Since the curved surface area is \(260\pi\), \[\pi r\sqrt{r^2+576}=260\pi.\] Hence \[r^2(r^2+576)=260^2.\] So \[r^4+576r^2-67600=0.\] This gives \[(r^2-100)(r^2+676)=0.\] Rejecting the negative value, \[r=\boxed{10\text{ cm}}.\] (b) The curved surface areas of \(X\), \(X+Y\) and the whole cone are in the ratio \[9:(9+16):(9+16+11)=9:25:36.\] Therefore, the corresponding linear ratio is \[ 3:5:6, \] and the corresponding volume ratio is \[27:125:216.\] The volume of the whole cone is \[\frac13\pi(10)^2(24)=800\pi.\] Thus \[V_Y=800\pi\cdot\frac{125-27}{216} =\boxed{\frac{9800\pi}{27}\text{ cm}^3}.\]

questions.stem:
11. Consider a right circular cone of base radius 15 cm and height 40 cm . A smaller cone of height 16 cm is cut from the original cone along with the plane parallel to its base of the larger cone.

(a) Find the base radius of the smaller cone.

(b) Someone claims that the total surface area of the frustum formed is at least \(2500 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\).
Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
11. 考慮一個底半徑 \(15\) cm、高 \(40\) cm 的直立圓錐。沿平行於底面的平面，從原圓錐切除一個高 \(16\) cm 的小圓錐。

(a) 求小圓錐的底半徑。

(b) 某人聲稱所得截頭錐的總表面積最少為 \(2500\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: (a) Let the base radius of the smaller cone be \(r\) cm. By similarity, \[\frac{r}{15}=\frac{16}{40},\] so \[r=\boxed{6}.\] (b) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{15^2+40^2}=5\sqrt{73}.\] The slant height of the smaller cone is \[\sqrt{6^2+16^2}=2\sqrt{73}.\] The curved surface area of the frustum is \[\pi(15)(5\sqrt{73})-\pi(6)(2\sqrt{73})=63\pi\sqrt{73}.\] Including the two circular ends, the total surface area is \[63\pi\sqrt{73}+15^2\pi+6^2\pi =\pi(63\sqrt{73}+261).\] Since \[\pi(63\sqrt{73}+261)>2500,\] the claim is correct.

questions.stem: 3. 6 litres of pure alcohol is mixed with 4 litres of water. How much water should be added so that the ratio of volume of alcohol to that of water is \(2: 3\) ?
questions.stemZh: 3. 6 升純酒精與 4 升水混合。需再加入多少水，才能使酒精與水的體積比為 \(2:3\)？
questions.hint: Volume displaced = object volume. Compare calculated value with claim.

questions.solution: The volume of alcohol is \(6\) litres. For the ratio of alcohol to water to be \(2:3\), the volume of water should be \(6\times\frac32=9\text{ litres}.\) There are already \(4\) litres of water, so the amount of water to be added is \(9-4=\boxed{5\text{ litres}}.\)

questions.stem:
13. An inverted right circular conical vessel of base radius \(4\) cm and height \(5\) cm contains water to a depth of \(3.5\) cm. All the water in the vessel is now poured into an empty right circular cylindrical cup with base radius \(2.1\) cm without overflow.

(a) Find the depth of water in the cylindrical cup.

(b) A solid metal sphere is then put into the cylindrical cup. The metal sphere is completely immersed in water and no water spills out of the cup. The total area of the wet surface of the cup is \(21.21\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(i) Mark claims that the sum of the volumes of the water and the metal sphere is greater than \(55000\text{ mm}^3\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(ii) Find the radius of the metal sphere.
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個底半徑 \(4\) cm、高 \(5\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器盛水至深度 \(3.5\) cm。現將全部水倒入一個底半徑 \(2.1\) cm 的空直立圓柱杯，且沒有溢出。

(a) 求圓柱杯中水的深度。

(b) 再將一個實心金屬球放入圓柱杯，球完全浸入水中且沒有水溢出。杯的濕表面總面積為 \(21.21\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(i) Mark 聲稱水與金屬球的體積之和大於 \(55000\text{ mm}^3\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
(ii) 求金屬球的半徑。
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: (a) Let \(r\) cm be the radius of the water surface in the conical vessel. By similarity, \[\frac r4=\frac{3.5}{5},\] so \[ r=2.8. \] Let the depth of water in the cylindrical cup be \(h\) cm. Then \[\frac13\pi(2.8)^2(3.5)=\pi(2.1)^2h.\] Hence \[h=\boxed{\frac{56}{27}\text{ cm}}.\] (b)(i) Let \(H\) cm be the water depth after the sphere is put into the cup. The total wet surface area is \(\pi(2.1)^2+2\pi(2.1)H=21.21\pi.\) Thus \(H=4.\) The sum of the volumes of the water and the sphere is \(\pi(2.1)^2(4)\approx55.418\text{ cm}^3 =55418\text{ mm}^3.\) Since \(55418>55000\), the claim is correct. (ii) Let the radius of the metal sphere be \(R\) cm. Then \[\frac43\pi R^3=\pi(2.1)^2\left(4-\frac{56}{27}\right).\] Hence \[R\approx\boxed{1.85\text{ cm}}.\]
questions.solutionZh:
（a）設錐內水面半徑 r。由相似 r/4 = 3.5/5，r = 2.8。設杯中水深 h：
\[
\frac13\pi(2.8)^2(3.5)=\pi(2.1)^2h,\quad h=\frac{56}{27}\text{ cm}.
\]
（b）（i）設放入球後水深 H。總濕面積 π(2.1)² + 2π(2.1)H = 21.21π，H = 4。水+球體積 = π(2.1)²(4) ≈ 55418 mm³ > 55000 mm³，聲稱正確。
（b）（ii）設球半徑 R：
\[
\frac43\pi R^3=\pi(2.1)^2\left(4-\frac{56}{27}\right),\quad R\approx1.85\text{ cm}.
\]

(a) Find the height and the base radius of the smaller circular cone removed.

(b) If the height of the circular cylinder is \(4\) cm, is the total surface area of solid \(P\) larger than \(1000\text{ cm}^2\)? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
10. 一個高 \(8\) cm 的截頭錐，由切除一個底半徑 \(10\) cm 的實心直立圓錐的上部造成。已知切除的小圓錐高與截頭錐高之比為 \(2:3\)。將該截頭錐固定在一個底半徑 \(10\) cm 的實心直立圓柱頂部而成的立體 \(P\)。

(b) 若圓柱的高為 \(4\) cm，立體 \(P\) 的總表面積是否大於 \(1000\text{ cm}^2\)？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
questions.solution: (a) The height of the smaller cone removed is \[\frac23(8)=\boxed{\frac{16}{3}\text{ cm}}.\] Let its base radius be \(r\) cm. By similarity, \[\frac{16/3}{16/3+8}=\frac{r}{10}.\] Thus \[\frac{16/3}{40/3}=\frac{r}{10},\] so \[r=\boxed{4\text{ cm}}.\] (b) The height of the original cone is \[\frac{16}{3}+8=\frac{40}{3}.\] Its slant height is \[\sqrt{10^2+\left(\frac{40}{3}\right)^2}=\frac{50}{3}.\] The curved surface area of the original cone is \[\pi(10)\left(\frac{50}{3}\right)=\frac{500\pi}{3}.\] The curved surface area of the smaller cone removed is \[\left(\frac{4}{10}\right)^2\left(\frac{500\pi}{3}\right)=\frac{80\pi}{3}.\] Hence the curved surface area of the frustum is \[\frac{500\pi}{3}-\frac{80\pi}{3}=140\pi.\] The exposed top circular face has area \[\pi(4)^2=16\pi.\] The curved surface area of the cylinder is \[2\pi(10)(4)=80\pi,\] and its bottom base has area \[100\pi.\] Therefore, the total surface area of solid \(P\) is \[16\pi+140\pi+80\pi+100\pi=336\pi\approx1055.6.\] Since \(336\pi>1000\), the total surface area is larger than \(1000\text{ cm}^2\).

questions.stem:
13. A large right circular cone \(X\) is divided into a right circular cone \(Y\) of height 6 cm and a frustum \(Z\) of height 3 cm by a plane which is parallel to its base. The volume of the frustum is \(114 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\).

(a) Find the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Is the total surface area of \(X\) smaller than \(0.04 \mathrm{~m}^{2}\). Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個大直立圓錐 \(X\) 被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個高 \(6\) cm 的圓錐 \(Y\) 及一個高 \(3\) cm 的截頭錐 \(Z\)。截頭錐的體積為 \(114\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) \(X\) 的總表面積是否小於 \(0.04\text{ m}^2\)？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
questions.solution:
(a) The heights of Y and X are 6 cm and 9 cm, so \(V_Y/V_X=(6/9)^3=8/27\). Hence \(V_Z/V_X=19/27\), giving \(V_X=114\pi(27/19)=162\pi\text{ cm}^3\).
(b) From \(\pi r^2(9)/3=162\pi\), \(r^2=54\). The slant height is \(\sqrt{54+81}=\sqrt{135}\) cm. Total surface area is \(\pi(54+\sqrt{54}\sqrt{135})=\pi(54+27\sqrt{10})\approx437.88\text{ cm}^2\). This is approximately 0.0438 m², greater than 0.04 m². Therefore it is not smaller.

questions.stem:
12. A vessel in the form of a frustum is made by cutting off the lower part of an inverted right circular cone of base radius 36 cm and height 48 cm. The height of the vessel is 30 cm. The vessel is placed on a horizontal table. Some water is now poured into the vessel. Nathan finds that the depth of water in the vessel is 24 cm.

(a) Find the area of the wet curved surface of the vessel in terms of \(\pi\). (4 marks)

(b) Nathan claims that when \(0.2\text{ m}^3\) of water is poured into the vessel, it will overflow. Do you agree? Explain your answer. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個截頭錐形容器，由切除一個底半徑 \(36\) cm、高 \(48\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐的下部造成。容器高 \(30\) cm，放在水平桌上。現將一些水倒入容器，Nathan 發現水深為 \(24\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求容器的濕曲面面積。（4 分）

(b) Nathan 聲稱若將 \(0.2\text{ m}^3\) 水倒入容器，水會溢出。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 12. (a) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{36^2+48^2}=60\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of the original cone is \(\pi(36)(60)=2160\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) The height of the removed small cone is \(48-30=18\text{ cm}.\) Since the depth of water is 24 cm, the height of the cone up to the water surface is \(18+24=42\text{ cm}.\) By similarity, the required wet curved surface area is \(2160\pi\left[\left(\frac{42}{48}\right)^2-\left(\frac{18}{48}\right)^2\right].\) \[=2160\pi\left[\left(\frac78\right)^2-\left(\frac38\right)^2\right] =2160\pi\left(\frac{40}{64}\right) =1350\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] ------------------(4) (b) The volume of the original cone is \[\frac13\pi(36)^2(48)=20736\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] The empty space above the current water surface corresponds to the part of the original cone above height 42 cm from the vertex. Its volume is \(20736\pi-20736\pi\left(\frac{42}{48}\right)^3.\) \[=20736\pi\left[1-\left(\frac78\right)^3\right] \approx 21502.6\text{ cm}^3 =0.0215\text{ m}^3.\] Since \(0.2>0.0215,\) the vessel will overflow. Therefore, Nathan's claim is correct. ------------------(3)
questions.solutionZh:
（a）原錐斜高 60，曲面 2160π。被切小錐高 18，水面高 42。濕曲面：
\[
2160\pi\left[\left(\frac{42}{48}\right)^2-\left(\frac{18}{48}\right)^2\right]=1350\pi\text{ cm}^2.
\]
（b）原錐體積 20736π。空位 = 20736π[1−(7/8)³] ≈ 0.0215 m³。0.2 > 0.0215，會溢出，Nathan 正確。

questions.stem:
12. A right circular cylindrical container of base radius 10 cm and height 64 cm is fully filled with water. An inverted right circular conical vessel of base radius 25 cm and height 60 cm is held vertically on a horizontal stand. The water in the container is now poured into the vessel.

(a) Find the depth of the water in the vessel.

(b) Now, \(\frac{37}{64}\) of the volume of water in the vessel is removed. A student claims that the final area of the wet curved surface of the vessel is less than half of the original area of the wet curved surface of the vessel. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個底半徑 \(10\) cm、高 \(64\) cm 的直立圓柱形容器完全注滿水。一個底半徑 \(25\) cm、高 \(60\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器垂直放置在水平架上。現將圓柱中的水倒入圓錐容器。

(a) 求圓錐容器中水的深度。

(b) 現移除圓錐容器中 \(\frac{37}{64}\) 的水。某學生聲稱圓錐容器最終的濕曲面面積少於原本濕曲面面積的一半。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Volume displaced = object volume. Compare calculated value with claim.
questions.hintZh:
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 12. (a) The volume of the water \[=\pi(10)^{2}(64)\] \[=6400 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the water surface and \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the depth of the water in the vessel. \[\frac{r}{25}=\frac{h}{60}\] \[r=\frac{5 h}{12}\] \[\therefore \frac{1}{3} \pi\left(\frac{5 h}{12}\right)^{2} h=6400 \pi\] \[h^{3}=110592\] \[ h=48 \] The depth of the water is 48 cm . (b) \[\frac{\text { Final volume of the water }}{\text { Original volume of the water }}\] \[=1-\frac{37}{64}\] \[=\frac{27}{64}\] \[\frac{\text { Final wet surface area }}{\text { Original wet surface area }}\] \[=\left(\sqrt[3]{\frac{27}{64}}\right)^{2}\] \[=\frac{9}{16}>\frac{1}{2}\] ∴ Disagree f.t. (7 marks)

questions.stem:
14. \(X\) is a solid frustum which is made by cutting off the upper part of a solid right circular cone of base radius \(15\text{ cm}\) and height \(36\text{ cm}\). It is given that the curved surface area of \(X\) is \(325\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(a) Find the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) \(Y\) is a vessel in the shape of a frustum which is made by cutting off the lower part of an inverted right circular cone. The upper base radius of \(Y\) is \(24\text{ cm}\) and the lower base radius of \(Y\) is \(16\text{ cm}\). \(Y\) is similar to \(X\) in shape. \(Y\) contains \(3500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) of water. \(X\) is put into \(Y\) and \(X\) is totally immersed in the water without overflowing. Someone claims that the depth of water in \(Y\) exceeds \(15\text{ cm}\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. \(X\) 為一個實心截頭錐，由切除一個底半徑 \(15\) cm、高 \(36\) cm 的實心直立圓錐的上部造成。已知 \(X\) 的曲面面積為 \(325\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) \(Y\) 為一個截頭錐形容器，由切除一個倒置直立圓錐的下部造成。\(Y\) 的上底半徑為 \(24\) cm，下底半徑為 \(16\) cm。\(Y\) 與 \(X\) 形狀相似。\(Y\) 盛有 \(3500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 水。將 \(X\) 放入 \(Y\) 中，\(X\) 完全浸入水中且沒有溢出。某人聲稱 \(Y\) 中水深超過 \(15\) cm。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
排水 = 物體體積。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 14. (a) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{15^2+36^2}=39.\] Its curved surface area is \[\pi(15)(39)=585\pi.\] Hence the curved surface area of the cone cut off is \[585\pi-325\pi=260\pi.\] Let the radius of the cone cut off be \(r\). Since curved surface areas of similar cones are in the square of the linear ratio, \[\left(\frac{r}{15}\right)^2=\frac{260}{585}=\frac49.\] Thus \[ r=10. \] The height of the cone cut off is \[\frac{10}{15}\times 36=24.\] Therefore, the volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(15)^2(36)-\frac13\pi(10)^2(24) =2700\pi-800\pi =1900\pi.\] (b) Since \(Y\) is similar to \(X\), the linear scale factor from \(X\) to \(Y\) is \[\frac{24}{15}=1.6.\] The smaller cone cut off from the larger inverted cone for \(Y\) has radius \(16\text{ cm}\), corresponding to radius \(10\text{ cm}\) in \(X\). Its height is \[24(1.6)=38.4\text{ cm}.\] The volume of this smaller cone is \[\frac13\pi(16)^2(38.4)=3276.8\pi.\] After \(X\) is immersed, the total volume below the water surface, measured from the apex of the smaller cone, is \[3276.8\pi+3500\pi+1900\pi=8676.8\pi.\] Let the water depth in \(Y\) be \(x\text{ cm}\). Then \[\left(\frac{x+38.4}{38.4}\right)^3=\frac{8676.8}{3276.8}.\] Hence \[x=38.4\sqrt[3]{\frac{8676.8}{3276.8}}-38.4 \approx 14.725.\] Since \[14.725<15,\] the claim is not correct.

(a) Find the wet surface area after taking the spheres out. (b) The water is poured into an inverted cone of base radius \(27\) cm and height \(36\) cm. Is the conical wet surface area greater? (8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個半徑 \(12\) cm 的圓柱形容器盛水。將兩個半徑 \(6\) cm 的金屬球浸入水中，水深為 \(22\) cm。

(a) 取出金屬球後，求濕表面積。

(b) 將水倒入一個底半徑 \(27\) cm、高 \(36\) cm 的倒置圓錐。圓錐的濕表面積是否較大？（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution: 13. Let the new depth in the cylinder be \(h\). Then \(\pi(12)^2(22)-\pi(12)^2h=2\cdot\frac43\pi(6)^3\), so \(h=18\). The wet surface area is \(2\pi(12)(18)+\pi(12)^2=576\pi\). In the cone, \(r/H=27/36=3/4\), and the water volume is \(2592\pi\), giving \(H=24,r=18\). The conical wet curved surface is \(\pi(18)(30)=540\pi<576\pi\). The claim is not correct.

14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。已知 \(X\) 及 \(Y\) 的高分別為 \(45\) cm 及 \(30\) cm，\(Y\) 的體積為 \(31360\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。

(a) 求 \(X\) 的底半徑。（3 分）

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的總表面積。（2 分）

(c) 一個實心金屬直立圓柱 \(Z\) 的底半徑為 \(32\) cm。已知 \(Y\) 的總表面積等於 \(Z\) 的總表面積。以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Z\) 的體積。（3 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.

圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
questions.solution:
(a) Let the radii of X and the whole cone be r and R. Similarity gives \(R=5r/3\). Thus \(31360=\frac{30}{3}(R^2+Rr+r^2)=\frac{490}{9}r^2\), so \(r=24\) cm and \(R=40\) cm.

(b) Frustum slant height \(s=\sqrt{30^2+16^2}=34\) cm. Total area \(\pi(40+24)(34)+\pi(40^2+24^2)=4352\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(c) For the cylinder, \(2\pi(32)h+2\pi(32)^2=4352\pi\), so \(h=36\) cm and \(V=\pi(32)^2(36)=36864\pi\text{ cm}^3\).

questions.stem:
14. The base radius and the height of a right circular cone \(W\) are 80 cm and 192 cm respectively. The circular cone is then divided into a right circular cone \(X\), a small frustum \(Y\) and a large frustum \(Z\) by two planes parallel to its base. It is given that the base radius of the right circular cone \(X\) is 5 cm .

(a) Find the height and the volume of the right circular cone \(X\).

(b) (i) Find the curved surface area of the right circular cone \(X\).
(ii) Given that frustum \(Y\) is similar to frustum \(Z\), find the total surface area of the frustum \(Y\).
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個直立圓錐 \(W\) 的底半徑及高分別為 \(80\) cm 及 \(192\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\)、一個小截頭錐 \(Y\) 及一個大截頭錐 \(Z\)。已知圓錐 \(X\) 的底半徑為 \(5\) cm。

(a) 求圓錐 \(X\) 的高及體積。

(b) 

(i) 求圓錐 \(X\) 的曲面面積。
(ii) 已知截頭錐 \(Y\) 與截頭錐 \(Z\) 相似，求截頭錐 \(Y\) 的總表面積。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 14. (a) Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of the right circular cone \(X\). \[\frac{h}{192} =\frac{5}{80} \\ h =12\] The height of the right circular cone \(X\) is 12 cm . The volume of right circular cone \(X=\frac{1}{3} \pi(5)^{2}(12)\) \(=100 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\left(314 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\right)\) Alternative Solutions: The volume of right circular cone \(W=\frac{1}{3} \pi(80)^{2}(192)\) \(=409600 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) Let \(V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volume of the right circular cone \(X\). \(\frac{V}{409600 \pi} =\left(\frac{5}{80}\right)^{3} \\ V =100 \pi\) The volume of right circular cone \(X\) is \(100 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\left(314 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\right)\) Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of the right circular cone \(X\). \(\frac{1}{3} \pi(5)^{2} h =100 \\ h =12\) The height of the right circular cone \(X\) is 12 cm . (b) (i) The slant height of circular cone \(X=\sqrt{12^{2}+5^{2}} \mathrm{~cm}=13 \mathrm{~cm}\) \[\text { The curved surface area } =\pi(5)(13) \mathrm{cm}^{2} \\ =65 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\left(204 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\right)\] (ii) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the lower base radius of frustum \(Y\). Then the upper base radius of frustum \(Z\) is also \(r \mathrm{~cm}\). \(\frac{5}{r}=\frac{r}{80}\) \(r=20\) or \(r=-20\) (reject) Let \(A \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) the curved surface area of the right of frustum \(Y\). \( \frac{65 \pi}{65 \pi+A}=\left(\frac{5}{20}\right)^{2} \\ \qquad A=975 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ \therefore \text { The total surface area of the frustum } Y =\left[\pi(5)^{2}+\pi(20)^{2}+975 \pi\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2} \\ =1400 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\left(4400 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\right)\) (8 marks)

questions.stem:
13. The baige radius and the height of an inverted right circular conical vessel are 18 cm and 24 cm respectively. Water is poured into the vessel until the depth of water is 8 cm .

(a) Find the volume of water in terms of \( \pi \).
(2 marks)
(@) A metal sphere of radius 3 cm is put into the vessel. The sphere is totally immersed in the water.

(i) Find the depth of water.
(ii) Someone claims that the wet surface area of the vessel is increased by more than \( 24 \% \) after the sphere is put into the vessel. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個倒置直立圓錐形容器的底半徑及高分別為 \(18\) cm 及 \(24\) cm。將水倒入容器至水深 \(8\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求水的體積。（2 分）

(b) 將一個半徑 \(3\) cm 的金屬球放入容器，球完全浸入水中。

(i) 求水深。
(ii) 某人聲稱放入球後，容器的濕表面積增加超過 \(24\%\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（5 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution:
(a) Similarity gives the water radius \(r=3h/4\), so \(V(h)=3\pi h^3/16\). At depth 8 cm, \(V=96\pi\text{ cm}^3\).

(b)(i) The immersed sphere displaces \(\frac43\pi(3)^3=36\pi\text{ cm}^3\). Thus \(3\pi h^3/16=132\pi\), giving \(h=\sqrt[3]{704}\approx8.896\text{ cm}\).

(ii) The cone slant length up to depth h is \(5h/4\), so its wet area is \(15\pi h^2/16\). The percentage increase is \(100[(704^{1/3}/8)^2-1]\approx23.65\%\), below 24%. Disagree.

questions.stem:
13. There are two similar inverted right circular conical vessels. For the larger vessel, the base radius and the slant height are \(45\) cm and \(51\) cm respectively. It is given that the ratio of the curved surface area of the larger vessel to that of the smaller vessel is \(9:4\).

(a) Express the capacity of the smaller vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) \(15500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) of water is now poured into the larger vessel. Then, four solid metal spheres of radius \(6\) cm are put into the vessel and are totally immersed. The water that overflows is then collected by the smaller vessel.

(i) Express the volume of water overflowed in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) Someone claims that the area of the wet curved surface of the smaller vessel does not exceed \(670\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 有兩個相似的倒置直立圓錐形容器。較大容器的底半徑及斜高分別為 \(45\) cm 及 \(51\) cm。已知較大容器與較小容器的曲面面積比為 \(9:4\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示較小容器的容量。

(b) 現將 \(15500\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 水倒入較大容器，再放入四個半徑 \(6\) cm 的實心金屬球，球完全浸入水中。溢出的水由較小容器盛載。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求溢出的水體積。
(ii) 某人聲稱較小容器的濕曲面面積不超過 \(670\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The height of the larger vessel is \[\sqrt{51^2-45^2}=24\text{ cm}.\] The capacity of the larger vessel is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)^2(24).\] Since the ratio of curved surface areas is \(9:4\), the linear scale factor from the larger vessel to the smaller vessel is \(3:2\), and the volume scale factor is \(27:8\). Therefore, the capacity of the smaller vessel is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)^2(24)\left(\frac{4}{9}\right)^{3/2}=4800\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b)(i) The volume overflowed is \(15500\pi+4\left(\frac{4}{3}\pi(6)^3\right)-\frac{1}{3}\pi(45)^2(24).\) Thus the volume overflowed is \(452\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (ii) The area of the wet curved surface in the smaller vessel is \[\pi(45)(51)\left(\frac{4}{9}\right) \left(\frac{452\pi}{4800\pi}\right)^{2/3}.\] This is approximately \[663.2564917\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[663.2564917<670,\] the claim is agreed.

questions.stem:
11. An inverted right circular conical vessel of base radius 12 cm and height 9 cm contains water to a depth of 6 cm . All the water in the vessel is now poured into an empty right circular cylindrical cup without overflow and the depth of water is 12.8 cm .

(a) Find the base radius of the cylindrical cup. Leave your answer in surd form.

(b) A solid metal sphere with surface area equal to one-fifth of the curved surface area of the vessel is then put into the cylindrical cup. The metal sphere is completely immersed in water and no water spills out of the cup. Find the rise in water level in the cylindrical cup.
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個底半徑 \(12\) cm、高 \(9\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器盛水至深度 \(6\) cm。現將全部水倒入一個空直立圓柱杯且沒有溢出，水深為 \(12.8\) cm。

(a) 求圓柱杯的底半徑，答案以根式表示。

(b) 再將一個實心金屬球放入圓柱杯，其表面積等於容器曲面面積的五分之一。球完全浸入水中且沒有水溢出。求圓柱杯水位的上升高度。
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution:
11.(a) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the water surface in the vessel. \(\frac{r}{12} =\frac{6}{9} \\ r =8\) 
 Let \(R \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of the cylindrical cup. \(\pi R^{2} \times 12.8 =\frac{1}{3} \pi\left(8^{2}\right)(6) \\ R =\sqrt{10}\) 
 ∴ The base radius of the cylindrical cup is \(\sqrt{10} \mathrm{~cm}\). (b) Slant height of the curved surface in the vessel \(=\sqrt{12^{2}+9^{2}}=15 \mathrm{~cm}\) 
 Let \(s \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the sphere. \[\pi \times 12 \times 15=5 \times 4 \pi s^{2} \\ s=3 \\ \text { Rise in water level } =\frac{4}{3} \pi(3)^{3} \div \pi(\sqrt{10})^{2} \\ =3.6 \mathrm{~cm}\]

questions.stem:
11. An inverted right circular conical vessel contains some water. The vessel is held vertically. The depth of water in the vessel is \(12\text{ cm}\). \(950\pi\text{ cm}^3\) of water is poured into the vessel. It is given that the depth of water in the vessel becomes \(18\text{ cm}\).

(a) Find the final volume of water in the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Someone claims that the area of the wet curved surface of the vessel is at most \(1100\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個倒置直立圓錐形容器盛有一些水，容器垂直放置。水深為 \(12\) cm。再倒入 \(950\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 水後，水深變為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求容器中最終的水體積。

(b) 某人聲稱容器的濕曲面面積最多為 \(1100\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（6 分）
questions.hint: Volume displaced = object volume. Compare calculated value with claim.
questions.hintZh:
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 11. (a) Let the final volume of water be \(x\text{ cm}^3\). Since the depths before and after pouring are \(12\text{ cm}\) and \(18\text{ cm}\), the volume ratio is \[12^3:18^3=8:27.\] Thus \[\frac{x-950\pi}{x}=\frac{8}{27}.\] Hence \[27(x-950\pi)=8x.\] So \[19x=25650\pi,\] and \[x=1350\pi.\] Therefore, the final volume is \[1350\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) Let \(r\text{ cm}\) be the radius of the water surface after pouring. Then \[\frac13\pi r^2(18)=1350\pi.\] Hence \[ r=15. \] The slant height of the wet cone is \[\sqrt{15^2+18^2}=\sqrt{549}.\] The wet curved surface area is \[\pi(15)\sqrt{549}\approx 1104.148\text{ cm}^2.\] Since this is greater than \(1100\text{ cm}^2\), I disagree with the claim.

questions.stem:
11. A bowl in the shape of a hemisphere has a radius of \(r \mathrm{~cm}\). An inverted right circular conical container with a base radius of 36 cm and a height of 48 cm is held vertically. The outer curved surface area of the container is 7.5 times that of the bowl.

(a) Find \(r\).

(b) Initially, there is some water in a container with a depth of \(h \mathrm{~cm}\). A hemispherical bowl is used to pour water into the container. After pouring \(5 \frac{1}{4}\) bowls of water into the container without overflowing, the depth of the water increases to \(4 h \mathrm{~cm}\). Find \(h\).
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個半球形碗的半徑為 \(r\) cm。一個底半徑 \(36\) cm、高 \(48\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器垂直放置。容器的外曲面面積為碗的 \(7.5\) 倍。

(a) 求 \(r\)。

(b) 最初容器中有一些水，深度為 \(h\) cm。用半球碗將水倒入容器，倒了 \(5\frac{1}{4}\) 碗水後沒有溢出，水深增加至 \(4h\) cm。求 \(h\)。
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution:
(a) The cone slant height is 60 cm, so \(7.5(2\pi r^2)=\pi(36)(60)\), giving r = 12 cm.
(b) The added volume is \(\frac{21}{4}\frac23\pi(12)^3=6048\pi\text{ cm}^3\). If the initial water volume is V, quadrupling its depth multiplies its volume by 64. Thus \(63V=6048\pi\) and \(V=96\pi\). The cone capacity is \(\pi(36)^2(48)/3=20736\pi\text{ cm}^3\). Therefore \((h/48)^3=96/20736=1/216\), giving h = 8 cm.

14. An inverted right circular cone is of base radius 120 cm and height 64 cm . A container in the form of a frustum is made by cutting off the lower part of the inverted right circular cone. The height of the container is 48 cm . The container is placed with its smaller circular face on a horizontal table. Some water is now poured into the container. It is known that the area of the wet curved surface of the container is \(5355 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\).

(a) Find the depth of water in the container.

(b) Someone claims that the volume of water in the container is less than \(0.2 \mathrm{~m}^{3}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個底半徑 \(120\) cm、高 \(64\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐，切除其下部造成一個截頭錐形容器，容器高 \(48\) cm。將容器的較小圓面放在水平桌上，倒入一些水。已知容器的濕曲面面積為 \(5355\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求容器中水深。

(b) 某人聲稱容器中水的體積少於 \(0.2\text{ m}^3\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 14. An inverted right circular cone is of base radius 120 cm and height 64 cm . A container in the form of a frustum is made by cutting off the lower part of the inverted right circular cone. The height of the container is 48 cm . The container is placed with its smaller circular face on a horizontal table. Some water is now poured into the container. It is known that the area of the wet curved surface of the container is \(5355 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). (a) Find the depth of water in the container. (b) Someone claims that the volume of water in the container is less than \(0.2 \mathrm{~m}^{3}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (a) Curved surface area of the circular cone \[=\pi(120) \sqrt{120^{2}+64^{2}}\] \[=\pi(120)(136)\] \[=16320 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] Height of the lower part \(=64-48=16 \mathrm{~cm}\) Curved surface area of the lower part \[=\left(\frac{16}{64}\right)^{2} \times 16320 \pi\] \[=1020 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the depth of water. \[\left(\frac{h+16}{16}\right)^{2} =\frac{1020 \pi+5355 \pi}{1020 \pi} \\ (h+16)^{2} =1600 \\ h+16 =40 \text { or }-40 \text { (rejected) } \\ h =24\] ∴ The depth of water is 24 cm . (b) Volume of the circular cone \(=\frac{1}{3} \pi(120)^{2}(64)\) Volume of the lower part \(=\left(\frac{16}{64}\right)^{3} \times 307200 \pi\) Let \(V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volume of water. \(\frac{V+4800 \pi}{4800 \pi} =\left(\frac{24+16}{16}\right)^{3} \\ V+4800 \pi =75000 \pi \\ V =70200 \pi\) Volume of water \(=70200 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) \(=0.220539804 \mathrm{~m}^{3}\) \(>0.2 \mathrm{~m}^{3}\) ∴ The claim is disagreed. \(=307200 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) \(=4800 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 1 M for \(\pi r \ell\) 1 M for any correct ratio

questions.stemZh:
12. 兩個半球形容器垂直放在水平面上，均完全注滿水。較小半球與較大半圓的濕表面積比為 \(16:25\)，較小半球半徑為 \(10\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求兩個半球容器中總水體積。

(b) 另一個容器 \(X\) 為截頭錐，由切除一個直立圓錐的上部造成。\(X\) 的上底半徑及下底半徑分別為 \(10\) cm 及 \(15\) cm。將 \(X\) 放在水平地面，把兩個半球容器中的水倒入 \(X\)，水剛好注滿 \(X\)。求 \(X\) 的高。

questions.solution: 12. There are two hemispherical vessels held vertically on a horizontal surface. The vessels are fully filled with water. The ratio of the wet surface area of the smaller hemispherical vessel to the wet surface area of the larger hemispherical vessel is \(16: 25\). The radius of the smaller hemispherical vessel is 10 cm . (a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the total volume of water in the two hemispherical vessels. ( 3 marks) (b) Another vessel \(X\) is in the form of a frustum which is made by cutting off the upper part of a right circular cone. The radii of the upper base and the lower base of \(X\) are 10 cm and 15 cm respectively. \(X\) is placed on a horizontal ground. The water in the two hemispherical vessels is poured into \(X\). If the water can just fill up \(X\), find the height of \(X\). 12. (a) Let \(x \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the larger hemispherical vessel. \[\frac{16}{25}=\left(\frac{10}{x}\right)^{2} 1 \mathrm{M}\] Wet surface area of the smaller vessel \(=2 \pi(10)^{2} \mathrm{~cm}^{2}=200 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) Wet surface area of the larger vessel \[=\frac{25}{16} \times 200 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2} 1 \mathrm{M}\] \[=312.5 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] Let \(x \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the larger vessel. \[2 \pi x^{2}=312.5 \pi\] \[ x=12.5 \] \[\text { Total volume of water } =\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{4}{3} \pi\left(12.5^{3}+10^{3}\right) \mathrm{cm}^{3} 1 \mathrm{M} \text { for the volume of one hemisphere } \\ =\underline{\underline{1968.75 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}}} 1 \mathrm{~A}\] (b) Let \(H \mathrm{~cm}\) and \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the heights of the upper part of the cone being cut off and the frustum respectively. \[\frac{H}{H+h}=\frac{10}{15} 1 \mathrm{M} \\ H=2 h \\ \frac{1}{3} \pi(15)^{2}(H+h)-\frac{1}{3} \pi(10)^{2} H=1968.75 \pi 1 \mathrm{M} \text { for the volume of frustum } \\ 225(3 h)-100(2 h)=5906.25 \\ 475 h=5906.25 \\ h \approx 12.43421053 \] ∴ The height of the frustum is \(\underline{12.4 \mathrm{~cm}}\) (corr. to 3 sig. fig.).

questions.stem:
13. A closed vessel with some water, which is in the form of an inverted right circular cone. The base radius and the height of the cone are 18 cm and 24 cm respectively. Kelly finds that the depth of water in the vessel is 8 cm.

(a) (i) Find the radius of the water surface.
(ii) Find the area of the wet curved surface of the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Kelly turns the vessel upside down.

(i) Find the new depth of water, correct to 1 decimal place.
(ii) Kelly claims that the wet curved surface of the vessel has increased. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
一個封閉的倒置直立圓錐形容器內有一些水。圓錐底半徑為 18 cm、高為 24 cm，初始水深為 8 cm。
(a)(i) 求水面半徑。
(ii) 以圓周率表示容器的濕曲面面積。
(b) Kelly 把容器上下倒轉。
(i) 求新水深，準確至一位小數。
(ii) Kelly 聲稱容器的濕曲面面積增加了。你是否同意？解釋答案。（7 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. (a)(i) Let \(r\) cm be the radius of the water surface. By similar triangles, \[\frac{r}{18}=\frac{8}{24}.\] Thus \(r=6.\) The radius of the water surface is \(6\) cm. (a)(ii) The slant height of the wet cone is \(\sqrt{6^2+8^2}=10.\) The wet curved surface area is \(\pi(6)(10)=60\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (b)(i) The volume of water is \(\frac13\pi(6)^2(8)=96\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) The capacity of the vessel is \(\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)=2592\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) The volume of the empty space is \(2592\pi-96\pi=2496\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) Let \(H\) cm be the height of the empty cone after turning the vessel upside down. By similarity, \(\frac{\frac13\pi\left(\frac{18}{24}H\right)^2H}{2592\pi}=\frac{2496}{2592}.\) Equivalently, \(\left(\frac{H}{24}\right)^3=\frac{26}{27}.\) Thus \(H\approx 23.69996855.\) The new depth of water is \(24-23.69996855\approx0.3\text{ cm}.\) (b)(ii) Let \(R\) cm be the radius of the empty cone after turning the vessel upside down. Then \(\frac{R}{18}=\frac{H}{24},\) so \(R\approx17.77497641.\) The slant height of the empty cone is \(\sqrt{H^2+R^2}\approx29.62496069.\) The curved surface area of the whole cone is \(\pi(18)(30)=540\pi.\) The dry curved surface area is approximately \(\pi(17.77497641)(29.62496069)\approx526.6\pi.\) Therefore the new wet curved surface area is approximately \(540\pi-526.6\pi=13.4\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) Since \(13.4\pi<60\pi,\) the wet curved surface has not increased. I do not agree with Kelly's claim. (7 marks)

questions.stem:
12. The capacity of a hemispherical container is \(486 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). The ratio of the base radius to the height of an inverted right circular conical vessel is \(3: 2\). The base radius of the vessel is 3 times the radius of the container.

(a) Find the capacity of the vessel in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) Both the container and the vessel are held vertically. The container is fully filled with water. The water in the container is now poured into the vessel.

(i) Find the depth of water in the vessel.
(ii) A student then puts \(n\) solid metal spheres of radius 2 cm into the vessel and the spheres are totally immersed in the water. Find the least value of \(n\) such that the depth of water in the vessel is increased by at least 7 cm . (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個半球形容器的容量為 \(486\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。一個倒置直立圓錐形容器的底半徑與高之比為 \(3:2\)，其底半徑為容器半徑的 \(3\) 倍。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求圓錐容器的容量。（3 分）

(b) 兩個容器均垂直放置，半球容器完全注滿水，現將水倒入圓錐容器。

(i) 求圓錐容器中水深。
(ii) 某學生再將 \(n\) 個半徑 \(2\) cm 的實心金屬球放入圓錐容器，球完全浸入水中。求 \(n\) 的最小值，使圓錐容器中水深增加至少 \(7\) cm。（4 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution: (a) \(\frac23\pi r^3=486\pi\) gives \(r=9\) cm. The cone has radius 27 cm and height 18 cm, so its capacity is \(4374\pi\text{ cm}^3\). (b)(i) Its volume below depth h is \(3\pi h^3/4\). Thus \(h_0=\sqrt[3]{648}\approx8.6535\) cm. (ii) For an increase of at least 7 cm, \(486+\frac{32n}{3}\geq\frac34(h_0+7)^3\), giving \(n\geq224.1287\). The least integer is 225.

questions.stem:
14. The base of a solid right pyramid is a square of side \(20\) cm. The height of the pyramid is \(18\) cm.

(a) The pyramid is inverted and divided into a frustum and a smaller pyramid by a plane which is parallel to its base. It is given that the height of the frustum is \(9\) cm. Find the volume of the frustum.

(b) A container consists of two parts with a common base. The upper part is the frustum described in (a) and the lower part is a cuboid of height \(8\) cm. Water is poured into the container to a depth of \(11\) cm. Find the volume of the water in the container.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心直立錐體的底面為邊長 \(20\) cm 的正方形，高為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 將錐體倒置，被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐及一個小錐體。已知截頭錐高 \(9\) cm，求截頭錐的體積。

(b) 一個容器由兩部分組成，共享同一底面。上部為 

(a) 所述的截頭錐，下部為高 \(8\) cm 的長方體。將水倒入容器至深度 \(11\) cm，求容器中水的體積。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Volume displaced = object volume. Compare calculated value with claim.
questions.hintZh:
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of the original pyramid is \[\frac13(20)^2(18)=2400\text{ cm}^3.\] The height of the smaller pyramid is \[18-9=9\text{ cm}.\] The ratio of the heights of the smaller pyramid and the original pyramid is \[9:18=1:2.\] Therefore, the ratio of their volumes is \[1^3:2^3=1:8.\] The volume of the smaller pyramid is \[\frac{1}{8}(2400)=300\text{ cm}^3.\] Hence the volume of the frustum is \[2400-300=2100\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The lower cuboid has square base of side \(10\) cm, so the volume of water in the cuboid is \[10^2(8)=800\text{ cm}^3.\] Since the water depth is \(11\) cm, the height of water in the frustum is \[11-8=3\text{ cm}.\] The corresponding similar pyramids have heights \(12\) cm and \(9\) cm, so their height ratio is \[12:9=4:3.\] The volume of the pyramid of height \(9\) cm is \(300\text{ cm}^3\). Thus the volume of the pyramid of height \(12\) cm is \[300\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)^3=\frac{6400}{9}\text{ cm}^3.\] Therefore, the volume of water in the frustum part is \[\frac{6400}{9}-300=\frac{3700}{9}\text{ cm}^3.\] The total volume of water is \[800+\frac{3700}{9} =\frac{10900}{9} \approx 1210\text{ cm}^3\] correct to 3 significant figures.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）原角錐 = 2400。小角錐高 9，比 1:2，體積比 1:8，小角錐 = 300，截頭錐 = 2100 cm³。
（b）下方長方體底邊 10，水 = 800，水深 8，總深 11 cm。

questions.stem:
11. An inverted right circular conical vessel is held vertically and fully filled with soft drink. The depth of soft drink in the vessel is 18 cm . Patrick drinks \(364 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) of soft drink and now he finds that the depth of soft drink in the vessel is 15 cm .

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the volume of remaining soft drink in the vessel.
( 3 marks )

(b) Patrick then pours the remaining soft drink into a right cylindrical vessel without overflowing. The base radius of the cylindrical vessel is 5 cm . Patrick claims that the total area of the wet surface of the cylindrical vessel is greater than \(700 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
11. 一個倒置直立圓錐形容器垂直放置，完全注滿汽水。汽水深度為 \(18\) cm。Patrick 喝了 \(364\pi\text{ cm}^3\) 汽水後，發現汽水深度變為 \(15\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求容器中餘下的汽水體積。（3 分）

(b) Patrick 將餘下的汽水倒入一個直立圓柱形容器且沒有溢出，圓柱底半徑為 \(5\) cm。Patrick 聲稱圓柱容器的濕表面總面積大於 \(700\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Calculate the values, then compare with the claim. State agree/disagree clearly.
questions.hintZh: 先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 11. (a) Let \(V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volume of remaining soft drink. By the property of similar solids, we have \[\frac{V+364 \pi}{V}=\left(\frac{18}{15}\right)^{3} \\ 125 V+45500 \pi=216 V \\ V=500 \pi\] \(\therefore \) Volume of remaining soft drink \(=500 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). (b) Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the depth of soft drink in the cylindrical vessel. \[500 \pi=\pi(5)^{2} h \\ h=20\] Total area of the wet surface \(=\left(\pi(5)^{2}+2 \pi(5)(20)\right) \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(=225 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) \(\approx 706.858 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) \(> 700 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) The claim is agreed.
