13. The painting cost (in $) of a solid is a sum of two parts, one part is constant and the other part varies as the surface area (in \(\mathrm{cm}^{2}\) ) of the solid. The painting cost for a solid with surface area \(200 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) is \(\$ 300\) while the painting cost for a solid with surface area \(250 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) is \(\$ 360\). Suppose the surface area and the volume of solid \(A\) are \(720 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) and \(1000 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) respectively.

(a) Find the painting cost of solid \(A\).

(b) Solids \(A\) and \(B\) are similar solids. The painting cost of solid \(A\) is at 40% higher than that of solid \(B\). Mary claims that the volume of solid \(B\) is at least \(580 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個立體的油漆成本（以 $ 計）由兩部分組成：一部分為常數，另一部分隨立體表面積（以 cm\(^2\) 計）正變。表面積 \(200\text{ cm}^2\) 的立體油漆成本為 $300，表面積 \(250\text{ cm}^2\) 的立體油漆成本為 $360。已知立體 \(A\) 的表面積及體積分別為 \(720\text{ cm}^2\) 及 \(1000\text{ cm}^3\)。

(a) 求立體 \(A\) 的油漆成本。

(b) 立體 \(A\) 與 \(B\) 為相似立體，\(A\) 的油漆成本比 \(B\) 高 \(40\%\)。Mary 聲稱立體 \(B\) 的體積最少為 \(580\text{ cm}^3\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。

相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. The painting cost (in $) of a solid is a sum of two parts, one part is constant and the other part varies as the surface area (in \(\mathrm{cm}^{2}\) ) of the solid. The painting cost for a solid with surface area \(200 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) is \(\$ 300\) while the painting cost for a solid with surface area \(250 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) is \(\$ 360\). Suppose the surface area of solid \(A\) is \(720 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) and the volume of Solid \(A\) is \(1000 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). (a) Find the painting cost of \(\operatorname{solid} A\). (b) Solids \(A\) and \(B\) are similar solids. The painting cost of solid \(A\) is at \(40 \%\) higher than that of solid \(B\). Mary claims that the volume of solid \(B\) is at least \(580 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (4 marks) (a) Let \(\$ C\) be the painting cost of a solid and \(S \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) be its surface area. Let \(C=k_{1}+k_{2} S\), where \(k_{1}\) and \(k_{2}\) are non-zero constants. So, we have \(300=k_{1}+k_{2}(200)\) and \(360=k_{1}+k_{2}(250)\). 1 M either Solving, we have \(k_{1}=60\) and \(k_{2}=1.2\). both correct Painting cost of solid \(A\) \[=\$[60+1.2(720)]\] \[=\underline{\underline{\$ 924}}\] (b) Let \(V_{A} \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) and \(V_{B} \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volumes of solids \(A\) and \(B\) respectively, and let \(S_{A} \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) and \(S_{B} \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) be the surface area of solids \(A\) and \(B\) respectively. The painting cost of the Solid \(B=\$ 924 \div(1+40 \%)\) \(=\underline{\underline{\$ 660}}\) \(660=60+1.2 S_{B}\) \(S_{B}=500\) Note that solids \(A\) and \(B\) are similar. \(\frac{V_{A}}{V_{B}}=\left(\frac{S_{A}}{S_{B}}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}\) \(\frac{1000}{V_{B}}=\left(\frac{720}{500}\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}\) \(V_{B} \approx 578.7037037<580\) Thus, the claim is incorrect. f.t. ----(4)

questions.stem:
14. A right circular cone \(W\) is divided into two parts by a plane which is parallel to its base. The upper part is a smaller right circular cone \(X\) and the lower part is a frustum \(Y\). It is given that the curved surface area of \(Y\) is 8 times to the curved surface area of \(X\) and the volume of \(Y\) is greater than the volume of \(X\) by \(8000 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\).

(a) Find the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(4 marks)

(b) Suppose the height of \(X\) is 15 cm . Mr. Cheung claims that the total surface area of cone \(W\) is greater than the surface area of a sphere with radius 21 cm . Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個直立圓錐 \(W\) 被一個平行於底面的平面分成兩部分：上部為小圓錐 \(X\)，下部為截頭錐 \(Y\)。已知 \(Y\) 的曲面面積為 \(X\) 的 \(8\) 倍，且 \(Y\) 的體積比 \(X\) 多 \(8000\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(X\) 的體積。（4 分）

(b) 設 \(X\) 的高為 \(15\) cm。Mr. Cheung 聲稱圓錐 \(W\) 的總表面積大於一個半徑 \(21\) cm 的球的表面積。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（5 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution:
(a) The curved areas of X and W are in the ratio 1:9. Their corresponding length ratio is 1:3, so their volume ratio is 1:27. Since \(V_Y=26V_X\) and \(V_Y-V_X=8000\pi\), \(25V_X=8000\pi\) and \(V_X=320\pi\text{ cm}^3\).
(b) W has volume \(8640\pi\text{ cm}^3\) and height 45 cm. From \(\pi r^2(45)/3=8640\pi\), r = 24 cm. Its slant height is \(\sqrt{24^2+45^2}=51\) cm. Total surface area is \(\pi(24)(51)+\pi(24)^2=1800\pi\text{ cm}^2\). The sphere area is \(4\pi(21)^2=1764\pi\text{ cm}^2\). The claim is true.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) X 與 W 的曲面積比為 1:9，對應長度比為 1:3，體積比為 1:27。因此 \(V_Y=26V_X\)。由 \(V_Y-V_X=8000\pi\) 得 \(25V_X=8000\pi\)，所以 \(V_X=320\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。
(b) W 體積為 \(8640\pi\text{ cm}^3\)，高為 45 cm。由圓錐體積公式得底半徑 24 cm，畢氏定理給出斜高 51 cm。總表面積為 \(\pi(24)(51)+\pi(24)^2=1800\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。球表面積為 \(4\pi(21)^2=1764\pi\text{ cm}^2\)，所以同意聲稱。

questions.stemZh:
11. 圓形截頭錐形容器 \(X\)，由切除一個直立圓錐的下部造成，上底與下底平行。已知 \(X\) 的上底半徑及下底半徑分別為 \(60\) cm 及 \(20\) cm，\(X\) 的高為 \(120\) cm。

questions.stem: 14. A right circular cone is cut into three parts by two planes parallel to its base. The base radius and the height of the upper part of the cone are 6 cm and 20 cm respectively. (a) Find the volume of the upper part of the cone in terms of \(\pi\). (2 marks) (b) If the height of the middle part is 10 cm, find the volume of the middle part. (3 marks) (c) The height of the lower part is 10 cm. Amy claims that the curved surface area of the lower part is more than \(200\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個直立圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分。圓錐上部的底半徑及高分別為 \(6\) cm 及 \(20\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求圓錐上部的體積。（2 分）

(b) 若中間部分的高為 \(10\) cm，求中間部分的體積。（3 分）

(c) 下部的高為 \(10\) cm。Amy 聲稱下部的曲面面積多於 \(200\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）

圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of the upper cone is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(6)^2(20)=240\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (2 marks) (b) Since the planes are parallel to the base, the cones are similar. The upper cone has height 20 cm and radius 6 cm. For the cone formed by the upper and middle parts, its height is \[20+10=30\text{ cm}.\] By similarity, its radius is \[6\cdot\frac{30}{20}=9\text{ cm}.\] Hence the volume of the cone formed by the upper and middle parts is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(9)^2(30)=810\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Therefore, the volume of the middle part is \[810\pi-240\pi=570\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (c) The whole cone has height \[20+10+10=40\text{ cm}.\] By similarity, its base radius is \[6\cdot\frac{40}{20}=12\text{ cm}.\] The radius at the top of the lower part is \(9\) cm, and the radius at the bottom of the lower part is \(12\) cm. The height of the lower part is \(10\) cm, so its slant height is \[\sqrt{10^2+(12-9)^2}=\sqrt{109}\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of the lower frustum is \[\pi(9+12)\sqrt{109}=21\sqrt{109}\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[21\sqrt{109}>200,\] the curved surface area is more than \(200\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Therefore, I agree with Amy's claim. (4 marks)

questions.stem:
14. The base radius and the height of a solid right circular cone are 20 cm and 48 cm respectively. The cone is divided into a cone \(X\), a middle frustum \(Y\) and a bottom frustum \(Z\) by two planes which are parallel to its base. It is given that \(Y\) and \(Z\) are similar, and the height of \(Z\) is 12 cm.

(a) Express the volume of \(Z\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) Another different solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(S\) and a cone \(T\) by a plane parallel to its base. The height of \(S\) is 16 cm. The total surface area of \(S\) is equal to the sum of the total surface areas of \(Y\) and \(Z\). Is \(Z\) similar to \(S\)? Explain your answer. (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心直立圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(20\) cm 及 \(48\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\)、一個中截頭 \(Y\) 及一個下截頭 \(Z\)。已知 \(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 相似，且 \(Z\) 的高為 \(12\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Z\) 的體積。（3 分）

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(S\) 及一個圓錐 \(T\)。\(S\) 的高為 \(16\) cm，\(S\) 的總表面積等於 \(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 的總表面積之和。\(Z\) 與 \(S\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 14. (a) For the bottom frustum \(Z\), the lower radius is 20 cm and the height is 12 cm. Its upper plane is at a distance \[48-12=36\text{ cm}\] from the vertex of the original cone. By similarity of cones, the upper radius of \(Z\) is \[20\left(\frac{36}{48}\right)=15\text{ cm}.\] The volume of \(Z\) is \[\frac13\pi(12)(20^2+20\cdot 15+15^2)\] \[=4\pi(400+300+225) =3700\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) The slant height of \(Z\) is \[\sqrt{12^2+(20-15)^2}=13.\] The total surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(20+15)(13)+\pi(20)^2+\pi(15)^2\] \[=455\pi+400\pi+225\pi =1080\pi.\] Since \(Y\) and \(Z\) are similar, and the lower radius of \(Y\) is the upper radius of \(Z\), the linear scale factor from \(Z\) to \(Y\) is \[\frac{15}{20}=\frac34.\] Therefore, the total surface area of \(Y\) is \[1080\pi\left(\frac34\right)^2=607.5\pi.\] Hence the total surface area of \(S\) is \[1080\pi+607.5\pi=1687.5\pi.\] Now \[\frac{\text{TSA of }S}{\text{TSA of }Z} =\frac{1687.5\pi}{1080\pi} =\frac{25}{16},\] but \[\left(\frac{\text{height of }S}{\text{height of }Z}\right)^2 =\left(\frac{16}{12}\right)^2 =\frac{16}{9}.\] Since \[\frac{25}{16}\ne\frac{16}{9},\] \(Z\) and \(S\) are not similar. (4 marks)

questions.stem:
14. A right circular cylindrical container of base radius 12 cm and height 16 cm and an inverted right circular conical vessel of base radius 30 cm and height 15 cm are held vertically. The container is fully filled with water. The water in the container is now poured into the vessel.

(a) Find the volume of water in the vessel in terms of \(\pi\). (2 marks)

(b) Find the depth of water in the vessel. (4 marks)

(c) If a solid metal sphere of radius 4 cm is then put into the vessel and the sphere is totally immersed in the water, will the water overflow? Explain your answer. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個底半徑 \(12\) cm、高 \(16\) cm 的直立圓柱形容器，與一個底半徑 \(30\) cm、高 \(15\) cm 的倒置直立圓錐形容器，均垂直放置。圓柱容器完全注滿水，現將水倒入圓錐容器。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求圓錐容器中水的體積。（2 分）

(b) 求圓錐容器中水深。（4 分）

(c) 若再將一個半徑 \(4\) cm 的實心金屬球放入圓錐容器，球完全浸入水中，水會否溢出？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
排水 = 物體體積。
questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of water is equal to the volume of the cylinder: \[\pi(12)^2(16)=2304\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) Let the depth of water in the conical vessel be \(h\) cm. By similarity, the radius of the water surface is \[\frac{30}{15}h=2h.\] Thus \(\frac{1}{3}\pi(2h)^2h=2304\pi.\) So \(\frac{4}{3}h^3=2304,\) and hence \(h^3=1728.\) Therefore \(h=12.\) The depth of water is 12 cm. (c) The remaining volume of the conical vessel is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(30)^2(15)-2304\pi=2196\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] The volume of the sphere is \(\frac{4}{3}\pi(4)^3=\frac{256}{3}\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) Since \(\frac{256}{3}\pi<2196\pi,\) the water will not overflow. (9 marks)

questions.stem:
13. A vessel in form of a frustum is made by cutting off the lower part of an inverted right circular cone. The radii of the upper base and the lower base are 16 cm and 4 cm respectively. The height of the frustum is 36 cm.

(a) Find the capacity of the vessel in terms of \(\pi\). (2 marks)

(b) The vessel contains \(10000\text{ cm}^3\) of water. Now, Sam puts n solid metal spheres of radii 3 cm into the vessel and the spheres are totally immersed in the water.

(i) Find the maximum value of n such that the water in the vessel will not overflow.
(ii) Sam claims that the wetted curved surface area of the vessel now is less than \(2350\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個截頭錐形容器，由切除一個倒置直立圓錐的下部造成。上底半徑及下底半徑分別為 \(16\) cm 及 \(4\) cm，截頭錐高 \(36\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求容器的容量。（2 分）

(b) 容器中有 \(10000\text{ cm}^3\) 水。Sam 放入 \(n\) 個半徑 \(3\) cm 的實心金屬球，球完全浸入水中。

(i) 求 \(n\) 的最大值，使容器中的水不會溢出。
(ii) Sam 聲稱容器現時的濕曲面面積少於 \(2350\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（5 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
排水 = 物體體積。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution:
(a) Let the removed cone height be h. Similarity gives \(4/h=16/(h+36)\), hence h = 12 cm. Capacity is \(\pi[(16)^2(48)-(4)^2(12)]/3=4032\pi\text{ cm}^3\).
(b)(i) Each sphere displaces \(36\pi\text{ cm}^3\). From \(10000+36\pi n\le4032\pi\), the greatest integer n is 23.
(ii) Including the virtual removed cone, the occupied volume below the waterline is \(10000+(23)(36\pi)+64\pi=10000+892\pi\). Let H be the height above the virtual apex; then radius = H/3 and \(\pi H^3/27=10000+892\pi\). The wetted curved area is \(\pi\sqrt{10}(H^2/9-16)\approx2375.6\text{ cm}^2\), greater than 2350 cm². Disagree.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 設切去的小圓錐高為 h。由相似，\(4/h=16/(h+36)\)，得 h = 12 cm。容器容量為 \(\pi[(16)^2(48)-(4)^2(12)]/3=4032\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。
(b)(i) 每球排水量為 \(36\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。由 \(10000+36\pi n\le4032\pi\) 得最大整數 n = 23。
(ii) 連同底部虛擬小圓錐，水面以下的體積為 \(10000+892\pi\)。設水面距虛擬頂點高為 H，則半徑為 H/3，且 \(\pi H^3/27=10000+892\pi\)。濕曲面積為 \(\pi\sqrt{10}(H^2/9-16)\approx2375.6\text{ cm}^2\)，大於 2350 cm²，所以不同意。

(a) 求 \(X\)、\(Y\)、\(Z\) 的體積比。（2 分）

(b) 已知原圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(24\) cm 及 \(18\) cm。

(ii) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。（5 分）

questions.solution:
(a) The cumulative heights from the vertex are in the ratio \(3:5:6\). Volumes of similar cones scale as the cube, so \(X:Y:Z=27:(125-27):(216-125)=27:98:91\).

(b)(i) The full cone volume is \(\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)=2592\pi\). Thus \(V_Z=2592\pi\cdot91/216=1092\pi\text{ cm}^3\).

(ii) Full slant height is \(\sqrt{18^2+24^2}=30\). Curved areas scale as the square: \(S_Y=\pi(18)(30)[(5/6)^2-(3/6)^2]=240\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

questions.hint: Similar solids: area ratio = k², volume ratio = k³.
questions.hintZh:
柱體：體積 = 底面積 × 高。
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: The total volume of metal is \(84(20)=1680\text{ cm}^3.\) The ratio of corresponding lengths of the smaller pyramid to the larger pyramid is \(\sqrt{4:9}=2:3.\) Hence the ratio of their volumes is \(8:27.\) (a) The volume of the larger pyramid is \[1680\left(\frac{27}{8+27}\right)=1296\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The volume of the smaller pyramid is \[1680-1296=384\text{ cm}^3.\] The height of the smaller pyramid is \[\frac23(12)=8\text{ cm}.\] Let the side length of its square base be \(s\). Then \[\frac13s^2(8)=384\] so \[s^2=144,\qquad s=12.\] The slant height of each triangular face is \[\sqrt{8^2+6^2}=10.\] Thus the total surface area is \[144+4\left(\frac12(12)(10)\right)=384\text{ cm}^2.\] Final answers: (a) \(1296\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(384\text{ cm}^2\).

questions.stem:
9. The sum of the volumes of two spheres is \(324\pi\text{ cm}^3\). The radius of the larger sphere is equal to the diameter of the smaller sphere. Express, in terms of \(\pi\),

(a) the volume of the larger sphere;

(b) the sum of the surface areas of the two spheres.
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
9. 兩個球的體積和為 \(324\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。較大球的半徑等於較小球的直徑。以 \(\pi\) 表示：

(a) 較大球的體積；

(b) 兩個球的表面積之和。
（5 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.solution: The ratio of the radii of the larger sphere to the smaller sphere is \(2:1\), so the ratio of their volumes is \(8:1\). (a) \[\text{Volume of larger sphere}=\frac8{9}(324\pi)=288\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Let the radius of the larger sphere be \(R\). Then \[\frac43\pi R^3=288\pi\] so \[ R=6. \] The smaller radius is \(3\) cm. (b) \[4\pi(6^2)+4\pi(3^2)=180\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Final answers: (a) \(288\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(180\pi\text{ cm}^2\).
questions.solutionZh:
半徑比 2:1，體積比 8:1。
（a）大球 = 288π。(4/3)πR³ = 288π，R = 6。小球半徑 3。
（b）表面積和 = 180π cm²。

questions.stem:
13. There are two solid metal spheres. The ratio of the surface area of the smaller sphere to the surface area of the larger sphere is \(4:9\). The radius of the larger sphere is \(9\text{ cm}\).

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the volume of the smaller sphere.

(b) The two spheres are melted and recast into two solid right circular cones. Denote these two circular cones by \(A\) and \(B\). It is given that the height and the base radius of \(A\) are \(10\text{ cm}\) and \(6\text{ cm}\) respectively. A student finds that the base radius of \(B\) is \(12\text{ cm}\). The student claims that \(A\) and \(B\) are similar. Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 有兩個實心金屬球。較小球與較大球的表面積比為 \(4:9\)，較大球半徑為 \(9\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較小球的體積。

(b) 兩球熔化後重鑄成兩個實心直立圓錐，記為 \(A\) 及 \(B\)。已知 \(A\) 的高及底半徑分別為 \(10\) cm 及 \(6\) cm，某學生量得 \(B\) 的底半徑為 \(12\) cm。該學生聲稱 \(A\) 與 \(B\) 相似。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: (a) Since the surface area ratio is \(4:9\), the radius ratio is \(2:3\), and the volume ratio is \(8:27\). Therefore \[V_{\text{smaller}}=\frac{8}{27}\cdot \frac{4}{3}\pi(9)^3=288\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The volume of \(A\) is \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(6)^2(10)=120\pi.\] The volume of \(B\) is \[288\pi+\frac{4}{3}\pi(9)^3-120\pi=1140\pi.\] Thus \[\frac{V_B}{V_A}=\frac{1140\pi}{120\pi}=\frac{19}{2}.\] If \(A\) and \(B\) were similar, the volume ratio should be \[\left(\frac{12}{6}\right)^3=8.\] Since \(8\ne \frac{19}{2}\), \(A\) and \(B\) are not similar. Final answers: (a) \(288\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) no.

questions.stem:
14. The base radius and the curved surface area of a solid metal right circular cone are \(14\text{ cm}\) and \(700\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively.

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The curved surface area of \(Y\) is 15 times the curved surface area of \(X\).

(i) Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) If \(Y\) is melted and recast into 2 identical solid spheres, find the diameter of each sphere.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的底半徑及曲面面積分別為 \(14\) cm 及 \(700\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(Y\) 的曲面面積為 \(X\) 的 \(15\) 倍。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的體積。
(ii) 若將 \(Y\) 熔化重鑄成兩個相同的實心球，求每個球的直徑。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: (a) Let \(l\) be the slant height of the circular cone. Since the curved surface area is \(700\pi\), \[\pi(14)l=700\pi.\] Thus \[ l=50. \] The height is \[\sqrt{50^2-14^2}=48\text{ cm}.\] (b)(i) Since the curved surface area of \(Y\) is 15 times that of \(X\), the whole cone has curved surface area \(16\) times that of \(X\). Therefore the linear scale factor from \(X\) to the whole cone is \(1:4\), and the volume of \(X\) is \(\frac{1}{64}\) of the volume of the whole cone. The volume of the whole cone is \(\frac{1}{3}\pi(14)^2(48)=3136\pi.\) Hence \(V_Y=3136\pi\left(1-\frac{1}{64}\right)=3087\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b)(ii) If the diameter of each sphere is \(d\), then \(2\cdot \frac{4}{3}\pi\left(\frac{d}{2}\right)^3=3087\pi.\) Solving gives \(d=21.\) Final answers: (a) \(48\text{ cm}\); (b)(i) \(3087\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b)(ii) \(21\text{ cm}\).

questions.stem:
14. The height and the base radius of a solid metal right circular cone are 45 cm and 24 cm respectively. The circular cone is divided into a circular cone and a frustum \(X\) by a plane parallel to its base. It is given that the height of \(X\) is 30 cm.

(a) Express the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Express the total surface area of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(c) \(X\) is melted and recast into a solid cube. Does the total surface area of the cube exceed the total surface area of \(X\)? Explain your answer.
(9 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(45\) cm 及 \(24\) cm。該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐及一個截頭錐 \(X\)。已知 \(X\) 的高為 \(30\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(X\) 的總表面積。

(c) 將 \(X\) 熔化重鑄成一個實心立方體。立方體的總表面積是否超過 \(X\) 的總表面積？試解釋你的答案。
（9 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: (a) The height of the small cone is \[45-30=15\text{ cm}.\] The small cone is similar to the original cone with linear scale factor \[\frac{15}{45}=\frac13.\] Therefore the volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(24)^2(45)\left(1-\left(\frac13\right)^3\right) =8320\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{24^2+45^2}=51\text{ cm}.\] The radius and slant height of the small cone are respectively \[8\text{ cm} \text{and} 17\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of \(X\) is \[\pi(24)(51)-\pi(8)(17).\] The two circular faces have total area \[\pi(24)^2+\pi(8)^2.\] Hence the total surface area of \(X\) is \[\pi(24)(51)-\pi(8)(17)+\pi(24)^2+\pi(8)^2 =1728\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (c) Let the side length of the cube be \(x\) cm. Since the volume is unchanged, \[x^3=8320\pi.\] Thus \[x\approx 29.6773.\] The total surface area of the cube is \[6x^2\approx 5284.45\text{ cm}^2.\] Also, \[1728\pi\approx 5428.67\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[5284.45<5428.67,\] the total surface area of the cube does not exceed the total surface area of \(X\). Final answers: (a) \(8320\pi\text{ cm}^3\); (b) \(1728\pi\text{ cm}^2\); (c) no.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）小錐高 15，線性比 1/3：
\[
V_X=\frac13\pi(24)^2(45)\left(1-\frac1{27}\right)=8320\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]
（b）原錐斜高 51。小錐半徑 8、斜高 17。

questions.stem:
13. A solid metal sphere of radius 10 cm is melted and recast into three similar solid right circular cylinders \(X\), \(Y\) and \(Z\). Let \(r_1\) cm, \(r_2\) cm and \(r_3\) cm be the base radii of \(X\), \(Y\) and \(Z\) respectively. It is given that
\(r_1:r_2:r_3=2:3:5.\)

(a) Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) A craftsman finds that the height of \(Y\) is 9 cm.

(i) Find \(r_2\).
(ii) The craftsman claims that the total surface area of \(Z\) is greater than the surface area of the sphere. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個半徑 \(10\) cm 的實心金屬球熔化後，重鑄成三個相似的實心直立圓柱 \(X\)、\(Y\)、\(Z\)。設 \(X\)、\(Y\)、\(Z\) 的底半徑分別為 \(r_1\)、\(r_2\)、\(r_3\) cm，已知 \(r_1:r_2:r_3=2:3:5\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的體積。

(b) 某工匠量得 \(Y\) 的高為 \(9\) cm。

(i) 求 \(r_2\)。
(ii) 該工匠聲稱 \(Z\) 的總表面積大於球的表面積。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.
questions.hintZh:
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: (a) The volume of the original sphere is \[\frac43\pi(10)^3=\frac{4000\pi}{3}.\] Since the cylinders are similar and their linear ratio is \(2:3:5\), their volume ratio is \[2^3:3^3:5^3=8:27:125.\] Thus \[V_Y=\frac{27}{160}\cdot\frac{4000\pi}{3}=225\pi.\] (b)(i) \(\pi r_2^2(9)=225\pi\) \(r_2^2=25\) \(r_2=5.\) (b)(ii) Since \(r_2:r_3=3:5\), \(r_3=\frac53(5)=\frac{25}{3}.\) Since the cylinders are similar, \(h_Z=\frac53(9)=15.\) Total surface area of \(Z\): \(2\pi r_3^2+2\pi r_3h_Z =2\pi\left(\frac{25}{3}\right)^2+2\pi\left(\frac{25}{3}\right)(15) =\frac{3500\pi}{9}.\) Surface area of the sphere: \(4\pi(10)^2=400\pi.\) Since \(\frac{3500\pi}{9}<400\pi,\) the claim is not correct. Final answers: (a) \(225\pi\); (b)(i) \(r_2=5\); (b)(ii) disagree.

questions.stem:
10. The height and the base radius of a solid metallic right circular cone are \(24\) cm and \(18\) cm respectively. The circular cone is melted and recast into two spheres. The surface area of the larger sphere is \(4\) times that of the smaller sphere. Express, in terms of \(\pi\),

(a) the volume of the larger sphere,

(b) the sum of the surface areas of the two spheres.
questions.stemZh:
10. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(24\) cm 及 \(18\) cm。該圓錐熔化後重鑄成兩個球，較大球的表面積為較小球的 \(4\) 倍。以 \(\pi\) 表示：

(a) 較大球的體積；

(b) 兩個球的表面積之和。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: The volume of the cone is \(\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)=2592\pi.\) Since the surface area ratio of the larger sphere to the smaller sphere is \(4:1\), their radii are in the ratio \(2:1\), so their volumes are in the ratio \(8:1\). (a) \[V_{\text{larger}}=2592\pi\cdot\frac{8}{9} =\boxed{2304\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\] (b) Let the radius of the larger sphere be \(R\). Then \[\frac43\pi R^3=2304\pi,\] so \[ R=12. \] The radius of the smaller sphere is \(6\). Hence the sum of the surface areas is \[4\pi(12)^2+4\pi(6)^2 =\boxed{720\pi\text{ cm}^2}.\]
questions.solutionZh:
圓錐 2592π。表面積比 4:1，半徑比 2:1，體積比 8:1。
（a）大球 = 2304π。
（b）R = 12，小球半徑 6。

questions.stem:
12. A solid metal right circular cylinder of base area \(96\pi\text{ cm}^2\) and height \(38\) cm is melted and recast into two similar solid right circular cones. The ratio of the base area of the smaller circular cone to the base area of the larger circular cone is \(9:25\).

(a) Find the volume of the smaller circular cone.

(b) If the base radius of the smaller circular cone is \(6\) cm, find the curved surface area of the larger circular cone correct to the nearest \(\text{cm}^2\).
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個底面積 \(96\pi\text{ cm}^2\)、高 \(38\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓錐。較小圓錐與較大圓錐的底面積比為 \(9:25\)。

(a) 求較小圓錐的體積。

(b) 若較小圓錐的底半徑為 \(6\) cm，求較大圓錐的曲面面積，準確至最接近的 cm\(^2\)。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: The volume of the cylinder is \(96\pi(38)=3648\pi.\) The base areas of the smaller and larger cones are in the ratio \(9:25\), so their linear ratio is \(3:5\) and their volume ratio is \(27:125\). (a) \[V_{\text{smaller}}=3648\pi\cdot\frac{27}{27+125} =\boxed{648\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\] (b) Let the height of the smaller cone be \(h\). Since its base radius is \(6\) cm, \[\frac13\pi(6)^2h=648\pi,\] so \[ h=54. \] The slant height of the smaller cone is \[\sqrt{6^2+54^2}=6\sqrt{82}.\] The curved surface area of the smaller cone is \[\pi(6)(6\sqrt{82})=36\pi\sqrt{82}.\] The ratio of the curved surface areas is \(9:25\). Hence the curved surface area of the larger cone is \[36\pi\sqrt{82}\cdot\frac{25}{9}=100\pi\sqrt{82}\approx \boxed{2845\text{ cm}^2}.\]

questions.sourceZh: 來源所列（未獨立核實）：Extra 2021 P1 Q12

questions.stem:
13. The slant height and the curved surface area of a solid metal right circular cone are 29 cm and \(580 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) respectively.

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into three parts by two planes which are parallel to its base. The top part is a right circular cone \(A\), the middle part is a frustum \(B\) and the bottom part is a frustum \(C\). The curved surface areas of \(A\) and \(B\) are equal. The curved surface area of \(C\) is 6 times the curved surface area of \(A\).

(i) Express the volume of \(C\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) If \(C\) is melted and recast into 5 identical solid metal right circular cylinders with the height 10 cm , find the base radius of each circular cylinder.
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的斜高及曲面面積分別為 \(29\) cm 及 \(580\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分：頂部為圓錐 \(A\)，中部為截頭錐 \(B\)，底部為截頭錐 \(C\)。\(A\) 與 \(B\) 的曲面面積相等，\(C\) 的曲面面積為 \(A\) 的 \(6\) 倍。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(C\) 的體積。
(ii) 若將 \(C\) 熔化重鑄成 \(5\) 個高 \(10\) cm 的相同實心金屬直立圓柱，求每個圓柱的底半徑。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: (a) Let the base radius be \(r\) cm. Since the slant height is \(29\) cm and the curved surface area is \(580\pi\), \[\pi r(29)=580\pi.\] Hence \(r=20\). The height is \[\sqrt{29^2-20^2}=\boxed{21\text{ cm}}.\] (b)(i) The curved surface areas of \(A,B,C\) are in the ratio \(1:1:6\). Hence the combined top cone \(A+B\) has curved surface area \(\frac14\) of the original cone, so its linear scale factor is \(\frac12\). Its volume scale factor is \(\frac18\). The volume of the original cone is \(\frac13\pi(20)^2(21)=2800\pi.\) Therefore, \(V_C=\frac78(2800\pi)=\boxed{2450\pi\ \text{cm}^3}.\) (b)(ii) Each cylinder has volume \(\frac{2450\pi}{5}=490\pi.\) If the base radius is \(R\) cm, then \(\pi R^2(10)=490\pi,\) so \(\boxed{R=7}.\)

questions.stem:
14. A solid metal right circular cylinder of base radius 10 cm and height 4.2 cm is melted and recast into two similar solid metal right circular cones \(X\) and \(Y\). The ratio of the base area of \(X\) to the base area of \(Y\) is \(4: 9\). The ratio of the base radius of \(Y\) to its height is \(3: 4\).

(a) Find the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Find the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(c) The frustum \(Z\) is made by cutting off the upper part of \(Y\). The heights of \(X\) and \(Z\) are the same. Someone claims that the curved surface area of \(Z\) is twice the curved surface area of \(X\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個底半徑 \(10\) cm、高 \(4.2\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心金屬直立圓錐 \(X\) 及 \(Y\)。\(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的底面積比為 \(4:9\)，\(Y\) 的底半徑與高之比為 \(3:4\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的體積。

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。

(c) 切除 \(Y\) 的上部造成截頭錐 \(Z\)，\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 的高相等。某人聲稱 \(Z\) 的曲面面積為 \(X\) 的兩倍。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: The volume of the original cylinder is \(\pi(10)^2(4.2)=420\pi.\) Since the base areas of \(X\) and \(Y\) are in the ratio \(4:9\), their radii are in the ratio \(2:3\), so their volumes are in the ratio \(8:27\). (a) \[V_Y=420\pi\cdot\frac{27}{8+27}=\boxed{324\pi\ \text{cm}^3}.\] (b) Let the radius and height of \(Y\) be \(3k\) and \(4k\) respectively. Then \[\frac13\pi(3k)^2(4k)=324\pi,\] so \(12k^3=324\), \(k=3\). Hence \(r_Y=9\), \(h_Y=12\), and the slant height is \(15\). Therefore, \[\text{curved surface area of }Y=\pi(9)(15)=\boxed{135\pi\ \text{cm}^2}.\] (c) Since \(X\) and \(Y\) are similar, \(r_X=6\), \(h_X=8\), and the slant height of \(X\) is \(10\). Thus \[\text{CSA of }X=\pi(6)(10)=60\pi.\] In \(Y\), the frustum \(Z\) has height \(8\), so the removed top cone has height \(4\), with linear scale factor \(\frac{4}{12}=\frac13\). Its curved surface area is \[\frac{1}{9}(135\pi)=15\pi.\] Therefore, \[\text{CSA of }Z=135\pi-15\pi=120\pi=2(60\pi).\] The claim is correct.

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into three parts by two planes which are parallel to its base. The top part is a right circular cone \(A\), the middle part is a frustum \(B\) and the bottom part is a frustum \(C\). The curved surface areas of \(A\) and \(B\) are equal. The curved surface area of \(C\) is 6 times the curved surface area of \(A\).

(i) Express the volume of \(C\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) If \(C\) is melted and recast into 5 identical solid metal right circular cylinders with the height 10 cm , find the base radius of each circular cylinder.
questions.stemZh:

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分：頂部為圓錐 \(A\)，中部為截頭錐 \(B\)，底部為截頭錐 \(C\)。\(A\) 與 \(B\) 的曲面面積相等，\(C\) 的曲面面積為 \(A\) 的 \(6\) 倍。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(C\) 的體積。
(ii) 若將 \(C\) 熔化重鑄成 \(5\) 個高 \(10\) cm 的相同實心金屬直立圓柱，求每個圓柱的底半徑。

圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。

questions.solution: (a) Let the base radius be \(r\) cm. Since the slant height is \(29\) cm, \[\pi r(29)=580\pi,\] so \(r=20\). Hence the height is \[\sqrt{29^2-20^2}=\boxed{21\text{ cm}}.\] (b)(i) The curved surface areas of \(A,B,C\) are in the ratio \(1:1:6\). Thus the combined top cone \(A+B\) has curved surface area \(\frac{1+1}{1+1+6}=\frac14\) of the original cone. Its linear scale factor is therefore \(\sqrt{\frac14}=\frac12\), so its volume scale factor is \(\left(\frac12\right)^3=\frac18\). The volume of the original cone is \(\frac13\pi(20)^2(21)=2800\pi.\) Therefore, \(V_C=\frac78(2800\pi)=\boxed{2450\pi\ \text{cm}^3}.\) (b)(ii) The volume of each cylinder is \(\frac{2450\pi}{5}=490\pi.\) If the radius is \(R\), then \(\pi R^2(10)=490\pi,\) so \(R=7\). The total surface area of each cylinder is \(2\pi(7)^2+2\pi(7)(10)=\boxed{238\pi\ \text{cm}^2}.\)

(b) If the base radius of the larger circular cone is 12 cm , find the total surface area of the smaller circular cone in terms of \(\pi\).

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較大圓錐的體積。

(b) 若較大圓錐的底半徑為 \(12\) cm，以 \(\pi\) 求較小圓錐的總表面積。

questions.solution: The volume of the cylinder is \(\pi(8)^2(7)=448\pi.\) The base radii of the smaller and larger cones are in the ratio \(1:3\), so their volumes are in the ratio \(1:27\). The smaller cone is similar with linear scale factor \(\frac13\), so its radius and height are \(4\) cm and \(3\) cm respectively. (ii) If \(Y\) is melted and recast into \(2352\) identical solid spheres, find the radius of each sphere.

(b) 該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(Y\) 的體積為 \(X\) 的 \(63\) 倍。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。
(ii) 若將 \(Y\) 熔化重鑄成 \(2352\) 個相同實心球，求每個球的半徑。

questions.solution: (a) Let the height be \(h\) cm. Then \[\frac13\pi(96)^2h=86016\pi,\] so \[ h=28. \] The slant height is \[\sqrt{96^2+28^2}=100.\] Therefore, the curved surface area is \[\pi(96)(100)=\boxed{9600\pi\text{ cm}^2}.\] (b)(i) Since the volume of \(Y\) is \(63\) times the volume of \(X\), \(V_X:V_{\text{whole}}=1:64.\) Thus the linear ratio of \(X\) to the whole cone is \(1:4\), and the curved surface area ratio is \(1:16\). Therefore, \(\text{curved surface area of }Y =9600\pi\left(1-\frac1{16}\right) =\boxed{9000\pi\text{ cm}^2}.\) (ii) The volume of \(Y\) is \[86016\pi\cdot\frac{63}{64}.\] Let the radius of each sphere be \(r\) cm. Then \[2352\left(\frac43\pi r^3\right)=86016\pi\cdot\frac{63}{64}.\] Hence \[r^3=27,\qquad r=\boxed{3\text{ cm}}.\]

(a) Find the volume of \(C\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) If the height of \(C\) is 27 cm , find the total surface area of \(B\).

12. 一個半徑 \(9\) cm 的實心金屬球熔化後，重鑄成三個相似的實心直立圓錐 \(A\)、\(B\) 及 \(C\)。已知 \(A\) 與 \(B\) 的底面積比為 \(1:4\)，\(A\) 與 \(C\) 的體積比為 \(1:27\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(C\) 的體積。

(b) 若 \(C\) 的高為 \(27\) cm，求 \(B\) 的總表面積。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.

questions.solution: The volume of the sphere is \(\frac43\pi(9)^3=972\pi.\) Since the base areas of \(A\) and \(B\) are in the ratio \(1:4\), their linear scale is \(1:2\), so their volumes are in the ratio \(1:8\). Also, the volumes of \(A\) and \(C\) are in the ratio \(1:27\). Therefore, \(V_A:V_B:V_C=1:8:27.\) (a) \[V_C=972\pi\cdot\frac{27}{1+8+27}=\boxed{729\pi\ \text{cm}^3}.\] (b) Let the base radius of \(C\) be \(r\) cm. Since the height of \(C\) is \(27\) cm, \[\frac13\pi r^2(27)=729\pi,\] so \(r=9\). Since the linear scale of \(B:C\) is \(2:3\), the base radius and height of \(B\) are \(6\) cm and \(18\) cm respectively. The slant height of \(B\) is \[\sqrt{6^2+18^2}=6\sqrt{10}.\] Therefore, the total surface area of \(B\) is \[\pi(6)^2+\pi(6)(6\sqrt{10}) =\boxed{36\pi(1+\sqrt{10})\ \text{cm}^2}.\]

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The ratio of the volume of \(X\) to the volume of \(Y\) is \(8:19\). Express the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).

12. 某工作坊將 \(9\) 個半徑 \(6\) cm 的相同實心金屬球熔化後，重鑄成一個圓錐。已知圓錐的底半徑為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的體積比為 \(8:19\)。以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。

questions.stemZh:

(a) \[V_{\text{smaller}}=14592\pi\cdot\frac{27}{27+125} =\boxed{2592\pi\ \text{cm}^3}.\] (b) If the height of the smaller cone is \(24\) cm, then \[\frac13\pi r^2(24)=2592\pi,\] so \(r=18\) cm. The larger cone has radius \(30\) cm and height \(40\) cm. The slant heights of the smaller and larger cones are \(30\) cm and \(50\) cm respectively. The circular cone is divided into a circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane parallel to its base. (a) Express the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) \(X\) and \(Y\) are melted and recast into two similar solid circular cylinders \(W\) and \(Z\) respectively. If the base radius of \(Z\) is 6 cm, does the total surface area of \(W\) exceed \(700\text{ cm}^2\)? Explain your answer. (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個實心直立圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(54\) cm 及 \(18\) cm。該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。已知 \(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的曲面面積比為 \(1:8\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的體積。（3 分）

(b) \(X\) 及 \(Y\) 分別熔化重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓柱 \(W\) 及 \(Z\)。若 \(Z\) 的底半徑為 \(6\) cm，\(W\) 的總表面積是否超過 \(700\text{ cm}^2\)？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）

questions.solution: 12. (a) Let the curved surface area of the original cone be \(S\). Since the ratio of the curved surface area of \(X\) to that of \(Y\) is \(1:8\), the curved surface area of \(X\) is \(\frac{1}{9}S.\) For similar cones, the ratio of curved surface areas is the square of the ratio of corresponding lengths. Hence the ratio of the base radius of \(X\) to the base radius of the original cone is \(1:3.\) Therefore, the ratio of the volume of \(X\) to the volume of the original cone is \(1:27.\) The volume of the original cone is \(\frac13\pi(18)^2(54)=5832\pi.\) Hence the volume of \(Y\) is \(\left(1-\frac{1}{27}\right)(5832\pi)=5616\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) ------------------(3) (b) Let \(h\) cm be the height of \(Z\). Since \(Y\) is recast into \(Z\), \(\pi(6)^2h=5616\pi.\) Thus \(h=156.\) The total surface area of \(Z\) is \(2\pi(6)^2+2\pi(6)(156)=1944\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) The volume ratio of \(W\) to \(Z\) is the same as the volume ratio of \(X\) to \(Y\): \(1:26.\) Since \(W\) and \(Z\) are similar, their total surface areas are in the ratio \(1:26^{2/3}.\) Therefore, the total surface area of \(W\) is \(\frac{1944\pi}{26^{2/3}}\text{ cm}^2.\) \[\frac{1944\pi}{26^{2/3}}\approx 695.9<700.\] Therefore, the total surface area of \(W\) does not exceed \(700\text{ cm}^2\). ------------------(4)

questions.stem:
12. There are two similar metal right circular cones. Denote these two circular cones by \(A\) and \(B\) respectively. The sum of the curved surface areas of these two cones is \(680 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). The ratio of the volume of \(A\) to the volume of \(B\) is \(1: 8\). The height of \(A\) is 15 cm .

(a) Find, in terms of \(\pi\), the volume of \(B\).

(b) \(B\) is melted and recast into two identical solid right circular cones. Denote each of the two identical cones by \(C\) where their base radii are \(w \mathrm{~cm}\). The craftsman finds that \(w^{3}=2048\) and claims that all the cones \(A\), \(B\) and \(C\) are similar. Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
12. 有兩個相似的金屬直立圓錐，記為 \(A\) 及 \(B\)。兩圓錐的曲面面積和為 \(680\pi\text{ cm}^2\)，\(A\) 與 \(B\) 的體積比為 \(1:8\)，\(A\) 的高為 \(15\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(B\) 的體積。

(b) 將 \(B\) 熔化重鑄成兩個相同的實心直立圓錐，記為 \(C\)，其底半徑為 \(w\) cm。某工匠量得 \(w^3=2048\)，並聲稱圓錐 \(A\)、\(B\)、\(C\) 全部相似。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution:
(a) A:B have length ratio 1:2, curved-area ratio 1:4 and heights 15:30. Thus B has curved area \(544\pi\text{ cm}^2\). If its radius is r, \(r\sqrt{r^2+30^2}=544\). Squaring gives \((r^2-256)(r^2+1156)=0\), so r = 16 cm. Its volume is \(\pi(16)^2(30)/3=2560\pi\text{ cm}^3\).
(b) Each C has volume \(1280\pi\). Since \(w^3=2048\), \((w/16)^3=1/2=V_C/V_B\). For cones, \(V/r^3=\pi h/(3r)\), so C and B have the same height-to-radius ratio and are similar. A is already similar to B. Agree.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) A:B 長度比為 1:2，曲面積比為 1:4，高分別為 15、30 cm。因此 B 曲面積為 \(544\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。設 B 半徑為 r，則 \(r\sqrt{r^2+30^2}=544\)。平方整理得 \((r^2-256)(r^2+1156)=0\)，所以 r = 16 cm。體積為 \(\pi(16)^2(30)/3=2560\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。
(b) 每個 C 體積為 \(1280\pi\)。由 \(w^3=2048\)，\((w/16)^3=1/2=V_C/V_B\)。圓錐滿足 \(V/r^3=\pi h/(3r)\)，因此 C、B 的高與半徑之比相等，兩者相似。A 本來已與 B 相似，所以同意。

questions.stem:
12. A solid circular cone is divided into a cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane parallel to its base. It is given that the radii of the upper base and the lower base of the frustum \(Y\) are \(r\text{ cm}\) and \(3r\text{ cm}\) respectively. The height of the frustum \(Y\) is \(2r\text{ cm}\).

(a) Find, in terms of \(\pi\) and \(r\), the volume of \(Y\).

(b) \(Y\) is melted and recast into \(k\) identical solid hemispheres \(Z\) with radius \(r\text{ cm}\). Find \(k\).

(c) Find the least number of solid hemispheres \(Z\) such that the total surface area of the hemispheres would exceed that of \(Y\).
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個實心圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。已知截頭錐 \(Y\) 的上底半徑及下底半徑分別為 \(r\) cm 及 \(3r\) cm，\(Y\) 的高為 \(2r\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 及 \(r\) 求 \(Y\) 的體積。

(b) 將 \(Y\) 熔化重鑄成 \(k\) 個半徑 \(r\) cm 的相同實心半球 \(Z\)，求 \(k\)。

(c) 求最少需要多少個實心半球 \(Z\)，使其總表面積超過 \(Y\) 的總表面積。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 12. (a) Since the radii of the smaller cone and larger cone are in the ratio \(1:3\), their heights are also in the ratio \(1:3\). The height of the frustum is \(2r\), so the height of the smaller cone is \(r\), and the height of the larger cone is \(3r\). The volume of \(Y\) is \(\frac13\pi(3r)^2(3r)-\frac13\pi r^2(r).\) Thus \(\text{Volume of }Y=9\pi r^3-\frac13\pi r^3=\frac{26}{3}\pi r^3.\) (b) The volume of one solid hemisphere of radius \(r\) is \[\frac23\pi r^3.\] Since \(Y\) is recast into \(k\) identical hemispheres, \[\frac{26}{3}\pi r^3=k\left(\frac23\pi r^3\right).\] Therefore, \[ k=13. \] (c) The slant height of the frustum is \[\sqrt{(2r)^2+(2r)^2}=2\sqrt2r.\] The total surface area of \(Y\) is \[\pi r^2+\pi(3r)^2+\pi(r+3r)(2\sqrt2r).\] Hence \[\text{Total surface area of }Y=(10+8\sqrt2)\pi r^2.\] The total surface area of one solid hemisphere is \[2\pi r^2+\pi r^2=3\pi r^2.\] Let \(n\) be the required number of hemispheres. Then \[n(3\pi r^2)>(10+8\sqrt2)\pi r^2.\] Thus \[n>\frac{10+8\sqrt2}{3}\approx 7.10.\] Therefore, the least possible value of \(n\) is \(8.\)
questions.solutionZh:
（a）小錐：大錐半徑比 1:3，高比 1:3。截頭錐高 2r，小錐高 r，大錐高 3r：
\[
V_Y=9\pi r^3-\frac13\pi r^3=\frac{26}{3}\pi r^3.
\]
（b）半球 = (2/3)πr³。(26/3)πr³ = k(2/3)πr³，k = 13。

questions.solution: 14. A solid metal right circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(A\) and a frustum \(B\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The base radius and the height of \(A\) are 6 cm and 8 cm respectively. The curved surface area of \(B\) is \(480 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). (a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), (i) the curved surface area of \(A\), (ii) the volume of \(B\). (6 marks) (b) The frustum \(B\) is melted and recast into 12 identical solid right circular cylinders. The height of each circular cylinder is 13 cm . Find the base radius of each circular cylinder. (2 marks) 14. (a) (i) The slant height of \(A\) \[ =\sqrt{6^{2}+8^{2}} \mathrm{~cm} \\ =10 \mathrm{~cm}\] The curved surface area of \(A\) \[=\pi(6)(10) \mathrm{cm}^{2} 1 \mathrm{M} \\ =60 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2} 1 \mathrm{~A}\] (ii) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) and \(V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the lower base radius and the volume of \(B\) respectively. \[\left(\frac{6}{r}\right)^{2} =\frac{60 \pi}{60 \pi+480 \pi} \\ r^{2} =324 \\ r =18 \text { or }-18 \text { (rejected) }\] The volume of \(A\) \[=\frac{1}{3} \pi(6)^{2}(8) \mathrm{cm}^{3}\] \[=96 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] \[\frac{96 \pi}{96 \pi+V}=\left(\frac{6}{18}\right)^{3}\] \[V=2496 \pi\] \(\therefore \) The volume of \(B\) is \(2496 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). (b) Let \(R \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of each circular cylinder. \[12 \times \pi R^{2} \times 13=2496 \pi 1 \mathrm{M} \\ R=4 \text { or }-4 \text { (rejected) } 1 \mathrm{~A}\] \(\therefore \) The base radius of each circular cylinder is 4 cm .

（4 分）

圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。

questions.solution: 14. A metal solid consists of a right circular cone and a hemisphere with a common base. The base radius and the height of the cone are \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) and \((r+6) \mathrm{cm}\) respectively. It is known that the volume of the hemisphere is \(\frac{3}{2}\) times the volume of the cone. (a) Find \(r\). (b) The metal solid is now melted and recast into 8 smaller identical solids which are similar to the original metal solid. A craftsman claims that the sum of the total surface areas of the 8 smaller solids is greater than \(7500 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (4 marks) 14. (a) Volume of the hemisphere \(=\frac{3}{2} \times\) volume of the cone \[\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{4}{3} \pi r^{3} =\frac{3}{2} \times \frac{1}{3} \pi r^{2}(r+6) 1 \mathrm{M}+1 \mathrm{M} \\ 4 r^{3} =3 r^{3}+18 r^{2} \\ r^{3}-18 r^{2} =0 1 \mathrm{~A}\] (b) Total surface area of the original metal solid \[ =\left[\pi(18) \sqrt{18^{2}+(18+6)^{2}}+\frac{1}{2} \times 4 \pi(18)^{2}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2} 1 \mathrm{M}+1 \mathrm{M} \\ =(540 \pi+648 \pi) \mathrm{cm}^{2} \\ =1188 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] Sum of the total surface areas of the 8 smaller solids \( =8 \times 1188 \pi \times\left(\sqrt[3]{\frac{1}{8}}\right)^{2} \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ =2376 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ \approx 7464.4241 \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ <7500 \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ \therefore \text { The claim is disagreed. }\)

questions.stem:
13. A solid metal right circular cylinder of base radius 10 cm and height 4.2 cm is melted and recast into two similar solid metal right circular cones \(X\) and \(Y\). The ratio of the base area of \(X\) to the base area of \(Y\) is \(4:9\). The ratio of the base radius of \(Y\) to its height is \(3:4\).

(a) Find the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\). (2 marks)

(b) Find the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(c) The frustum \(Z\) is made by cutting off the upper part of \(Y\). The heights of \(X\) and \(Z\) are the same. Someone claims that the curved surface area of \(Z\) is twice the curved surface area of \(X\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個底半徑 \(10\) cm、高 \(4.2\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心金屬直立圓錐 \(X\) 及 \(Y\)。\(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的底面積比為 \(4:9\)，\(Y\) 的底半徑與高之比為 \(3:4\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的體積。（2 分）

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。（3 分）

(c) 切除 \(Y\) 的上部造成截頭錐 \(Z\)，\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 的高相等。某人聲稱 \(Z\) 的曲面面積為 \(X\) 的兩倍。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The volume of the cylinder is \[\pi(10)^2(4.2)=420\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Since the base area ratio of \(X\) to \(Y\) is \(4:9\), the base radius ratio of \(X\) to \(Y\) is \(2:3.\) As \(X\) and \(Y\) are similar, the volume ratio of \(X\) to \(Y\) is \(2^3:3^3=8:27.\) Hence \(\text{Volume of }Y=420\pi\times\frac{27}{8+27}=324\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b) Let the base radius and height of \(Y\) be \(3k\) cm and \(4k\) cm respectively. Then \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(3k)^2(4k)=324\pi.\] Thus \(12k^3=324,\qquad k^3=27,\qquad k=3.\) The base radius and height of \(Y\) are 9 cm and 12 cm respectively. The slant height of \(Y\) is \(\sqrt{9^2+12^2}=15.\) Therefore the curved surface area of \(Y\) is \(\pi(9)(15)=135\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (c) Since the curved surface area ratio of two similar cones equals the square of their corresponding length ratio, \[\frac{\text{curved surface area of }X}{\text{curved surface area of }Y}=\frac{4}{9}.\] Thus \(\text{curved surface area of }X=135\pi\times\frac{4}{9}=60\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) Since the height ratio of \(X\) to \(Y\) is \(2:3\), the height of \(X\) is \(12\times\frac{2}{3}=8\text{ cm}.\) Hence the height of \(Z\) is also 8 cm. The small cone removed from \(Y\) has height \(12-8=4\) cm, so its linear scale compared with \(Y\) is \(\frac{4}{12}=\frac{1}{3}\). Therefore \(\text{curved surface area of }Z =135\pi-135\pi\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^2 =120\pi.\) Since \(120\pi=2(60\pi),\) the claim is correct. (8 marks)

questions.solution: 13. The volume of \(X\) is \(\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)=2592\pi\). The larger sphere has radius twice that of the smaller sphere, so its volume is 8 times the smaller sphere's volume. questions.stem:
14. A solid metal right prism of base area \(75 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) and height 126 cm is melted and recast into two similar solid right pyramids . The bases of the two pyramids are squares . The ratio of the base area of the smaller pyramid to the base area of the larger pyramid is \(16: 25\).

(a) Find the volume of the larger pyramid .

(b) Now a craftsman measures the height of the larger pyramid to be 30 cm .
The craftsman claims that the total surface area of the smaller pyramid exceeds \(1500 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). Do you agree ? Explain your answer .
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個底面積 \(75\text{ cm}^2\)、高 \(126\) cm 的實心直立棱柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立錐體，兩錐底面均為正方形。較小錐與較大錐的底面積比為 \(16:25\)。

(a) 求較大錐的體積。

(b) 某工匠量得較大錐的高為 \(30\) cm，他聲稱較小錐的總表面積超過 \(1500\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Similar solids: area ratio = k², volume ratio = k³.
questions.hintZh:
柱體：體積 = 底面積 × 高。
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution:
(a) The original prism volume is \(75(126)=9450\text{ cm}^3\). The pyramid length ratio is 4:5, hence the volume ratio is 64:125. The larger volume is \(9450(125/189)=6250\text{ cm}^3\).
(b) Its base area is \(3(6250)/30=625\text{ cm}^2\), so its base side is 25 cm. The face slant height is \(\sqrt{30^2+12.5^2}=32.5\) cm. Its total area is \(625+4(25)(32.5)/2=2250\text{ cm}^2\). The smaller total area is \(2250(16/25)=1440\text{ cm}^2\), below 1500 cm². Disagree.

questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心直立圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(24\) cm 及 \(18\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分，三部分高度相等。以 \(\pi\) 表示：

(a) 中間部分的體積；

(b) 中間部分的總表面積。（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh: 圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The largest cone has radius 18 cm and height 24 cm, so its volume is \[\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)=2592\pi.\] The cone is divided into three equal heights. By similarity, the volume ratios of the three parts from top to bottom are \[1^3:(2^3-1^3):(3^3-2^3)=1:7:19.\] Hence the volume of the middle part is \[\frac{7}{27}(2592\pi)=672\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) The slant height of the largest cone is \[\sqrt{18^2+24^2}=30\text{ cm}.\] The curved surface area of the largest cone is \[\pi(18)(30)=540\pi.\] The curved surface area ratios of the three similar cones are \(1^2:2^2:3^2\), so the curved surface area of the middle frustum is \[\frac{3}{9}(540\pi)=180\pi.\] Adding the two circular ends with radii 6 cm and 12 cm gives \[180\pi+\pi(6)^2+\pi(12)^2=360\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Marks follow the marking scheme: formula and similarity ratio method marks, with final answers \(672\pi\text{ cm}^3\) and \(360\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Total: 8 marks.

questions.stem:
13. The radii of two solid metal spheres are 6 cm and 12 cm respectively. They are melted and recast into a solid right circular cone \(X\). It is given that the height of \(X\) is 24 cm.

(a) Find the base radius of \(X\). (3 marks)

(b) Express the total surface area of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(c) \(X\) is divided into a circular cone \(Y\) and a frustum \(Z\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The volume of \(Z\) is 26 times the volume of \(Y\). Someone claims that the total surface area of \(Z\) is greater than the total surface area of \(X\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 兩個實心金屬球的半徑分別為 \(6\) cm 及 \(12\) cm，熔化後重鑄成一個實心直立圓錐 \(X\)。已知 \(X\) 的高為 \(24\) cm。

(a) 求 \(X\) 的底半徑。（3 分）

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(X\) 的總表面積。（3 分）

(c) \(X\) 被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(Y\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Z\)。\(Z\) 的體積為 \(Y\) 的 \(26\) 倍。某人聲稱 \(Z\) 的總表面積大於 \(X\) 的總表面積。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The total volume of the two spheres is \[\frac43\pi(6)^3+\frac43\pi(12)^3=2592\pi.\] Let the base radius of \(X\) be \(r\) cm. Since the height of \(X\) is 24 cm, \(\frac13\pi r^2(24)=2592\pi.\) Thus \(8r^2=2592,\) so \(r=18.\) (b) The slant height of \(X\) is \[\sqrt{18^2+24^2}=30.\] Hence the total surface area of \(X\) is \(\pi(18)(30)+\pi(18)^2=864\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (c) Since the volume of \(Z\) is 26 times the volume of \(Y\), the volume of \(X\) is 27 times the volume of \(Y\). Hence the linear scale factor from \(Y\) to \(X\) is \(1:3\). Thus the radius and slant height of \(Y\) are \(6\text{ cm} \text{and} 10\text{ cm}\) respectively. The curved surface area of \(Z\) is \(\pi(18)(30)-\pi(6)(10)=480\pi.\) The two circular faces of \(Z\) have total area \(\pi(18)^2+\pi(6)^2=360\pi.\) Therefore, the total surface area of \(Z\) is \(480\pi+360\pi=840\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) Since \(840\pi<864\pi,\) the claim is not agreed. (9 marks)

questions.stem:
13. A frustum is made by cutting off the upper part of a right circular cone. The height of the frustum is 12 cm . The radius of the upper base and the radius of the lower base of the frustum are 5 cm and 9 cm respectively.

(a) Find the volume of the frustum in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) The frustum is melted and recast into two identical solid spheres.

(i) Find the radius of each sphere in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) Determine whether the total surface area of the two spheres is greater than the total surface area of the original frustum. Explain your answer.
(4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個直立圓錐切除上部造成一個截頭錐，截頭錐高 \(12\) cm，上底半徑及下底半徑分別為 \(5\) cm 及 \(9\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求截頭錐的體積。

(b) 將截頭錐熔化重鑄成兩個相同實心球。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求每個球的半徑。
(ii) 判斷兩個球的總表面積是否大於原截頭錐的總表面積。試解釋你的答案。
（4 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: (a) Let \(h\) cm be the height of the small cone cut off. By similarity, \(\frac{h}{h+12}=\frac59\), giving \(h=15\). Thus the frustum volume is \[\frac13\pi(9^2)(27)-\frac13\pi(5^2)(15)=604\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b)(i) Let the radius of each sphere be \(r\) cm. By conservation of volume, \(2\left(\frac43\pi r^3\right)=604\pi,\) so \(r^3=\frac{453}{2}\) and \(r=\sqrt[3]{\frac{453}{2}}\text{ cm}\approx6.095\text{ cm}.\) (ii) The slant height of the frustum is \(\sqrt{12^2+(9-5)^2}=4\sqrt{10}\) cm. Its total surface area is \[\pi(5+9)(4\sqrt{10})+\pi(5^2+9^2) =(56\sqrt{10}+106)\pi\approx889.35\text{ cm}^2.\] The total surface area of the two spheres is \[2(4\pi r^2)=8\pi\left(\frac{453}{2}\right)^{2/3}\approx933.87\text{ cm}^2.\] Therefore the total surface area of the two spheres is greater.

(a) Find the height of the right circular cone.
(3 marks)

(b) Find the volume of frustum \( Y \) in terms of \( \pi \).

(c) Frustum \( Y \) is melted and recast into a sphere. Does the total surface area of the sphere exceed the total surface area of frustum \( Y \) ? Explain your answer.

(a) 求直立圓錐的高。（3 分）

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 求截頭錐 \(Y\) 的體積。（2 分）

(c) 將截頭錐 \(Y\) 熔化重鑄成一個球。球的總表面積是否超過截頭錐 \(Y\) 的總表面積？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）

questions.solution: 14. (a) Let \( A_{x} \mathrm{~cm}^{2}, A_{y} \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \) and \( A_{z} \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \) be the curved surface area of \( X, Y \) and \( Z \) respectively \(A_{x}:\left(A_{x}+A_{y}\right):\left(A_{x}+A_{y}+A_{z}\right)=1^{2}: 3^{2}: 4^{2} \\ =1: 9: 16 \\ \therefore A_{x}: A_{y}: A_{z}=1: 8: 7\) Let \( l \mathrm{~cm} \) be the slant height of the cone \[\pi(20)(l) \times \frac{8}{16} =520 \pi \\ l =52\] \[\therefore \text { Height of the cone } =\sqrt{52^{2}-20^{2}} \\ =48 \mathrm{~cm}\] (b) \[\text { Volume of } Y =\frac{1}{3} \pi(20)^{2}(48) \times \frac{3^{3}-1^{3}}{4^{3}} \\ =2600 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] (c) Total surface area of \( Y=520 \pi+\pi\left(20 \times \frac{1}{4}\right)^{2}+\pi\left(20 \times \frac{3}{4}\right)^{2} \) \(=770 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) Let \( r \mathrm{~cm} \) be the radius of the sphere \(\frac{4}{3} \pi r^{3} =2600 \pi \\ r =\sqrt[3]{1950}\) \(\text { Total surface area of the sphere } =4 \pi(\sqrt[3]{1950})^{2} \\ \approx 624.3331554 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ <770 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) ∴ No. The total surface area of the sphere does not exceed that of frustum \( Y \).

(b) 兩球熔化後重鑄成兩個實心直立正方形底錐體，記為 \(A\) 及 \(B\)。已知 \(A\) 的底邊長及高分別為 \(20\) cm 及 \(15\) cm，某學生量得 \(B\) 的底邊長為 \(40\) cm。該學生聲稱 \(A\) 與 \(B\) 相似。該聲稱是否正確？試解釋你的答案。

球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。

questions.solution:
13. (a) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the radius of the larger sphere \( 4 \pi r^{2}=900 \pi \\ r=15\) 
 Radius of the smaller sphere \(=9 \mathrm{~cm}\) 
 Volume of the smaller sphere \[ =\frac{4}{3} \pi(9)^{3} \\ =972 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] (b) The volume of \(A\) 
 \(=\frac{1}{3}(20)^{2}(15)\) 
 \(=2000 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 The volume of \(B\) 
 \(=972 \pi+\frac{4}{3} \pi(15)^{3}-2000\) 
 \(\approx 15191 \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 \(\frac{\text { volume of } B}{\text { volume of } A}=\frac{15191}{2000} \approx 7.60\) 
 \(\left(\frac{\text { length of a side of base of } B}{\text { length of a side of base of } A}\right)^{3}=8\) 
 \(8 \neq 7.60\) 
 Thus, \(A\) and \(B\) are not similar. The claim is not correct. Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of \(B\). 
 \(\frac{1}{3}(40)^{2}(h)=15191\) 
 \(h \approx 28.5\) 
 \(\frac{\text { height of } B}{\text { height of } A}=\frac{28.5}{15} \approx 1.90\) 
 \(\frac{\text { length of a side of base of } B}{\text { length of a side of base of } A}=2\) 
 \(2 \neq 1.90\) 
 Thus, \(A\) and \(B\) are not similar. The claim is not correct.

14. There are 30 identical solid metal spheres each of diameter 12 cm. All the metal spheres are melted and recast into a solid right circular cone of base radius 24 cm.

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The volume of \(Y\) is 7 times the volume of \(X\).

(i) Express the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) Find the ratio of the total surface area of \(X\) to the total surface area of \(Y\).

questions.stemZh:
14. 有 \(30\) 個直徑 \(12\) cm 的相同實心金屬球，全部熔化後重鑄成一個底半徑 \(24\) cm 的實心直立圓錐。

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(Y\) 的體積為 \(X\) 的 \(7\) 倍。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。
(ii) 求 \(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的總表面積之比。
（8 分）

questions.solution: 14. (a) Let \(h\) cm be the height of the circular cone. Since each sphere has radius \(6\) cm, \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(24)^2h=30\left(\frac{4}{3}\pi(6)^3\right).\] Therefore \[192\pi h=8640\pi,\] so \[ h=45. \] The height of the circular cone is \(45\) cm. (b)(i) Since \(V_X:V_{\text{whole cone}}=1:(1+7)=1:8\), the linear scale factor of cone \(X\) to the whole cone is \(\sqrt[3]{\frac{1}{8}}=\frac{1}{2}.\) The slant height of the whole cone is \(\sqrt{24^2+45^2}=51\text{ cm}.\) The curved surface area of the whole cone is \(\pi(24)(51)=1224\pi.\) The curved surface area of cone \(X\) is \(\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2(1224\pi)=306\pi.\) Hence the curved surface area of frustum \(Y\) is \(1224\pi-306\pi=918\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (ii) The base radius of \(X\) is \(12\) cm. Thus the total surface area of \(X\) is \[306\pi+\pi(12)^2=450\pi.\] The total surface area of \(Y\) is \[918\pi+\pi(12)^2+\pi(24)^2=1638\pi.\] Therefore the required ratio is \[450\pi:1638\pi=25:91.\]

(a) Find the volume of \(B\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) The circular cone \(A\) is melted and recast into a solid sphere and the frustum \(B\) is melted and recast into a solid right circular cylinder. (a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(B\) 的體積。

(b) 將圓錐 \(A\) 熔化重鑄成一個實心球，截頭錐 \(B\) 熔化重鑄成一個實心直立圓柱。已知球的半徑與圓柱的底半徑相同。某人聲稱圓柱的總表面積最少為球的總表面積的兩倍。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。

questions.solution:
13(a) Volume of the original cone \(=\frac{1}{3} \pi(36)^{2}(18)\) \(=7776 \pi\) 
 ∴ Volume of \(B=7776 \pi \times \frac{18^{3}-(18-6)^{3}}{18^{3}}\) \(=5472 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) 
 Let the base radius of the cylinder be \(r \mathrm{~cm}\), the height of the cylinder be \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) 
 Note that the radius of the sphere \(=r\) 
 Volume of sphere \(=\frac{4}{3} \pi r^{3}=7776 \pi-5472 \pi\) \(r=12\) 
 Volume of cylinder \(=\pi(12)^{2} h=5472 \pi\) \(h=38\) 
 Total surface area of cylinder \(=2 \pi(12)(38)+2 \pi(12)^{2}\) 
 \(=1200 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) 
 Twice the total surface area of sphere 
 \(=2\left(4 \pi(12)^{2}\right)\) 
 \(=1152 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}<1200 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) 
 ∴ The claim is agreed. 1 M for \(V=\frac{1}{3} \pi r^{2} h\) 
 1 M for \(V \times \frac{l_{1}^{3}-l_{2}^{3}}{l_{1}^{3}}\)

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求兩個半球的總體積。

(b) 兩個半球熔化後重鑄成一個直立圓錐，圓錐的底半徑與高之比為 \(4:9\)。某人聲稱圓錐的總表面積超過 \(280\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。

questions.solution: 12. The sum of the total surface areas of two hemispheres is \(135 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). The ratio of the curved surface area of the larger hemisphere to the curved surface area of the smaller hemisphere is \(4: 1\). (a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the total volume of the two hemispheres. (4 marks) (b) The two hemispheres are melted and recast into a right circular cone. The ratio of the base radius of the circular cone to the height of the circular cone is \(4: 9\). Someone claims that the total surface area of the circular cone exceeds \(280 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (3 marks) (a) radius of the larger hemisphere: radius of the smaller hemisphere \(=\sqrt{\left(\frac{4}{1}\right)}=\frac{2}{1} 1 \mathrm{~A}\) Let \(r\) and \(2 r\) be the radius of the smaller and larger hemisphere respectively, \[3 \pi(r)^{2}+3 \pi(2 r)^{2} =135 \pi \\ r =3\] ∴ Volume of the smaller hemisphere \( =\frac{2}{3} \pi(3)^{3}+\frac{2}{3} \pi(6)^{3}\) \[=\underline{\underline{162 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}}}\] (b) Let \(4 k\) and \(k\) be the radius and the height of the circular cone respectively. \[162 \pi =\frac{1}{3} \pi(4 k)^{2}(9 k) \\ k^{3} =3.375 \\ k =1.5\] The total surface area of the circular cone \(=\pi(4 \times 1.5)^{2}+\pi(4 \times 1.5)\left(\sqrt{(4 \times 1.5)^{2}+(9 \times 1.5)^{2}} 1 \mathrm{M}\right.\) \( =391.56 \ldots \mathrm{~cm}^{2} \\ >280 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) ∴ The claim is correct. 1f.t.

questions.stem:
12. Four solid metal right circular cones of base radius 25 cm and height 28 cm are melted and recast into two different hemispheres. Given that the ratio of the radius of the smaller hemisphere to the radius of the larger hemisphere is \(2:3\).

(a) Find the volume of the larger hemisphere in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) Find the percentage change in total surface area. (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 四個底半徑 \(25\) cm、高 \(28\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓錐熔化後，重鑄成兩個不同的半球。已知較小半球與較大半球的半徑比為 \(2:3\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較大半球的體積。（3 分）

(b) 求總表面積的百分數變化。（4 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 12. (a) Let \(2r\) cm and \(3r\) cm be the radii of the smaller hemisphere and the larger hemisphere respectively. \[4\left[\frac{1}{3}\pi(25)^2(28)\right] =\frac{2}{3}\pi(2r)^3+\frac{2}{3}\pi(3r)^3.\] \(r^3=1000,\) so \(r=10\). The volume of the larger hemisphere is \(\frac{2}{3}\pi(3\times10)^3=18000\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) ------------------(3) (b) The total surface area of the four circular cones is \[4\{\pi(25)^2+\pi(25)\sqrt{25^2+28^2}\}\] \[=(2500+100\sqrt{1409})\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] The total surface area of the two hemispheres is \(3\pi(2\times10)^2+3\pi(3\times10)^2=3900\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) The percentage change in total surface area is \(\frac{3900\pi-(2500+100\sqrt{1409})\pi}{(2500+100\sqrt{1409})\pi}\times100\%.\) \[\approx -37.63656868\%.\] Therefore, the total surface area is decreased by \(37.6\%\), correct to 3 significant figures. ------------------(4)

questions.stem:
13. A solid metal right prism of base area \(76\text{ cm}^2\) and height \(12\text{ cm}\) is melted and recast into two similar solid right pyramids. The bases of the two pyramids are squares. The ratio of the base area of the smaller pyramid to the base area of the larger pyramid is \(9:25\).

(a) Find the volume of the smaller pyramid.

(b) If the height of the smaller pyramid is \(6\text{ cm}\), find the total surface area of the larger pyramid.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個底面積 \(76\text{ cm}^2\)、高 \(12\) cm 的實心直立棱柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立錐體，兩錐底面均為正方形。較小錐與較大錐的底面積比為 \(9:25\)。

(a) 求較小錐的體積。

(b) 若較小錐的高為 \(6\) cm，求較大錐的總表面積。
（7 分）
questions.hint: Similar solids: area ratio = k², volume ratio = k³.
questions.hintZh:
柱體：體積 = 底面積 × 高。
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The volume of the prism is \[76\times 12=912\text{ cm}^3.\] Since the base-area ratio of the two similar pyramids is \(9:25\), their linear ratio is \[ 3:5. \] Thus their volume ratio is \[3^3:5^3=27:125.\] The volume of the smaller pyramid is \[912\times \frac{27}{27+125}=162\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) Let the side length of the square base of the smaller pyramid be \(x\) cm. Then \[\frac{1}{3}x^2(6)=162.\] Hence \[x^2=81,\] so \[ x=9. \] The slant height of the smaller pyramid is \(\sqrt{4.5^2+6^2}=7.5\text{ cm}.\) Therefore, the total surface area of the smaller pyramid is \(9^2+4\left(\frac{1}{2}\times 9\times 7.5\right)=216\text{ cm}^2.\) The surface-area ratio of the smaller pyramid to the larger pyramid is \(9:25\). Hence the total surface area of the larger pyramid is \(216\times \frac{25}{9}=600\text{ cm}^2.\)

questions.stem:
13. A sphere is melted and recast into 2 similar cones. The radius of the sphere is 6 cm. It is given that the ratio of the curved surface area of the 2 cones is \(25:4\).

(a) Find the volume of the smaller cone. (4 marks)

(b) If the base radius of the smaller cone is 2 cm, is the total curved surface area of the 2 cones larger than the surface area of the sphere? Explain your answer. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個球熔化後重鑄成兩個相似圓錐，球半徑為 \(6\) cm。已知兩圓錐的曲面面積比為 \(25:4\)。

(a) 求較小圓錐的體積。（4 分）

(b) 若較小圓錐的底半徑為 \(2\) cm，兩圓錐的總曲面面積是否大於球的表面積？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The volume of the sphere is \[\frac{4}{3}\pi(6)^3=288\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] The ratio of the curved surface areas of the two similar cones is \(25:4\), so their linear ratio is \(5:2.\) Hence their volume ratio is \(5^3:2^3=125:8.\) Therefore the volume of the smaller cone is \(288\pi\times\frac{8}{125+8} =\frac{2304\pi}{133}\text{ cm}^3.\) (b) Let \(h\) cm be the height of the smaller cone. Since its base radius is 2 cm, \[\frac{1}{3}\pi(2)^2h=\frac{2304\pi}{133}.\] Thus \[h=\frac{1728}{133}.\] The slant height of the smaller cone is \(\sqrt{2^2+\left(\frac{1728}{133}\right)^2}.\) Hence its curved surface area is \(\pi(2)\sqrt{2^2+\left(\frac{1728}{133}\right)^2}.\) Since the curved surface area ratio of the larger cone to the smaller cone is \(25:4\), the total curved surface area of the two cones is \(\frac{29}{4}\) times the curved surface area of the smaller cone. Numerically, \(\text{total curved surface area}\approx598.8\text{ cm}^2.\) The surface area of the sphere is \(4\pi(6)^2\approx452.4\text{ cm}^2.\) Since \(598.8>452.4\), the total curved surface area of the two cones is larger than the surface area of the sphere. (7 marks)

questions.stem:
9. The total surface area of a metal solid hemisphere is \(1728\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(a) Find the volume of the hemisphere in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) The hemisphere is melted and recast into \(n\) identical right circular cylinders. The base radius of each circular cylinder is half of the radius of the hemisphere while the height of each circular cylinder is \(16\) cm. Alan claims that the total curved surface area of all the circular cylinders is greater than \(5000\text{ cm}^2\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
9. 一個金屬實心半球的總表面積為 \(1728\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求半球的體積。

(b) 將半球熔化重鑄成 \(n\) 個相同直立圓柱，每個圓柱的底半徑為半球半徑的一半，高為 \(16\) cm。Alan 聲稱所有圓柱的總曲面面積大於 \(5000\text{ cm}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（5 分）
questions.hint: Sphere: V = (4/3)πr³, S = 4πr². Water displaced = object volume.

圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 9. (a) Let \(r\) cm be the radius of the hemisphere. The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is \(3\pi r^2\). Hence \[3\pi r^2=1728\pi,\] so \[ r=24. \] The required volume is \[\frac{2}{3}\pi r^3 =\frac{2}{3}\pi(24)^3 =9216\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b) Since the base radius of each circular cylinder is \(\frac{r}{2}=12\) cm and the height is \(16\) cm, \[\pi\left(\frac{r}{2}\right)^2(16n)=9216\pi.\] Thus \[\pi(12)^2(16n)=9216\pi,\] so \[ n=4. \] The total curved surface area of all the circular cylinders is \[2\pi\left(\frac{r}{2}\right)(16)(4) =2\pi(12)(16)(4) \approx 4825.486316\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[4825.486316<5000,\] the claim is disagreed.

questions.stem:
14. A solid metal right circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(A\) and a frustum \(B\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The base radius and the height of \(A\) are \(6\) cm and \(8\) cm respectively. The curved surface area of \(B\) is \(480\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\),

(i) the curved surface area of \(A\),
(ii) the volume of \(B\).

(b) The frustum \(B\) is melted and recast into \(12\) identical solid right circular cylinders. The height of each circular cylinder is \(13\) cm. Find the base radius of each circular cylinder.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(A\) 及一個截頭錐 \(B\)。\(A\) 的底半徑及高分別為 \(6\) cm 及 \(8\) cm，\(B\) 的曲面面積為 \(480\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示：

(i) \(A\) 的曲面面積；
(ii) \(B\) 的體積。

(b) 將截頭錐 \(B\) 熔化重鑄成 \(12\) 個相同的實心直立圓柱，每個圓柱高 \(13\) cm，求每個圓柱的底半徑。
（8 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 14. (a)(i) The slant height of \(A\) is \(\sqrt{6^2+8^2}=10\text{ cm}.\) Therefore, the curved surface area of \(A\) is \(\pi(6)(10)=60\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (a)(ii) Let the base radius of the original large cone be \(r\) cm. Since the curved surface areas of similar cones are proportional to the squares of corresponding lengths, \(\left(\frac{6}{r}\right)^2=\frac{60\pi}{60\pi+480\pi}.\) Thus \(\left(\frac{6}{r}\right)^2=\frac{1}{9},\) so \(r=18.\) By similarity, the height of the original large cone is \(8\left(\frac{18}{6}\right)=24\text{ cm}.\) The volume of cone \(A\) is \(\frac13\pi(6)^2(8)=96\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) Let the volume of \(B\) be \(V\text{ cm}^3\). Since volumes of similar cones are proportional to the cubes of corresponding lengths, \(\frac{96\pi}{96\pi+V}=\left(\frac{6}{18}\right)^3=\frac{1}{27}.\) Hence \(2592\pi=96\pi+V,\) so \(V=2496\pi.\) Therefore, the volume of \(B\) is \(2496\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b) Let the base radius of each circular cylinder be \(R\) cm. Then \[12\pi R^2(13)=2496\pi.\] Thus \[R^2=16,\] so \[ R=4. \] Therefore, the base radius of each circular cylinder is \[4\text{ cm}.\]

questions.stem:
14. A solid metal right circular cylinder of base radius \(20\text{ cm}\) and height \(8.4\text{ cm}\) is melted and recast into two similar solid right circular cones \(X\) and \(Y\). The ratio of the base area of \(X\) to the base area of \(Y\) is \(4:9\). The ratio of the base radius of \(Y\) to its height is \(3:4\).

(a) Find the volume of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) Find the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(c) The frustum \(Z\) is made by cutting off the upper part of \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The heights of \(X\) and \(Z\) are the same. Find the curved surface area of \(Z\). (2 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個底半徑 \(20\) cm、高 \(8.4\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓柱熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓錐 \(X\) 及 \(Y\)。\(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的底面積比為 \(4:9\)，\(Y\) 的底半徑與高之比為 \(3:4\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的體積。（3 分）

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。（3 分）

(c) 沿一個平行於底面的平面切除 \(Y\) 的上部，造成截頭錐 \(Z\)，\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 的高相等。求 \(Z\) 的曲面面積。（2 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 14. (a) The volume of the cylinder is \[\pi(20)^2(8.4)=3360\pi.\] Since the ratio of the base areas of \(X\) and \(Y\) is \(4:9\), the ratio of their radii is \(2:3\), and the ratio of their volumes is \(2^3:3^3=8:27.\) Therefore \(\text{volume of }Y=\frac{27}{8+27}(3360\pi)=2592\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b) Let the base radius of \(Y\) be \(3k\) and its height be \(4k\). \[\frac13\pi(3k)^2(4k)=2592\pi.\] Thus \(12k^3=2592,\) so \(k=6.\) Hence \(r=18\) and \(h=24\). The slant height is \(\sqrt{18^2+24^2}=30.\) The curved surface area of \(Y\) is \(\pi(18)(30)=540\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (c) Since \(X\) and \(Y\) are similar and the ratio of their heights is \(2:3\), \[\text{height of }X=\frac{2}{3}(24)=16.\] The height of \(Z\) is \(16\), so the removed small cone has height \(8\). Its scale factor compared with \(Y\) is \(\frac{8}{24}=\frac13.\) Therefore the curved surface area of the removed small cone is \(540\pi\left(\frac13\right)^2=60\pi.\) The curved surface area of \(Z\) is \(540\pi-60\pi=480\pi\text{ cm}^2.\) (8 marks)

questions.stem:
14. There are two solid metal spheres. The ratio of the surface area of the smaller sphere to the surface area of the larger sphere is \(9:25\). The radius of the smaller sphere is 9 cm.

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the volume of the larger sphere. (3 marks)

(b) The two spheres are melted and recast into two solid right circular cones. Denote these two circular cones by \(P\) and \(Q\). It is given that the height and the base radius of \(P\) are 24 cm and 12 cm respectively. A student finds that the height of \(Q\) is 40 cm. The student claims that \(P\) and \(Q\) are similar. Do you agree? Explain your answer. (5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 有兩個實心金屬球。較小球與較大球的表面積比為 \(9:25\)，較小球半徑為 \(9\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較大球的體積。（3 分）

(b) 兩球熔化後重鑄成兩個實心直立圓錐，記為 \(P\) 及 \(Q\)。已知 \(P\) 的高及底半徑分別為 \(24\) cm 及 \(12\) cm，某學生量得 \(Q\) 的高為 \(40\) cm。該學生聲稱 \(P\) 與 \(Q\) 相似。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（5 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 14. (a) Let the radius of the larger sphere be \(r\) cm. Since the ratio of surface areas is \(9:25\), \(\left(\frac{9}{r}\right)^2=\frac{9}{25}.\) Thus \(\frac{9}{r}=\frac35,\) so \(r=15.\) Therefore, the volume of the larger sphere is \(\frac43\pi(15)^3=4500\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (b) The volume of cone \(P\) is \[\frac13\pi(12)^2(24)=1152\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Let the base radius of cone \(Q\) be \(r\) cm. The total volume of the two spheres is \(\frac43\pi(9)^3+4500\pi.\) Thus \(\frac13\pi r^2(40)=\frac43\pi(9)^3+4500\pi-1152\pi.\) Hence \(\frac{40}{3}r^2=4320,\) so \(r=18.\) Now \(\frac{\text{base radius of }P}{\text{base radius of }Q}=\frac{12}{18}=\frac23,\) but \(\frac{\text{height of }P}{\text{height of }Q}=\frac{24}{40}=\frac35.\) The ratios are different, so \(P\) and \(Q\) are not similar. The claim is not agreed. (8 marks)

(a) Express the volume of the smaller circular cone in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) If the height of the smaller circular cone is 36 cm, express the total surface area of the larger circular cone in terms of \(\pi\). (4 marks)

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較小圓錐的體積。（3 分）

(b) 若較小圓錐的高為 \(36\) cm，以 \(\pi\) 求較大圓錐的總表面積。（4 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.

questions.solution: 13. (a) The volume of the cylinder is \[364\pi(25)=9100\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] Since the ratio of the base areas of the smaller cone to the larger cone is \(9:16\), the ratio of their corresponding lengths is \(3:4.\) Thus, the ratio of their volumes is \(3^3:4^3=27:64.\) Therefore, the volume of the smaller cone is \(\frac{27}{27+64}(9100\pi)=2700\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) ------------------(3) (b) The base area of the smaller cone is \[\frac{3(2700\pi)}{36}=225\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] Hence the radius of the smaller cone is \(15\text{ cm}.\) Since the cones are similar and their corresponding lengths are in the ratio \(3:4\), the radius and height of the larger cone are \(20\text{ cm}\) and \(48\text{ cm}\) respectively. The slant height of the larger cone is \(\sqrt{20^2+48^2}=52\text{ cm}.\) Therefore, the total surface area of the larger cone is \(\pi(20)^2+\pi(20)(52).\) \[=400\pi+1040\pi=1440\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] ------------------(4)

13. A solid metal hemisphere of radius 12 cm is melted and recast into two solid metal right circular cones \(X\) and \(Y\). The base radius and the curved surface area of \(X\) are 8 cm and \(80 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) respectively.

(a) Find the volume of the hemisphere.

(b) Find the volume of \(X\).

(c) Suppose the base radius of \(Y\) is 16 cm . Mr. Yip claims that if \(Y\) is divided into two parts by a plane which is parallel to its base, the upper part can be identical to \(X\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
