(a) 求半球的體積。

(b) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(c) 設 \(Y\) 的底半徑為 \(16\) cm。Mr. Yip 聲稱若 \(Y\) 被一個平行於底面的平面分成兩部分，上部可與 \(X\) 完全相同。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。

重鑄前後體積不變。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution:
(a) Hemisphere volume is \(2\pi(12)^3/3=1152\pi\text{ cm}^3\).
(b) From \(\pi(8)l=80\pi\), l = 10 cm. The height of X is \(\sqrt{10^2-8^2}=6\) cm, and its volume is \(128\pi\text{ cm}^3\).
(c) Y has volume \(1152\pi-128\pi=1024\pi\text{ cm}^3\). With radius 16 cm its height is 12 cm. Thus radius and height of Y are both twice those of X. A parallel cut halfway down from the apex of Y produces an upper cone with radius 8 cm and height 6 cm, identical to X. Agree.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 半球體積為 \(2\pi(12)^3/3=1152\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。
(b) 由 \(\pi(8)l=80\pi\) 得斜高 10 cm。X 高為 \(\sqrt{10^2-8^2}=6\) cm，體積為 \(128\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。
(c) Y 體積為 \(1024\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。由底半徑 16 cm 得高 12 cm。因此 Y 的半徑及高均為 X 的兩倍。在距頂點 6 cm 處作平行於底面的切割，上方小圓錐的半徑為 8 cm、高為 6 cm，與 X 全等，所以同意。

(a) Find the base radius of X. (2 marks)

(b) Express the total surface area of X in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(c) X is divided into a circular cone Y and a frustum Z by a plane parallel to its base. The volume of Z is 7 times the volume of Y. Someone claims that the total surface area of Z is greater than the total surface area of X. Do you agree? Explain your answer. (3 marks)

12. 兩個實心金屬球的半徑分別為 \(4\) cm 及 \(8\) cm，熔化後重鑄成一個實心直立圓錐 \(X\)。已知 \(X\) 的高為 \(16\) cm。

(a) 求 \(X\) 的底半徑。（2 分）

(b) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(X\) 的總表面積。（3 分）

(c) \(X\) 被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(Y\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Z\)。\(Z\) 的體積為 \(Y\) 的 \(7\) 倍。某人聲稱 \(Z\) 的總表面積大於 \(X\) 的總表面積。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。（3 分）

questions.solution:
(a) Conservation of volume gives \(\frac43\pi(4^3+8^3)=\frac13\pi r^2(16)\). Thus \(16r^2=2304\), giving r = 12 cm.
(b) Slant height is 20 cm, so total area is \(\pi(12)(20)+\pi(12)^2=384\pi\text{ cm}^2\).
(c) Y is one eighth of the original volume, so its radius and slant height are 6 and 10 cm. Z has curved area \(\pi(12)(20)-\pi(6)(10)=180\pi\). Its two plane faces have total area \(\pi(12)^2+\pi(6)^2=180\pi\). Thus its total area is \(360\pi\text{ cm}^2\), less than \(384\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Disagree.

(a) 由體積守恆，\(\frac43\pi(4^3+8^3)=\frac13\pi r^2(16)\)。所以 \(16r^2=2304\)，得 r = 12 cm。
(b) 斜高為 20 cm，總表面積為 \(\pi(12)(20)+\pi(12)^2=384\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。
(c) Y 體積是原來的八分之一，半徑及斜高分別為 6、10 cm。Z 曲面積為 \(180\pi\)，兩個底面面積和亦為 \(180\pi\)。故 Z 總表面積為 \(360\pi\text{ cm}^2\)，小於原來的 \(384\pi\text{ cm}^2\)，所以不同意。

(b) If the base radius of the larger circular cone is 36 cm , find the total surface area of the smaller circular cone in terms of \(\pi\).

12. \(42\) 個半徑 \(6\) cm 的相同實心金屬球熔化後，重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓錐。較小圓錐與較大圓錐的高之比為 \(1:3\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求較大圓錐的體積。

(b) 若較大圓錐的底半徑為 \(36\) cm，以 \(\pi\) 求較小圓錐的總表面積。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。

questions.solution: 12. 42 identical solid metal spheres with radius 6 cm are melted and recast into 2 similar solid right circular cones. The ratio of the height of the smaller circular cone to the height of the larger circular cone is \(1: 3\). (a) Find the volume of the larger circular cone in terms of \(\pi\). (b) If the base radius of the larger circular cone is 36 cm , find the total surface area of the smaller circular cone in terms of \(\pi\). (a) Let \(V_{1} \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volume of the larger circular cone and \(V_{2} \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volume of the smaller circular cone. \[ \frac{V_{2}}{V_{1}}=\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{3} \\ V_{2}=\frac{1}{27} V_{1}\] \[ \text { Volume of the sphere }=\frac{4 \pi}{3} \times 6^{3} \\ \qquad V_{1}+V_{2}=12096 \pi \\ V_{1}+\frac{1}{27} V_{1}=10296 \pi \\ \frac{28}{27} V_{1}=10296 \pi \\ V_{1}=11664 \pi\] Thus, the volume of the larger circular cone is \(11664 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\). (b) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}, h \mathrm{~cm}\) and \(\ell \mathrm{cm}\) be the base radius, height and slant height of the smaller circular cone respectively. \[\frac{r}{36} =\frac{1}{3} \\ r =12\] \[ \text { Volume of the smaller circular cone }=\frac{1}{3} \times \pi \times 12 \\ \qquad 12096 \pi-11664 \pi=\frac{144}{3} \pi h \\ 432 \pi=\frac{144}{3} \pi h \\ h=9 \\ \ell=\sqrt{12^{2}+9^{2}} \\ =15\] Total surface area of the smaller circular cone \(=\left(\pi \times 12^{2}+\pi \times 12 \times 15\right) \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(=324 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\)

questions.solution: 13. A metal circular cone \(X\) with height 20 cm was melted and recast into another metal circular cone \(Y\) and a metal circular cylinder \(Z\). It is given that \(X\) and \(Y\) are similar. The volume of \(Z\) is \(1176 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) and its base radius is 7 cm . The height of \(Z\) is equal to twice the height of \(Y\). (a) Find the height of \(Z\). (b) Find the base radius of \(Y\). (c) Someone claims that the sum of the curved surface area of \(Y\) and the curved surface area of \(Z\) is greater than the curved surface area of \(X\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (a) Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of \(Z\). \[\pi(7)^{2} \times h =1176 \pi \\ h =24\] The height of \(Z\) is 24 cm . (b) The height of \(Y\) is \(\frac{1}{2} \times 24=12 \mathrm{~cm}\). Let \(V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) be the volume of \(Y\). \( \frac{\text { volume of } Y}{\text { volume of } X}=\left(\frac{12}{20}\right)^{3} \\ \frac{V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}}{\text { volume of } X}=\frac{27}{125} \\ \text { volume of } X=\frac{125}{27} \mathrm{Vcm}^{3}\) volume of \(X=\) volume of \(Y+\) volume of \(Z\) \(\frac{125}{27} V =V+1176 \pi \\ \frac{98}{27} V =1176 \pi \\ V =324 \pi\) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of \(Y\). The base radius of \(Y\) is 9 cm . \(\frac{1}{3} \times \pi(r)^{2} \times 12 =324 \pi \\ r =9\) 13. [Continued] (c) base radius of \(X\) \[=\left(\frac{20}{12}\right)(9)\] \[=15 \mathrm{~cm}\] the curved surface area of \(X\) \[ =\pi(15)\left(\sqrt{20^{2}+15^{2}}\right) \mathrm{cm}^{2} \\ =375 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] the curved surface area of \(Y\) \[=\pi(9)\left(\sqrt{12^{2}+9^{2}}\right) \mathrm{cm}^{2}\] \[=135 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] the curved surface area of \(Z\) \[=2 \pi(7)(24) \mathrm{cm}^{2}\] \[=336 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] The total sum of curved surface area of \(Y\) and \(Z\) \(=135 \pi+336 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) \(=471 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) \(>375 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) ∴ The claim is agreed.

questions.stem:
13. Kelvin has 4 identical solid metal cubes of side 12 cm . From each of the cubes, Kelvin cuts off the largest square pyramid of same shape. All the remaining metals are melted and recast into 27 smaller identical solid square pyramids which are similar to the larger square pyramids cut off from the cubes.

(a) Find the height of a smaller square pyramid.

(b) Find the ratio of the total surface area of a smaller square pyramid to that of a larger square pyramid.

(c) Kelvin claims that the ratio in (b) will be different if the sides of the metal cubes used at the beginning are not 12 cm . Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
13. Kelvin 有 \(4\) 個邊長 \(12\) cm 的相同實心金屬立方體。從每個立方體切去一個最大的同形正方形底錐體。將所有剩餘金屬熔化後，重鑄成 \(27\) 個與切出的大正方形底錐相似的相同小正方形底錐。

(a) 求小正方形底錐的高。

(b) 求小正方形底錐與大正方形底錐的總表面積之比。

(c) Kelvin 聲稱若最初金屬立方體的邊長不是 \(12\) cm，

(b) 的比便會不同。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Similar solids: area ratio = k², volume ratio = k³.
questions.hintZh:
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
先計算相關數值，再同題目聲稱比較，明確表態 同意/不同意。
questions.solution: 13. (a) Let \(h\) cm be the height of a smaller square pyramid. The largest square pyramid cut from each cube has square base side \(12\) cm and height \(12\) cm. Hence \[27\cdot \frac{1}{3}h^3 =4\left(12^3-\frac{1}{3}\cdot 12^2\cdot 12\right).\] Therefore \[9h^3=4608\] and \(h=8\). The height of a smaller square pyramid is \(8\) cm. (b) The ratio of corresponding lengths of a smaller pyramid to a larger pyramid is \(8:12=2:3\). Therefore the ratio of their total surface areas is \[2^2:3^2=4:9.\] (c) I do not agree. If the side of each original cube is \(a\) cm, the largest square pyramid cut off from each cube has volume \(\frac{1}{3}a^3\). The total volume recast is \[4\left(a^3-\frac{1}{3}a^3\right)=\frac{8}{3}a^3.\] If the height of each smaller similar square pyramid is \(h\), then \[27\cdot \frac{1}{3}h^3=\frac{8}{3}a^3,\] so \(h=\frac{2a}{3}\). The corresponding length ratio is always \(2:3\), so the surface area ratio is always \(4:9\).

questions.stem:
12. In a workshop, 9 identical solid metal spheres of radius \(6\) cm are melted and recast into a circular cone. It is given that the base radius of the cone is \(18\) cm.

(a) Find the height of the circular cone.

(b) The circular cone is divided into a right circular cone \(X\) and a frustum \(Y\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The ratio of the volume of \(X\) to the volume of \(Y\) is \(8:19\). Express the curved surface area of \(Y\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 某工作坊將 \(9\) 個半徑 \(6\) cm 的相同實心金屬球熔化後，重鑄成一個圓錐。已知圓錐的底半徑為 \(18\) cm。

(a) 求圓錐的高。

(b) 該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個圓錐 \(X\) 及一個截頭錐 \(Y\)。\(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的體積比為 \(8:19\)。以 \(\pi\) 表示 \(Y\) 的曲面面積。
（6 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 12. (a) Let \(h\) cm be the height of the circular cone. By conservation of volume, \[\frac13\pi(18)^2h=9\left(\frac43\pi(6)^3\right).\] Hence \[108\pi h=2592\pi,\] so \[ h=24. \] Therefore, the height of the circular cone is \(24\) cm. (b) The volume ratio is \[V_X:V_Y=8:19,\] so \[V_X:V_{\text{whole cone}}=8:27.\] Thus the linear scale factor from \(X\) to the whole cone is \[\sqrt[3]{\frac8{27}}=\frac23.\] The slant height of the whole cone is \[\sqrt{18^2+24^2}=30.\] Hence the radius and slant height of the smaller cone \(X\) are \[12 \text{and} 20\] respectively. Therefore, the curved surface area of the frustum \(Y\) is \[\pi(18+12)(30-20)=300\pi.\]

13. The slant height and the base radius of a solid metal right circular cone are 82 cm and 18 cm respectively. The circular cone is melted and recast into three similar solid right circular cylinders. Denote these three circular cylinders by \(A, B\) and \(C\). It is given that the ratio of the base area of \(A\) to the base area of \(B\) to the base area of \(C\) is \(4: 9: 25\).

(a) Find the volume of \(C\).

(b) There are two solid hemispheres. The radii of the two hemispheres are equal to the base radii of \(A\) and \(B\) respectively. If the sum of the curved surface areas of the two hemispheres is \(234 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\), find the height of \(C\).
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心金屬直立圓錐的斜高及底半徑分別為 \(82\) cm 及 \(18\) cm。該圓錐熔化後重鑄成三個相似的實心直立圓柱，記為 \(A\)、\(B\) 及 \(C\)。已知 \(A\)、\(B\)、\(C\) 的底面積比為 \(4:9:25\)。

(a) 求 \(C\) 的體積。

(b) 有兩個實心半球，半徑分別等於 \(A\) 及 \(B\) 的底半徑。若兩個半球的曲面面積和為 \(234\pi\text{ cm}^2\)，求 \(C\) 的高。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
圓柱：體積 \(\pi r^2 h\)，曲面 \(2\pi r h\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The height of the circular cone \[=\sqrt{82^{2}-18^{2}} \mathrm{~cm}\] \[=80 \mathrm{~cm}\] The ratio of the volume of \(A\) to the volume of \(B\) to the volume of \(C\) \[=(\sqrt{4})^{3}:(\sqrt{9})^{3}:(\sqrt{25})^{3}\] \[=(2)^{3}:(3)^{3}:(5)^{3}\] \[=8: 27: 125\] The volume of \(C\) \[=\frac{1}{3} \pi(18)^{2}(80)\left(\frac{125}{8+27+125}\right) \mathrm{cm}^{3}\] \[=6750 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] (b) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of \(C\). The base radius of \(A\) is \(\frac{2}{5} r \mathrm{~cm}\) and the base radius of \(B\) is \(\frac{3}{5} r \mathrm{~cm}\). \(\frac{1}{2} \times 4 \pi\left(\frac{2}{5} r\right)^{2}+\frac{1}{2} \times 4 \pi\left(\frac{3}{5} r\right)^{2} =234 \pi \\ \frac{26}{25} r^{2} =234 \\ r^{2} =225 \\ r =15\) Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the height of \(C\). \(\pi r^{2} h =6750 \pi \\ \pi(15)^{2} h =6750 \pi \\ h =30\) Thus, the height of \(C\) is 30 cm . for the formula of the volume of a cone volume of a cylinder

The base radius of \(Y\) is \(10\) cm. \(Z\) is melted and recast into a solid metal hemisphere. The total surface area of the hemisphere is \(432\pi\text{ cm}^2\).

(a) Express the volume of the hemisphere in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) Does the total surface area of the hemisphere exceed the total surface area of \(Z\)? Explain your answer. (5 marks)
questions.stemZh:

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求半球的體積。（3 分）

(b) 半球的總表面積是否超過 \(Z\) 的總表面積？試解釋你的答案。（5 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
球：體積 \(\frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\)，面積 \(4\pi r^2\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
重鑄前後體積不變。
questions.solution: 14. (a) Let the radius of the hemisphere be \(r\) cm. The total surface area of a solid hemisphere is \[2\pi r^2+\pi r^2=3\pi r^2.\] Given that \[3\pi r^2=432\pi,\] we have \[r^2=144,\] so \[ r=12. \] Therefore, the volume of the hemisphere is \[\frac12\left(\frac43\pi r^3\right)\] \[=\frac23\pi(12)^3\] \[=1152\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) Let the height of cone \(X\) be \(h\) cm. Since cone \(Y\) and cone \(X\) are similar, the height of cone \(Y\) is \[\frac{10}{14}h=\frac57h.\] Thus the volume of frustum \(Z\) is \[\frac13\pi(14)^2h-\frac13\pi(10)^2\left(\frac57h\right).\] Since \(Z\) is recast into the hemisphere, \[\frac13\pi(14)^2h-\frac13\pi(10)^2\left(\frac57h\right)=1152\pi.\] Thus \[\frac{872}{21}h=1152,\] so \[h=\frac{3024}{109}.\] The height of frustum \(Z\) is \[\frac27h=\frac{6048}{763}.\] The slant height of \(Z\) is \[\sqrt{\left(\frac{6048}{763}\right)^2+(14-10)^2}\] \[\approx 8.878686548.\] Hence the total surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(14^2)+\pi(10^2)+\pi(14+10)(8.878686548).\] Therefore, \[\text{total surface area of }Z\approx 1599.35\text{ cm}^2.\] But \[432\pi\approx 1357.17\text{ cm}^2.\] Since \[1357.17<1599.35,\] the total surface area of the hemisphere does not exceed the total surface area of \(Z\). (5 marks)

The heights of the smaller cone and the larger cone are 15 cm and 60 cm respectively. (a) Find the volume of the smaller cone in terms of \(\pi\). (b) Someone claims that the total surface area of the larger cone is at least \(2000 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer. (a) Volume of the cylinder \[=\pi\left(5^{2}\right)(65) \mathrm{cm}^{3} \mathbf{1 M}\] \[=1625 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] Height of the smaller cone : height of the larger cone \[=15 \mathrm{~cm}: 60 \mathrm{~cm}\] \[ =1: 4 \] Volume of the smaller cone \[=\frac{1^{3}}{1^{3}+4^{3}} \times 1625 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] \[=25 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] (b) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of the larger cone. \[ \frac{1}{3} \pi r^{2}(60)=1625 \pi-25 \pi \\ r=\sqrt{80}\] Total surface area of the larger cone \( =\left[\pi(\sqrt{80})^{2}+\pi(\sqrt{80}) \sqrt{(\sqrt{80})^{2}+60^{2}}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2} \mathbf{1} \mathbf{M} \text { for } \pi r l+\mathbf{1} \mathbf{A} \\ =(80+80 \sqrt{46}) \pi \mathrm{cm}^{2} \\ \approx 1955.912856 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}<2000 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) ∴ The claim is disagreed. Base radius of the smaller cone \(=\sqrt{\frac{25 \pi \times 3}{\pi(15)}} \mathrm{cm}\) \(=\sqrt{5} \mathrm{~cm}\) Total surface area of the smaller cone \(=\left[\pi(\sqrt{5})^{2}+\pi(\sqrt{5}) \sqrt{(\sqrt{5})^{2}+15^{2}}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(\mathbf{1 M}\) for \(\pi r l+\mathbf{1} \mathbf{A}\) \(=(5+5 \sqrt{46}) \pi \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) Total surface area of the larger cone \(=[(5+5 \sqrt{46}) \pi \times 16] \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(=(80+80 \sqrt{46}) \pi \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(\approx 1955.912856 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}<2000 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) ∴ The claim is disagreed. f.t.

A craftsman finds that the volume of \(Y\) is \(800\pi\text{ cm}^3\).

(a) Find the base radius of \(Y\).

(b) Are \(Y\) and \(Z\) similar? Explain your answer.

questions.stemZh:
14. 實心直立圓柱 \(X\) 的底半徑與實心直立圓錐 \(Y\) 的底半徑相等。\(X\) 及 \(Y\) 的高分別為 \(20\) cm 及 \(24\) cm。實心直立圓錐 \(Z\) 的體積等於 \(X\) 與 \(Y\) 的體積之和，\(Z\) 的底半徑等於 \(X\) 的底直徑。某工匠量得 \(Y\) 的體積為 \(800\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。

(a) 求 \(Y\) 的底半徑。

(b) \(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。

(c) 該工匠聲稱 \(X\) 的曲面面積與 \(Y\) 的曲面面積之和大於 \(Z\) 的曲面面積。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。

questions.solution: (a) Let the common base radius of \(X\) and \(Y\) be \(r\). \[\frac13\pi r^2(24)=800\pi\] so \[8r^2=800,\qquad r=10.\] (b) The base radius of \(Z\) is \(20\). The volume of \(X\) is \[\pi(10)^2(20)=2000\pi.\] Thus the volume of \(Z\) is \(2800\pi\). Since the radius ratio \(Y:Z=10:20=1:2\) but the volume ratio \(800\pi:2800\pi=2:7\ne 1:8\), \(Y\) and \(Z\) are not similar. (c) The curved surface area of \(X\) is \[2\pi(10)(20)=400\pi.\] The slant height of \(Y\) is \(\sqrt{10^2+24^2}=26\), so the curved surface area of \(Y\) is \[\pi(10)(26)=260\pi.\] For \(Z\), \[\frac13\pi(20)^2h=2800\pi\] so \(h=21\), and its slant height is \(\sqrt{20^2+21^2}=29\). Hence the curved surface area of \(Z\) is \[\pi(20)(29)=580\pi.\] Since \[400\pi+260\pi=660\pi>580\pi,\] the claim is agreed. Final answers: (a) \(10\text{ cm}\); (b) no; (c) agree.

questions.solution: (a) The radius of the upper circular face of \(P\) is \[20\cdot\frac{48-12}{48}=15.\] Hence \[V_P =\frac13\pi(20)^2(48)-\frac13\pi(15)^2(36)\\ =\boxed{3700\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\] (b) The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{20^2+48^2}=52.\] The slant height of \(P\) is \[52\cdot\frac{12}{48}=13.\] Thus the total surface area of \(P\) is \[\pi(20+15)(13)+\pi(20)^2+\pi(15)^2=1080\pi.\] Since \(P\) and \(Q\) are similar and their linear ratio is \(20:15=4:3\), \[\text{TSA of }Q=1080\pi\left(\frac34\right)^2=607.5\pi.\] Therefore \[\text{TSA of }S=1080\pi+607.5\pi=1687.5\pi.\] Now \[\frac{\text{TSA of }S}{\text{TSA of }P}=\frac{1687.5}{1080}=\frac{25}{16},\] but \[\left(\frac{\text{height of }S}{\text{height of }P}\right)^2 =\left(\frac{16}{12}\right)^2=\frac{16}{9}.\] Since these are not equal, \(P\) and \(S\) are not similar.

(b) 兩圓柱熔化後重鑄成兩個實心直立圓錐，記為 \(A\) 及 \(B\)。\(A\) 的高及底半徑分別為 \(42\) cm 及 \(12\) cm，已知 \(B\) 的高為 \(84\) cm。\(A\) 與 \(B\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）

(a) The cylinder length ratio X:Y is 4:5 and volume ratio 64:125. Thus \(V_Y=6144\pi(125/64)=12000\pi\text{ cm}^3\).
(b) The total recast volume is \(18144\pi\text{ cm}^3\). Cone A has volume \(\pi(12)^2(42)/3=2016\pi\text{ cm}^3\), so B has volume \(16128\pi\text{ cm}^3\). From \(\pi r^2(84)/3=16128\pi\), r = 24 cm. Radius ratio A:B = 12:24 = 1:2, equal to height ratio 42:84, so they are similar.

questions.stem:
12. The height and the base radius of a solid right circular cone are 120 cm and 64 cm respectively. The circular cone is divided into three parts by two planes which are parallel to its base. The heights of the upper part, middle part and lower part of the cone are in the ratio \(1:3:4\).

(a) Find the volume of the middle part of the cone in terms of \(\pi\). (3 marks)

(b) A frustum \(X\) has a height of 10 cm and a total surface area of \(400\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Are the middle part of the cone and the frustum \(X\) similar? Explain your answer. (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 一個實心直立圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(120\) cm 及 \(64\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分，上部、中部、下部的高之比為 \(1:3:4\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求圓錐中部的體積。（3 分）

(b) 一個截頭錐 \(X\) 的高為 \(10\) cm、總表面積為 \(400\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。圓錐中部與截頭錐 \(X\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。（4 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 12. Since the height ratio is \(1:3:4\), the total number of parts is \[1+3+4=8.\] The heights of the upper part, middle part and lower part are \[15\text{ cm}, 45\text{ cm}, 60\text{ cm}\] respectively. (a) The radius at height 15 cm from the vertex is \[64\left(\frac{15}{120}\right)=8\text{ cm}.\] The radius at height \(15+45=60\) cm from the vertex is \[64\left(\frac{60}{120}\right)=32\text{ cm}.\] Therefore, the volume of the middle frustum is \[\frac13\pi(45)(32^2+32\cdot 8+8^2)\] \[=15\pi(1024+256+64) =20160\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) The slant height of the middle frustum is \[\sqrt{45^2+(32-8)^2} =\sqrt{2025+576} =51\text{ cm}.\] The total surface area of the middle frustum is \[\pi(32+8)(51)+\pi(32)^2+\pi(8)^2\] \[=2040\pi+1024\pi+64\pi =3128\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] If the middle part and frustum \(X\) are similar, the ratio of their surface areas should be the square of the ratio of their corresponding heights. However, \[\left(\frac{45}{10}\right)^2=\frac{81}{4},\] while \[\frac{3128\pi}{400\pi}=\frac{391}{50}.\] Since \[\frac{81}{4}\ne \frac{391}{50},\] the middle part of the cone and frustum \(X\) are not similar. (4 marks)

questions.stem:
13. The base radius and the height of a solid right circular cone are 75 cm and 40 cm respectively. The cone is divided into a frustum \(P\) and a right circular cone \(Q\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. It is given that the height of \(Q\) is 24 cm .

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the total surface area of \(P\).

(b) Another solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(R\) and a right circular cone \(S\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height and the volume of \(R\) are 7 cm and \(7350 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) respectively. Are \(P\) and \(R\) similar? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心直立圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(75\) cm 及 \(40\) cm。該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(P\) 及一個直立圓錐 \(Q\)。已知 \(Q\) 的高為 \(24\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(P\) 的總表面積。

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(R\) 及一個直立圓錐 \(S\)。\(R\) 的高及體積分別為 \(7\) cm 及 \(7350\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。\(P\) 與 \(R\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution:
(a) The small cone has radius \(75(24/40)=45\) cm. The original and small slant heights are 85 and 51 cm, so the frustum slant height is 34 cm. Its curved area is \(\pi(75+45)(34)=4080\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Including both circular faces, the total is \(4080\pi+\pi(75)^2+\pi(45)^2=11730\pi\text{ cm}^2\).
(b) P has height 16 cm and volume \(\pi[(75)^2(40)-(45)^2(24)]/3=58800\pi\text{ cm}^3\). The volume ratio P:R is 8:1, so similarity would require a height ratio 2:1. The actual height ratio is 16:7. They are not similar.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 小圓錐半徑為 \(75(24/40)=45\) cm。大、小圓錐斜高分別為 85、51 cm，故截頭錐斜高為 34 cm。曲面積為 \(\pi(75+45)(34)=4080\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。加上兩個圓形底面，總表面積為 \(4080\pi+\pi(75)^2+\pi(45)^2=11730\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。
(b) P 高為 16 cm，體積為 \(58800\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。P:R 體積比為 8:1，若相似則高度比應為 2:1，但實際為 16:7，所以不相似。

questions.stem:
14. The slant height and the curved surface area of the solid metal right circular cone \(X\) are \(85\text{ cm}\) and \(3060\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively.

(a) Find the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) \(X\) is melted and recast into two similar solid right circular cones \(Y\) and \(Z\). The ratio of the base area of \(Y\) to the base area of \(Z\) is \(16:25\).

(i) Find the volume of \(Z\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) It is found that the total surface area of \(Z\) is \(3025\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Are \(X\) and \(Z\) similar? Explain your answer.
(9 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 實心金屬直立圓錐 \(X\) 的斜高及曲面面積分別為 \(85\) cm 及 \(3060\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) 將 \(X\) 熔化重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓錐 \(Y\) 及 \(Z\)。\(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 的底面積比為 \(16:25\)。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Z\) 的體積。
(ii) 量得 \(Z\) 的總表面積為 \(3025\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
（9 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 14. (a) Let \(r\text{ cm}\) be the base radius of \(X\). Since the curved surface area is \(\pi r l\), \[\pi r(85)=3060\pi.\] Thus \[ r=36. \] The height of \(X\) is \[\sqrt{85^2-36^2}=77.\] Therefore, the volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(36)^2(77)=33264\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b)(i) Since the base area ratio of \(Y\) to \(Z\) is \(16:25\), their linear ratio is \(4:5\). Hence \(\frac{\text{volume of }Y}{\text{volume of }Z}=\left(\frac45\right)^3=\frac{64}{125}.\) Let the volume of \(Z\) be \(V\). Then the volume of \(Y\) is \(\frac{64}{125}V\), so \(V+\frac{64}{125}V=33264\pi.\) Thus \(\frac{189}{125}V=33264\pi,\) and \(V=22000\pi.\) Therefore, the volume of \(Z\) is \(22000\pi\text{ cm}^3\). (b)(ii) If \(X\) and \(Z\) were similar, then \(\frac{\text{volume of }X}{\text{volume of }Z} =\left(\frac{\text{total surface area of }X}{\text{total surface area of }Z}\right)^{3/2}.\) The total surface area of \(X\) is \(3060\pi+\pi(36)^2=4356\pi.\) Now \(\frac{\text{volume of }X}{\text{volume of }Z} =\frac{33264}{22000}=\frac{189}{125},\) but \(\left(\frac{4356\pi}{3025\pi}\right)^{3/2} =\left(\frac{36}{25}\right)^{3/2} =\left(\frac65\right)^3 =\frac{216}{125}.\) These are not equal. Therefore, \(X\) and \(Z\) are not similar.

questions.stem:
14. The base of a solid right pyramid A is a square of side 45 cm . The volume of A is 20 250 cm³ .

(a) Find the height of the pyramid. (2 marks)

(b) The pyramid is divided into a frustum P and a pyramid Q by a plane which is parallel to its base. It is
given that the volume of P is 9 882 cm³ .

(i) F ind the height of Q .
(ii) F ind the total surface area of Q .
(iii) The base of another solid right pyramid X is a square. The height and the total surface area of X are
16 cm and 1024 cm² respectively. Are Q and X similar? Explain your answer.
(6 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心直立錐體 \(A\) 的底面為邊長 \(45\) cm 的正方形，\(A\) 的體積為 \(20250\text{ cm}^3\)。

(a) 求錐體的高。（2 分）

(b) 該錐體被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(P\) 及一個錐體 \(Q\)。已知 \(P\) 的體積為 \(9882\text{ cm}^3\)。

(i) 求 \(Q\) 的高。
(ii) 求 \(Q\) 的總表面積。
(iii) 另一個實心直立錐體 \(X\) 的底面為正方形，\(X\) 的高及總表面積分別為 \(16\) cm 及 \(1024\text{ cm}^2\)。\(Q\) 與 \(X\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
（6 分）
questions.hint: Similar solids: area ratio = k², volume ratio = k³.
questions.hintZh:
錐體：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution:
(a) \(20250=\frac13(45)^2H\), hence \(H=30\) cm. There is no π in a square pyramid volume.

(b)(i) \(V_Q=20250-9882=10368\). The linear scale is \((10368/20250)^{1/3}=4/5\), so Q has height 24 cm and base side 36 cm.

(ii) Face slant height \(s=\sqrt{24^2+18^2}=30\) cm. Its total area is \(36^2+4(\frac12\cdot36\cdot30)=3456\text{ cm}^2\).

(iii) If X and Q were similar, their height ratio would be \(16/24=2/3\), so X would have total area \(3456(2/3)^2=1536\text{ cm}^2\). This differs from 1024, so they are not similar.

截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 13. (a) The height of cone \(Q\) is \[40-16=24\text{ cm}.\] Let the base radius of \(Q\) be \(r\) cm. By similarity, \[\frac{r}{75}=\frac{24}{40},\] so \[ r=45. \] The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{75^2+40^2}=85.\] The slant height of cone \(Q\) is \[\sqrt{45^2+24^2}=51.\] Therefore, the slant height of frustum \(P\) is \[85-51=34.\] The curved surface area of \(P\) is \[\pi(75+45)(34)=4080\pi.\] Hence the total surface area of \(P\) is \[4080\pi+\pi(75)^2+\pi(45)^2\] \[=4080\pi+5625\pi+2025\pi =11730\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (4 marks) (b) The volume of \(P\) is \[\frac13\pi(75)^2(40)-\frac13\pi(45)^2(24)\] \[=75000\pi-16200\pi =58800\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] If \(P\) and \(R\) are similar, then the ratio of their volumes should be the cube of the ratio of their corresponding heights. However, \[\frac{V_P}{V_R}=\frac{58800\pi}{7350\pi}=8,\] while \[\left(\frac{16}{7}\right)^3=\frac{4096}{343}\ne 8.\] Therefore, \(P\) and \(R\) are not similar. (3 marks)

questions.stem:
13. The base radius and the height of a solid right circular cone are 20 cm and 48 cm respectively. The circular cone is divided into a frustum \(P\), a frustum \(Q\) and a circular cone \(R\) by two planes which are parallel to its base. It is given that \(P\) and \(Q\) are similar and the height of \(P\), which is 12 cm , is greater than that of \(Q\).

(a) Find the volume of \(P\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) Another solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(S\) and a circular cone \(T\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height of \(S\) is 16 cm . The total surface area of \(S\) is the same as the sum of the total surface areas of \(P\) and \(Q\). Are \(P\) and \(S\) similar? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
13. 一個實心直立圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(20\) cm 及 \(48\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(P\)、一個截頭錐 \(Q\) 及一個圓錐 \(R\)。已知 \(P\) 與 \(Q\) 相似，\(P\) 的高 \(12\) cm 大於 \(Q\) 的高。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(P\) 的體積。

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(S\) 及一個圓錐 \(T\)。\(S\) 的高為 \(16\) cm，\(S\) 的總表面積等於 \(P\) 與 \(Q\) 的總表面積之和。\(P\) 與 \(S\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution:
(a) P is the lower frustum because it is taller than the similar frustum Q. Its upper radius is \(20(36/48)=15\) cm. Thus \(V_P=\pi[(20)^2(48)-(15)^2(36)]/3=3700\pi\text{ cm}^3\).
(b) The original slant height is 52 cm, and P has slant height 13 cm. Its total surface area is \(\pi(20+15)(13)+\pi(20)^2+\pi(15)^2=1080\pi\text{ cm}^2\). The length ratio Q:P is 3:4, so \(A_Q/A_P=9/16\) and \(A_S/A_P=25/16\). If S and P were similar, their height ratio would be 5:4. But their actual height ratio is 16:12 = 4:3. Therefore they are not similar.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) P 比相似的 Q 高，所以 P 是下方的截頭錐。其上底半徑為 \(20(36/48)=15\) cm。因此 \(V_P=\pi[(20)^2(48)-(15)^2(36)]/3=3700\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。
(b) 原圓錐斜高為 52 cm，P 斜高為 13 cm。P 總表面積為 \(\pi(20+15)(13)+\pi(20)^2+\pi(15)^2=1080\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。Q:P 長度比為 3:4，故面積比為 9:16，\(A_S/A_P=25/16\)。若 S 與 P 相似，則高度比應為 5:4，但實際高度比為 16:12 = 4:3，所以不相似。

questions.stem:
14. The base radius and the height of a solid right circular cone are 75 cm and 40 cm respectively. The cone is divided into a frustum \(P\) and a right circular cone \(Q\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. It is given that the height of \(P\) is 16 cm .

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the total surface area of \(P\).

(b) Another solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(R\) and a right circular cone \(S\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height and the volume of \(R\) are 7 cm and \(7350 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) respectively. Are \(P\) and \(R\) similar? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個實心直立圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(75\) cm 及 \(40\) cm。該圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(P\) 及一個直立圓錐 \(Q\)。已知 \(P\) 的高為 \(16\) cm。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(P\) 的總表面積。

(b) 另一個實心直立圓錐被一個平行於底面的平面分成一個截頭錐 \(R\) 及一個直立圓錐 \(S\)。\(R\) 的高及體積分別為 \(7\) cm 及 \(7350\pi\text{ cm}^3\)。\(P\) 與 \(R\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.

圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
截頭錐：大錐 - 細錐，用相似比例。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 14a. Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of \(Q\). Height of \(Q\) \(=(40-16) \mathrm{cm}\) \(=24 \mathrm{~cm}\) \(\frac{\text { Base radius of } Q}{\text { Base radius of the original circular cone }}=\frac{\text { height of } Q}{\text { height of the original circular cone }}\) \( \frac{r}{75}=\frac{24}{40} \\ r=45\) Curved surface area of \(P\) \(=\left[\pi(75) \sqrt{40^{2}+75^{2}}-\pi(45) \sqrt{24^{2}+45^{2}}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(=4080 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) Total surface area of \(P\) \(=\left[4080 \pi+\pi(45)^{2}+\pi(75)^{2}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2}\) \(=11730 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\) 14b. Volume of \(P\) \( =\left[\frac{1}{3} \pi(75)^{2}(40)-\frac{1}{3} \pi(45)^{2}(24)\right] \mathrm{cm}^{3} \\ =58800 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) \(\left(\frac{\text { Height of } P}{\text { Height of } R}\right)^{3}=\left(\frac{16}{7}\right)^{3}=\frac{4096}{343}\) \(\frac{\text { Volume of } P}{\text { Volume of } R}=\frac{58800 \pi}{7350 \pi}=8\) \(\because \left(\frac{\text { Height of } P}{\text { Height of } R}\right)^{3} \neq \frac{\text { volume of } P}{\text { volume of } R}\) \(\therefore P\) and \(R\) are not similar.

questions.stem:
9. In Figure 2, the volume of the solid right prism \(ABCDEFGH\) is \(1020\text{ cm}^3\). The base \(ABCD\) of the prism is a trapezium, where \(AD\) is parallel to \(BC\). It is given that \(\angle BAD=90^\circ\), \(AB=12\) cm, \(BC=6\) cm and \(DE=10\) cm.
Find

(a) the length of \(AD\),

(b) the total surface area of the prism \(ABCDEFGH\).
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
9. 圖 2 中，實心直立棱柱 \(ABCDEFGH\) 的體積為 \(1020\text{ cm}^3\)。棱柱的底面 \(ABCD\) 為梯形，其中 \(AD\parallel BC\)。已知 \(\angle BAD=90^\circ\)、\(AB=12\) cm、\(BC=6\) cm 及 \(DE=10\) cm。
求

(a) \(AD\) 的長度；

(b) 棱柱 \(ABCDEFGH\) 的總表面積。
（5 分）
questions.solution: (a) A right prism has volume equal to base area times its length. Thus the trapezoidal base area is \(1020/10=102\text{ cm}^2\). Its parallel sides are \(BC\) and \(AD\), separated by \(AB=12\) cm. \[\frac12(6+AD)(12)=102 \Rightarrow AD=11\text{ cm}.\] (b) The horizontal and vertical components of \(CD\) are \(11-6=5\) cm and \(12\) cm. Hence \[CD=\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13\text{ cm}.\] The total surface area comprises two trapezoidal ends and four rectangular sides: \[S=2(102)+(12+6+13+11)(10)=624\text{ cm}^2.\] Check: \(102\times10=1020\text{ cm}^3\), as given.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）直立棱柱體積 = 底面積 × 長度。梯形底面積 = 1020/10 = 102 cm²。平行邊為 BC 及 AD，距離 AB = 12 cm：
\[
\frac12(6+AD)(12)=102 \Rightarrow AD=11\text{ cm}.
\]
（b）CD 的水平及垂直分量分別為 11−6 = 5 cm 及 12 cm：
\[
CD=\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13\text{ cm}.
\]
總表面積包括兩個梯形端面及四個長方形側面：
\[
S=2(102)+(12+6+13+11)(10)=624\text{ cm}^2.
\]

questions.stem:
12. Figure 3(a) shows a solid metal right circular cone of base radius \(48\) cm and height \(96\) cm.

(a) Find the volume of the circular cone in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) A hemispherical vessel of radius \(60\) cm is held vertically on a horizontal surface. The vessel is fully filled with milk.

(i) Find the volume of the milk in the vessel in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) The circular cone is now held vertically in the vessel as shown in Figure 3(b). A craftsman claims that the volume of the milk remaining in the vessel is greater than \(0.3\text{ m}^3\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 圖 3(a) 顯示一個底半徑為 \(48\) cm、高為 \(96\) cm 的實心金屬直立圓錐。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 表示該圓錐的體積。

(b) 一個半徑為 \(60\) cm 的半球形容器垂直放置在水平面上，容器完全注滿牛奶。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 表示容器中牛奶的體積。
(ii) 現將該圓錐垂直放入容器中，如圖 3(b) 所示。某工匠聲稱容器中餘下的牛奶體積大於 \(0.3\text{ m}^3\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
（7 分）
questions.solution: (a) The cone volume is \[V_C=\frac13\pi(48)^2(96)=73728\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b)(i) The hemisphere initially contains \(V_H=\frac23\pi(60)^3=144000\pi\text{ cm}^3.\) (ii) The cone's base touches the hemispherical wall. In an axial section, the distance from the rim plane to the cone's base is \[d=\sqrt{60^2-48^2}=36\text{ cm}.\] The part above the rim is a smaller cone of height \(96-36=60\) cm, similar to the whole cone. Volumes scale as the cube of corresponding heights. Therefore the submerged frustum displaces \[V_D=73728\pi\left[1-\left(\frac{60}{96}\right)^3\right]=55728\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] The milk remaining is \[V_H-V_D=88272\pi\text{ cm}^3=0.088272\pi\text{ m}^3\approx0.277\text{ m}^3.\] Since this is less than \(0.3\text{ m}^3\), the claim is incorrect.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）圓錐體積：
\[
V_C=\frac13\pi(48)^2(96)=73728\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]
（b）（i）半球初始盛奶：
\[
V_H=\frac23\pi(60)^3=144000\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]
（b）（ii）圓錐底面接觸半球壁。軸向切面中，邊緣平面至圓錐底面距離：
\[
d=\sqrt{60^2-48^2}=36\text{ cm}.
\]
邊緣以上部分為高 96−36 = 60 cm 的小圓錐，與整錐相似。體積按高度立方縮放。浸水截頭錐排水量：
\[
V_D=73728\pi\left[1-\left(\frac{60}{96}\right)^3\right]=55728\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]
剩餘牛奶：
\[
V_H-V_D=88272\pi\text{ cm}^3\approx0.277\text{ m}^3.
\]
少於 0.3 m³，聲稱不正確。

questions.stem:
11.

(a) Figure 2(a) shows a container of height \(8\) cm which is in the shape of a frustum. The container is made by cutting off a right circular cone with a base circumference of \(24\pi\) cm from a hollow circular cone with a base circumference of \(36\pi\) cm. The container is fully filled with water. Find the volume of the water in the container in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) A solid sphere is placed inside the container as shown in Figure 2(b). It is known that the radius of the sphere equals to the height of the container.

(i) Find the volume of the sphere.
(ii) Abby claims that the ratio of the volume of the water remaining in the container to the volume of the water which flowed out is greater than \(2:1\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
11.

(a) 圖 2(a) 顯示一個高 \(8\) cm 的截頭錐形容器，由切除一個底圓周 \(24\pi\) cm 的直立圓錐造成，而該圓錐取自一個底圓周 \(36\pi\) cm 的空心圓錐。容器完全注滿水。以 \(\pi\) 求容器中水的體積。

(b) 如圖 2(b)，將一個實心球放入容器內。已知球的半徑等於容器的高度。

(i) 求球的體積。
(ii) Abby 聲稱容器中餘下的水體積與溢出的水體積之比大於 \(2:1\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a) Let the upper and lower radii of the frustum be \(r_1\) and \(r_2\) respectively. Since the circumferences are \(24\pi\) cm and \(36\pi\) cm, \[2\pi r_1=24\pi,\qquad 2\pi r_2=36\pi.\] Thus \[r_1=12,\qquad r_2=18.\] Let \(h\) be the height of the original cone. By similarity, \[\frac{h-8}{h}=\frac{12}{18}.\] Hence \[ h=24. \] The volume of water in the container is the volume of the frustum: \[V =\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)-\frac13\pi(12)^2(16)\\ =\boxed{1824\pi\text{ cm}^3}.\] (b)(i) The radius of the sphere is \(8\) cm. Hence its volume is \(\frac43\pi(8)^3=\boxed{\frac{2048\pi}{3}\text{ cm}^3}.\) (ii) From the figure, the volume of water flowed out is half of the volume of the sphere: \[\frac12\left(\frac{2048\pi}{3}\right)=\frac{1024\pi}{3}.\] The volume of water remaining is \[1824\pi-\frac{1024\pi}{3}=\frac{4448\pi}{3}.\] Therefore, the ratio of the volume of water remaining to the volume of water flowed out is \[\frac{4448\pi}{3}:\frac{1024\pi}{3}=139:32.\] Since \(139:32>2:1\), Abby's claim is correct.
questions.solutionZh:
（a）設截頭錐上下半徑 r₁、r₂。2πr₁ = 24π，2πr₂ = 36π，故 r₁ = 12、r₂ = 18。設原錐高 h：
\[
\frac{h-8}{h}=\frac{12}{18},\quad h=24.
\]
水體積：
\[
V=\frac13\pi(18)^2(24)-\frac13\pi(12)^2(16)=1824\pi\text{ cm}^3.
\]
（b）（i）球半徑 8，體積 = 2048π/3 cm³。
（b）（ii）流出水 = 球體積一半 = 1024π/3。剩餘 = 1824π − 1024π/3 = 4448π/3。比 = 139:32 > 2:1，Abby 正確。

questions.stem:
10. The height and the base radius of a solid right circular cone are 144 cm and 60 cm respectively. The circular cone is divided into three parts by two planes which are parallel to its base. The heights of Part I, Part II and Part III are 36 cm, 48 cm and 60 cm respectively as shown in the figure.
Express, in terms of \(\pi\),

(a) the volume of Part I of the circular cone; (3 marks)

(b) the curved surface area of Part II of the circular cone. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
10. 一個實心直立圓錐的高及底半徑分別為 \(144\) cm 及 \(60\) cm。該圓錐被兩個平行於底面的平面分成三部分，第 I、II、III 部分的高分別為 \(36\) cm、\(48\) cm 及 \(60\) cm，如圖所示。
以 \(\pi\) 表示：

(a) 圓錐第 I 部分的體積；（3 分）

(b) 圓錐第 II 部分的曲面面積。（3 分）
questions.solution: 10. The radius of a cross-section of the cone is proportional to its distance from the vertex. The total height is \(144\) cm and the base radius is \(60\) cm, so the radius at height \(h\) from the vertex is \[\frac{60}{144}h=\frac{5}{12}h.\] (a) Part I is the frustum between heights \(108\) cm and \(144\) cm from the vertex. The two radii are \[\frac{5}{12}(108)=45\] and \[\frac{5}{12}(144)=60.\] The height of Part I is \(36\) cm. Therefore, its volume is \[\frac13\pi(36)(60^2+60\cdot45+45^2)\] \[=12\pi(3600+2700+2025)\] \[=99900\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (3 marks) (b) Part II is the frustum between heights \(60\) cm and \(108\) cm from the vertex. The two radii are \[\frac{5}{12}(60)=25\] and \[\frac{5}{12}(108)=45.\] The vertical height of Part II is \(48\) cm, so its slant height is \[\sqrt{48^2+(45-25)^2}=52.\] Therefore, the curved surface area of Part II is \[\pi(45+25)(52)=3640\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (3 marks)

questions.stem:
14. Figure 3(a) shows the front view of a conical transparent decoration with some liquid inside. The base is sealed so that no liquid can come out. The radius and height of the decoration are 3 cm and 7 cm respectively. The decoration is now placed on the horizontal ground with depth of liquid equals 2 cm .

(a) (i) Express the volume of the liquid inside the decoration in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) Express the wet curved surface area in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) The decoration hung down from the ceiling now so that it is inverted. Ada claims that the wet curved surface area will increase by more than \(50 \%\) after it is inverted. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
14. 圖 3(a) 顯示一個錐形透明裝飾品的正視圖，內有一些液體。底部密封，液體不能流出。裝飾品的半徑及高分別為 \(3\) cm 及 \(7\) cm。現將裝飾品放在水平地面上，液體深度為 \(2\) cm。

(a) 

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求裝飾品中液體的體積。
(ii) 以 \(\pi\) 求濕曲面面積。

(b) 現將裝飾品從天花板垂下，倒置過來。Ada 聲稱倒置後濕曲面面積增加超過 \(50\%\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: (a)(i) Liquid volume \(=\frac13\pi(3)^2(7)[1-(5/7)^3]=654\pi/49\text{ cm}^3\). (ii) Wet curved area \(A=3\pi\sqrt{58}[1-(5/7)^2]=72\pi\sqrt{58}/49\text{ cm}^2\). (b) After inversion the liquid occupies a similar cone with volume fraction \(218/343\). Wet curved area \(B=3\pi\sqrt{58}(218/343)^{2/3}\). The increase \((B/A-1)100\%\approx50.9\%\), so Ada is correct.

questions.stem:
12. Figure (a) shows the sector \(O A B C\). By joining \(O A\) and \(O C\) together, \(O A B C\) is folded to form a right circular cone as shown in figure (b). Given that the radius of the sector is 32 cm .
The reflex angle AOC is \(216^\circ\). (a) Find the height of the cone. (b) A hemispherical vessel of radius 24 cm is full of water. An identical cone rests vertically in the vessel as shown in (c). Dick Hui claims that over 80% of its curved surface is immersed. Is he correct? Explain.
questions.stemZh: 圖 (a) 是半徑 32 cm 的扇形 OABC，優角 AOC 為 216°。將 OA 與 OC 接合，摺成圖 (b) 的直立圓錐。（a）求圓錐的高。（b）半徑 24 cm 的半球容器注滿水。將一個相同圓錐垂直放入容器，如圖 (c)。Dick Hui 聲稱超過 80% 的圓錐曲面浸入水中。他是否正確？解釋答案。
questions.solution: 12. (a) Let the base radius of the cone be \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) \[2 \pi(32) \times \frac{216}{360}=2 \pi r\] \[ r=19.2 \] Let the height of the cone be \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) \[h=\sqrt{32^{2}-(19.2)^{2}}=25.6\] (b) Height of the frustum that is immersed in water \(=\sqrt{24^{2}-19.2^{2}}=14.4 \mathrm{~cm}\). Height of the smaller cone that is not immersed in water \(=11.2 \mathrm{~cm}\) Consider the ratio of curved surface area of the smaller cone \(A_{1}\) and that of the larger cone \(A_{2}\) \(\frac{A_{1}}{A_{2}}=\left(\frac{11.2}{25.6}\right)^{2}\) \(\frac{A_{1}}{A_{2}}=\frac{49}{256}\) \% immersed \(=\frac{256-49}{256} \times 100 \%\) \(=80.8 \%>80 \%\) Therefore, his claim is correct.

questions.stem:
14. A solid metal sphere of radius 36 cm is melted and recast into a solid right circular cone of height 81 cm .

(a) Find the base radius of the right circular cone.

(b) A hemispherical bowl of radius 73 cm contains some water originally. The solid right circular cone in (a) is then slowly put into the bowl until it sits vertically in the bowl as shown in the figure below. After placing the cone in the bowl, the water level rises and the bowl is just full of water.
Someone claims that the total wet surface area of the circular cone and the bowl is less than \(5.3 \mathrm{~m}^{2}\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
questions.stemZh:
14. 一個半徑 \(36\) cm 的實心金屬球熔化後，重鑄成一個高 \(81\) cm 的實心直立圓錐。

(a) 求該直立圓錐的底半徑。

(b) 一個半徑 \(73\) cm 的半球形碗盛有一些水。然後將 

(a) 的直立圓錐慢慢放入碗中，直至垂直放置在碗內，如下圖所示。放入圓錐後水位上升，碗剛好注滿水。
某人聲稱圓錐與碗的總濕表面積少於 \(5.3\text{ m}^2\)。你是否同意？試解釋你的答案。
questions.solution: 14. (a) Volume of the metal sphere \[ =\frac{4}{3} \pi(36)^{3} \\ =62208 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of the right circular cone. \[ \frac{1}{3} \pi(81) r^{2}=62208 \pi \\ r=48\] ∴ The base radius of the right circular cone is 48 cm . (b) Refer to the following figure. Let \(h \mathrm{~cm}\) be the length of \(M N\). \(73^{2} =h^{2}+48^{2} \text { (Pyth. theorem) } \\ h =\sqrt{73^{2}-48^{2}} \\ =55 \\ V N =V M-M N \\ =(81-55) \mathrm{cm} \\ =26 \mathrm{~cm}\) Total surface area of the cone and the hemispherical bowl \( =2 \pi(73)^{2}+\pi(48)^{2}+\pi(48) \sqrt{81^{2}+48^{2}}\left[1-\left(\frac{26}{81}\right)^{2}\right] \\ =12962 \pi+\pi(48) \sqrt{8865}\left(\frac{5885}{6561}\right) \\ =53500 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}(3 \text { s.f. }) \\ >5.3 \mathrm{~m}^{2}\) \(\therefore \) The claim is disagreed.
questions.solutionZh: （a）由體積守恆，\(\frac13\pi r^2(81)=\frac43\pi(36)^3\)，得 \(r=48\text{ cm}\)。（b）碗邊緣至圓錐底的深度 \(=\sqrt{73^2-48^2}=55\text{ cm}\)，未浸水小錐高為 \(81-55=26\text{ cm}\)。斜高 \(l=\sqrt{81^2+48^2}=\sqrt{8865}\)。總濕表面包括碗的內曲面、圓錐底面及浸水曲面：\[2\pi(73)^2+\pi(48)^2+\pi(48)\sqrt{8865}\left[1-\left(\frac{26}{81}\right)^2\right]\approx53500\text{ cm}^2=5.35\text{ m}^2.\]大於 5.3 m²，因此不同意。
